settlement_track.summary: The employer-independent temporary work-permanence route is qualifying legal residence rather than visitor or nomad status. After maintaining it continuously for more than three years, the applicant can pursue naturalization directly and may also apply for permanent residence at the three-year point.
settlement_track.notes: The strong classification applies to a genuine non-dependent activity accepted by DIGEMIG. A foreign employee who cannot document an own-account activity should obtain advance filing confirmation.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: The route permits profitable activity without an employment relationship, and SIN expressly addresses work performed in Bolivia under contracts with foreign entities. It can therefore fit an ordinary foreign-client contractor without a local employer, subject to DIGEMIG accepting the activity declaration, Bolivian work location, ROE registration, and supporting contract.

data.notes: Bolivia's ordinary work-residence law establishes an own-account route with a credible residence-to-citizenship track. Confidence remains medium because DIGEMIG does not expose a functioning transactional residence page or a current official checklist specifically addressing foreign remote software contracts.

data.selection_summary: A foreign national may independently register an obrt (sole-trader/craft activity) in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, personally obtain a work permit without a local-employer sponsor or labor-market test, and obtain temporary residence based on that permit. Official classifications include computer programming and permit it from residential premises. Work-permit residence is not excluded from the five-year permanent-residence calculation, so the route can lead to permanent residence and ordinary naturalization. Administration is decentralized and work permits remain quota-controlled; confirm the registration and permit sequence with the chosen municipality, cantonal employment service and SFA field office before relocating.

visa_application.title: Application documents — Service for Foreigners' Affairs
visa_application.notes: There is no unified online residence application. The applicant first completes the FBiH obrt and work-permit steps, then files the temporary-residence application personally with SFA or, where required, through a BiH diplomatic-consular mission.

best_routes.route_name: Federation of BiH obrt registration, independent work permit and work-based temporary residence

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No fixed monthly immigration-income threshold is published. Official guidance treats possession of a BiH work permit as satisfying the residence subsistence and health-insurance requirements.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No fixed BAM monthly threshold is stated for this route.

income_requirement_display.value: No published monthly income threshold; a valid work permit satisfies the residence subsistence screen
income_requirement_display.notes: Business viability, tax registration and mandatory contributions still apply even though there is no stated immigration-income floor.

income_proof_months.notes: The official checklist does not prescribe a set number of prior income months.

key_requirements.requirement: Obtain municipal or city approval to conduct an obrt and register the activity in the Federation of BiH.
Computer programming, computer consultancy and related IT services are expressly listed as permitted obrt activities; computer programming may be carried out from residential premises.

The foreign obrt operator personally applies to the competent cantonal employment service for a work permit. Registered obrt operators are exempt from the labor-market availability test, although annual work-permit quotas still apply.

After the work permit is issued, apply for temporary residence with SFA; required documents include the permit, passport, registration, accommodation, medical certificate and foreign criminal-record documentation.
A first residence application may be filed inside BiH by a visa-exempt national or a person who entered with Visa D; otherwise it is normally filed abroad through a BiH diplomatic-consular mission.
Residence approval or extension carries a BAM 150 administrative fee under the route checklist.
Register for FBiH tax and social insurance, maintain the obrt and pay applicable income tax and mandatory contributions.

initial_validity.value: Up to 1 year
initial_validity.notes: A work permit cannot exceed one year; temporary residence based on it is likewise limited to a maximum of one year.

extension_rules.value: Renewable annually while the obrt, work permit and residence conditions continue to be met
extension_rules.notes: The work-permit renewal and residence-extension sequence must be maintained. Confirm the filing timetable with the competent cantonal service.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: The independently obtained work permit is an express legal basis for temporary residence; residence is granted after a separate SFA application.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: This is residence based on locally registered self-employment, not visitor or digital-nomad permission.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Apply after at least 5 years of continuous temporary residence. Absences may total no more than 10 months, including no single absence longer than 6 months. The applicant must also have subsistence, accommodation, health insurance, official-language knowledge and acceptable criminal/security records.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Work-permit residence is not among the categories excluded from the permanent-residence calculation.

path_to_citizenship.value: After obtaining permanent residence, ordinary naturalization generally requires at least 3 years holding permanent residence, language knowledge, sufficient resources, settled taxes and other financial obligations, security/criminal checks, acceptance of the constitutional order and normally renunciation or loss of prior nationality unless an exception or treaty applies.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Nominal residence timeline is approximately 5 years to permanent residence plus 3 years as a permanent resident, followed by processing.

best_routes.notes: This fits an ordinary foreign-client software engineer because no local employer, local client, startup financing, investment amount or five-local-employee requirement applies to the FBiH obrt/work-permit version. The applicant must operate a genuine local sole-trader business, obtain a quota-controlled work permit, and complete municipality, canton and SFA filings.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No dedicated digital-nomad route or income threshold appears in the current official residence grounds and application-document catalogue.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No dedicated route exists.

income_requirement_display.value: No current dedicated digital-nomad route confirmed
income_requirement_display.notes: Visitor or visa-free status is not a substitute for work-authorized residence.

income_proof_months.notes: Not applicable because no route was confirmed.

key_requirements.requirement: No digital-nomad category appears among the official temporary-residence grounds or SFA application checklists.

initial_validity.notes: No route exists.

extension_rules.notes: No route exists.

path_to_temporary_residence.notes: No digital-nomad residence basis is published.

path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Inapplicable because no such status exists.

path_to_citizenship.notes: Inapplicable because no such status exists.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected as a nonexistent current category. The usable route is registered FBiH self-employment with a work permit, not informal remote work while visiting.

rejected_routes.route_name: Company-founder residence without a work permit

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No personal-income threshold is stated.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No personal-income threshold is stated, but the company faces substantial payroll conditions.

income_requirement_display.value: No personal threshold; company must employ 5 BiH citizens per foreign founder and pay each at least the BiH average gross wage
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: Five local employees per foreign founder; each paid at least average BiH gross wage
income_requirement_display.notes: This is incompatible with an ordinary one-person remote software practice.

income_proof_months.notes: No fixed prior-income period is specified.

key_requirements.requirement: Locally registered and solvent company with settled direct and indirect taxes.
At least five BiH-citizen employees for every foreign founder, each paid at least the average BiH gross wage.

initial_validity.value: Up to 1 year
initial_validity.notes: Temporary residence is generally limited to one year.

extension_rules.value: Renewable only while the company and staffing conditions continue
extension_rules.notes: Annual compliance evidence is required.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Direct temporary residence is possible after satisfying the company-founder conditions.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Potentially after five years if the residence basis remains qualifying and all permanent-residence conditions are met.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Not selected because the five-employee requirement is disproportionate to the profile.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalization could follow permanent residence.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Not a practical route for this profile.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because it requires substantial local business substance: five local employees per foreign founder at prescribed gross salaries.

rejected_routes.route_name: Ordinary local-employer work permit and residence

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No remote-worker threshold applies.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Salary is determined by the local employment arrangement.

income_requirement_display.value: Local employment required
income_requirement_display.notes: The employer obtains the work permit.

income_proof_months.notes: The official guidance does not prescribe a prior-income period.

key_requirements.requirement: Find a local job or invitation; the local employer obtains the work permit before the foreigner begins work.
Apply separately for temporary residence after the work permit is issued.

initial_validity.value: Work permit plus 30 days, but no longer than 1 year

extension_rules.value: Renewal depends on continued local employment and renewed work authorization

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Temporary residence based on the employer-obtained work permit.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Potentially after five qualifying years.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalization may follow permanent residence.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because a local employer and employer-obtained work permit are required.

summary.value: Enrollment in a recognized higher-education institution supports renewable temporary residence without a local employer. The checklist requires enrollment, accommodation, insurance, medical and criminal-record documents, a BAM 150 fee and normally at least BAM 400 per month in subsistence funds. Only half of education-residence time counts toward the five-year permanent-residence period, and the applicant cannot file for permanent residence while the current basis remains education.
summary.notes: A pre-existing software degree alone does not grant residence; actual local enrollment is required.

tax_residency_rule.value: For the selected FBiH route, an individual is an FBiH tax resident if domiciled there or present for 183 or more days, continuously or intermittently, in a tax period. Residents are taxed on income inside and outside the Federation; treaty relief and foreign-tax credits can apply.
tax_residency_rule.notes: Bosnia and Herzegovina has entity-level income-tax systems. Republika Srpska and Brčko rules may differ.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Flat screening rate for FBiH income and self-employment income, applied to the taxable base after allowable expenses rather than gross receipts.

social_contributions_percent.notes: Combined FBiH contribution rate applicable from July 2025. For a sole trader it is applied to the prescribed monthly contribution base, not necessarily actual revenue.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: Screening estimate for a books-based obrt: 36% of the 2026 BAM 1,602 contribution base equals BAM 576.72. The historical conversion used in the underlying contribution review is approximate; classification as a free profession would produce a higher payment.

special_tax_regimes.value: No digital-nomad, remittance-basis or inbound remote-worker tax holiday was found. The applicant is taxed as an ordinary locally registered FBiH sole trader.
special_tax_regimes.notes: Foreign-tax credits and applicable treaties can prevent or reduce double taxation but are not a nomad exemption.

taxes.caveats: Tax residence and contribution liability depend on the entity of registration, domicile, days present, activity classification, contract form, source-of-income analysis and treaty position. Obtain FBiH accountant confirmation, especially concerning obrt versus free-profession classification and VAT treatment of exported services.

taxation_system.value: For the selected FBiH obrt route, personal/self-employment income is generally subject to flat 10% income tax on the taxable base, plus mandatory social contributions calculated on a prescribed monthly base. Entity rules differ.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: FBiH domicile or at least 183 days in a tax period; residents report income earned within and outside FBiH.
taxation_system.income_scope: Worldwide income for an FBiH resident, with foreign-tax credits and treaty priority; FBiH-source income for nonresidents.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No special digital-nomad or inbound-remote-worker regime found.
taxation_system.social_security: Selected-route screening: 36% on the prescribed contribution base. The reported 2026 monthly base is BAM 1,602 for books-based obrt/similar activities and BAM 2,710 for free professions.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: Not progressive; 10% is a flat screening rate, not an expected all-in effective burden. Mandatory social contributions materially increase the total cost.

tax_brackets.threshold_local: No progressive threshold; taxable FBiH income
tax_brackets.applies_to: Personal and self-employment taxable income under the selected FBiH route
tax_brackets.notes: Allowable costs, personal deductions and credits can affect the effective rate.

taxation_system.notes: The displayed tax number is the flat 10% FBiH income-tax rate. It excludes social contributions.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: There is no digital-nomad tax category. A software engineer using the selected route becomes a locally registered FBiH obrt operator and is taxed under ordinary self-employment rules.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: Locally registered FBiH self-employed obrt; not a digital-nomad status
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: 10% flat FBiH income tax on taxable self-employment income, plus mandatory contributions
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: FBiH domicile or 183 or more days in a tax period; residents report domestic and foreign income.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Foreign-client receipts form part of locally registered business income. Other foreign income of an FBiH resident is within the worldwide-income scope, subject to treaty relief and foreign-tax credits.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None found.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: Mandatory FBiH self-employed contributions are screened at 36% of the prescribed monthly base. For a books-based obrt, the published 2026 base is BAM 1,602; classification as a free profession would use BAM 2,710.

fixed_payments.status: confirmed_with_activity_classification_caveat
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: Screening amount BAM 576.72/month for an obrt (36% × BAM 1,602). A free-profession classification would be BAM 975.60/month (36% × BAM 2,710).
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: BAM 150 for approval or extension of temporary residence; permanent-residence fee is BAM 200.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: No separate digital-nomad levy found. Ordinary municipal registration, accounting, banking and possible fiscal-system costs vary locally. Mandatory VAT registration generally begins above BAM 100,000 taxable turnover; cross-border service rules require accountant review.
fixed_payments.notes: Obtain a written local classification of software programming before relying on the lower obrt contribution base.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: Presence below 183 days may still leave FBiH-source tax or locally registered business obligations. The obrt itself creates local registration and contribution obligations.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: An FBiH tax resident operating the obrt generally reports foreign-client business income in FBiH, pays 10% on the taxable base and mandatory contributions, with treaty or foreign-tax-credit analysis where another country also taxes the income.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: Expect monthly contributions based on the prescribed category, bookkeeping and annual income-tax filings. VAT registration becomes relevant above the BAM 100,000 threshold, subject to place-of-supply treatment.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: This block describes the selected local self-employment route; there is no separate nomad exemption.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: Temporary residence is obtained directly after the preliminary obrt and work-permit steps; there is no required multi-year waiting period.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: Requires continuous qualifying temporary residence and compliance with absence and substantive conditions.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: Current consolidated-law interpretation requires at least three years of approved permanent residence before ordinary naturalization.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: Nominal eligibility timeline: five years qualifying temporary residence plus three years permanent residence. Processing and any gaps add time.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: Official consular guidance gives a practical range of 6–12 months; 9 months is the midpoint used for display.

key_conditions.value: Maintain continuous qualifying residence; keep absences within permanent-residence limits; maintain the business, work authorization, accommodation, insurance, subsistence and tax compliance; obtain official-language proficiency; satisfy criminal/security checks; and normally renounce or lose prior nationality unless a treaty or statutory exception applies.
key_conditions.notes: Naturalization is subject to statutory and security review, not automatic after eight years.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: Facilitated naturalization requires marriage to a BiH citizen to have lasted at least five years and remain in force; the applicant must already have permanent residence.

existing_marriage_effect.value: Time in a legally valid existing marriage can count toward the five-year marriage-duration requirement if the marriage remains in force. Marriage also supplies a temporary family-reunification residence basis, but does not itself grant permanent residence or citizenship.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: Residence and citizenship applications remain separate.

requirements_and_risks.value: The spouse route requires a valid and continuing marriage, approved permanent residence for facilitated citizenship, security clearance and normally renunciation or loss of prior nationality unless an exception applies. Authorities can verify cohabitation and authenticity; sham marriage can cause refusal, cancellation and sanctions.
requirements_and_risks.notes: The official application catalogue has separate marriage and common-law partnership categories.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Citizenship is primarily by descent. Birth in BiH alone is insufficient; territorial acquisition principally protects foundlings and children whose parents are unknown, of unknown citizenship or stateless, or who would otherwise be stateless.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A child born in BiH to two foreign parents does not ordinarily acquire citizenship merely by birth. Citizenship applies if the child falls within the unknown-parent, stateless-parent or otherwise-stateless safeguards.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: A permanent-resident parent does not create an ordinary jus-soli entitlement.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: A child born in BiH acquires citizenship by descent when one parent was a BiH citizen at birth. For a child born abroad to one BiH-citizen parent and one foreign parent, registration generally must occur before age 23 unless the child would otherwise be stateless.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: Registration and entity-citizenship procedures should be completed promptly.

parent_benefit_summary.value: A foreign parent of a minor BiH-citizen child can use the official family-reunification residence category. The child's citizenship does not automatically give the parent permanent residence or citizenship.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: Normal residence-continuity and naturalization requirements still apply.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: If the child is a BiH citizen, a foreign father may apply for temporary residence through the parent-with-BiH-citizen-child family-reunification category. Citizenship for the father is not automatic.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: If neither parent is a citizen and the child is not stateless, birth in BiH provides no corresponding benefit.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank. Henley separately placed Bosnia and Herzegovina 42nd in January 2026; methodologies differ.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Strict visa-free category, not the broader mobility score.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Passport Index 2026 category.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: Combined from 41 visa-on-arrival and 5 eTA destinations.

passport.notes: Passport-index categories change as destination policies change. Passport Index is used for the requested breakdown.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: Generally practical in major cities and technology settings. EF EPI 2025 ranked Bosnia and Herzegovina 21st globally with a score of 591 in the high-proficiency band. Government, municipal, tax and residence procedures nevertheless operate in official local languages, and certified translations are routinely required.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: EF EPI uses a self-selected adult test population and is an indicator, not proof that every service provider or official speaks English.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Russian and Ukrainian are not official or generally used administrative languages. Serbian's Cyrillic script may make some written material more approachable, but the languages are not interchangeable; local-language assistance and certified translations should be expected.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: No reliable current national dataset establishing broad Russian or Ukrainian service availability was identified.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate conversion in the previous record of the official May 2026 average net wage of BAM 1,691. Exchange-rate movements mean a current conversion may differ.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate monthly equivalent of the official 2022 gross annual median earnings: BAM 20,622 divided by 12 equals BAM 1,718.50, converted at the CBBH 14 August 2026 middle rate of BAM 1.695708/USD. This is an older gross structural-earnings measure, not a current net-pay median.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate value from the previous record for the lowest 2026 entity statutory net minimum, BAM 1,000 in Republika Srpska. FBiH's minimum is BAM 1,027.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate conversion in the previous record of BAM 1,691 net; the BAM statistic is authoritative and the USD amount varies with the exchange date.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate USD monthly equivalent of the official 2022 gross annual median earnings: BAM 20,622 divided by 12 equals BAM 1,718.50, converted at BAM 1.695708/USD. The four-yearly Structure of Earnings Survey covers employees of sampled active legal entities with 10 or more employees; this older gross measure is not directly comparable with the May 2026 national net average.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No USD value is calculated because the reviewed official national and entity sources do not publish a national maximum salary or upper-percentile bound.

min_salary_local_currency.value: BAM 1,000 net in Republika Srpska; BAM 1,027 net in FBiH
min_salary_local_currency.notes: Statutory 2026 entity minimum wages, not observed minimum earnings. Republika Srpska has higher minimums of BAM 1,050–1,450 depending on required qualification level.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: Official average monthly net wage for persons employed in legal entities, May 2026.

median_salary_local_currency.value: BAM 20,622 gross annual median (BAM 1,718.50 monthly arithmetic equivalent), 2022
median_salary_local_currency.notes: Official national Structure of Earnings Survey result. It is a gross annual median for 2022, published on a four-year cycle and based on sampled active legal entities with 10 or more employees; BAM 1,718.50 is the annual median divided by 12, not a separately published monthly median.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: The reviewed official national and entity sources publish averages by period or activity and the 2022 national survey publishes a median, but none publishes a national maximum salary or upper-percentile bound. An individual highest wage would be disclosure-sensitive and would not constitute a stable national salary statistic, so no BAM maximum is reported.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Mixed official measures: May 2026 monthly net average for employees in legal entities; 2022 gross annual median from the Structure of Earnings Survey, divided by 12 only for display; 2026 statutory entity net minimum wages
average_citizen_salary.period: May 2026 average; 2022 median; calendar-year 2026 minimum wages
average_citizen_salary.notes: The current average and statutory minimum figures are net monthly amounts, while the only official national median located is a 2022 gross annual Structure of Earnings Survey statistic. The median is useful context but must not be compared directly with the May 2026 net average. No official national maximum or upper-percentile salary bound was published in the reviewed national or entity wage sources. USD conversions are approximate.

cost_of_living_note.notes: The focused official-source review did not establish a current, nationally comparable household-budget or cost-of-living amount; no crowd-sourced estimate was substituted.

settlement_track.summary: The FBiH obrt plus independently obtained work permit directly supports qualifying temporary residence, and this work-permit residence is not excluded from the five-year permanent-residence calculation. After permanent residence, ordinary naturalization is available after a further three years, subject to language, tax, security, resources and usually prior-nationality requirements.
settlement_track.notes: The route is credible but administratively decentralized and quota-controlled. Confirm the precise obrt approval, work-permit and residence sequence before committing funds.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: A foreign software engineer can use a locally registered FBiH obrt and personally obtained work permit without a local employer, local client, founder funding, exceptional-talent test or mandatory local hiring. The foreign contract supports the business commercially but is not itself the immigration basis.

data.notes: Official FBiH employment and craft laws support a distinct foreign-sole-trader route, expressly covering computer programming and exempting registered obrt operators from the labor-market test. Confidence is medium because implementation is split among municipal, cantonal, entity and state authorities, the work permit remains quota-controlled, and the precise activity and contribution classification should be confirmed locally.

data.selection_summary: Botswana does not currently offer a dedicated digital-nomad, foreign-remote-worker, or ordinary foreign-client freelancer residence route. A non-citizen can seek an immigrant residence permit or establish a business, but remunerated work or investment for profit uses the separate work-permit framework, and the official materials do not establish an ordinary foreign contract as an independent qualifying basis. Visitor status is not qualifying residence and expressly restricts providing services to businesses or the public in Botswana.

visa_application.title: Botswana eVisa portal
visa_application.notes: This is Botswana's official general visa portal, not a digital-nomad or remote-worker application. Residence, work and permanent-residence applications are separate government services generally filed through the responsible offices.

rejected_routes.route_name: Visitor visa, eVisa or visitor extension

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No remote-work income threshold applies because this is a visitor category.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The visitor service publishes no monthly remote-worker income threshold.

income_requirement_display.value: No remote-worker income threshold; visitor status only
income_requirement_display.notes: Applicants provide documents relevant to their visitor purpose. Those documents do not establish permission to work or reside as a foreign remote worker.

income_proof_months.notes: The visitor service does not publish a fixed number of income-proof months.

key_requirements.requirement: Visa nationals may apply through the official eVisa portal or an immigration office, embassy or consulate.
Visitors who exhaust their permitted visit must seek an extension before the authorized period expires.
The visitor-visa service says the visa must not be used to work for, provide services to, or sell goods to businesses or the public in Botswana.

initial_validity.value: Visitor presence is generally limited to the authorized visit period; the extension service describes a 90-day visitation period, while issued visa validity varies by category.
initial_validity.notes: Visitor presence is not temporary residence for this selection.

extension_rules.value: A visitor may apply for an extension before the authorized visitation period expires.
extension_rules.notes: Approval remains visitor permission and does not create a remote-work, residence, permanent-residence or citizenship route.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: No automatic path; a separate residence-permit application and qualifying basis are required.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The official sources do not treat visitor time as a remote-worker residence category.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: None from visitor status itself.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Permanent residence is a separate discretionary procedure normally requiring at least five years of continuous lawful residence plus character, contribution, standing and means criteria.

path_to_citizenship.value: None from visitor status itself.
path_to_citizenship.notes: General naturalization requires qualifying documented residence and does not arise from an eVisa or visitor extension.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because ordinary visitor admission, an eVisa and visitor extensions are not remote-worker residence statuses and do not provide a qualifying settlement track.

rejected_routes.route_name: Immigrant residence permit combined with business registration or investor work permit

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The government services and Immigration Act publish no monthly income threshold for an ordinary immigrant, investor or foreign remote contractor.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The immigrant residence-permit category requires proof of support or maintenance and a bank statement but states no numerical BWP threshold.

income_requirement_display.value: No numerical minimum published; proof of support or maintenance and a bank statement are required
income_requirement_display.notes: Business registration does not itself confer residence or work permission. Investor applicants must demonstrate an actual Botswana operation and investment documentation.

income_proof_months.notes: The residence service requires a bank statement but does not specify how many statement months an immigrant applicant must submit.

key_requirements.requirement: Immigrant residence applicants submit Forms 15 and 3, a covering letter, passport, birth certificate, photograph, proof of support or maintenance, and a bank statement.
The Immigration Act directs permit boards to consider qualifications, prospects of employment or sufficient business capital, effects on citizen opportunities and Botswana's interests.
Working for reward or investing for profit requires work authorization; employee filings require a job advertisement, employment contract and offer or appointment letter.
Investor work-permit applicants must document investment, premises, company registration, employees, assets, trade licensing, company profile and bank funds.
A trade licence or business-registration certificate is not a substitute for residence and work authorization.

initial_validity.value: The Immigration Act permits board-issued permits for periods not exceeding five years for employees or ten years for investors; the exact duration is fixed in the issued permit and may be subject to conditions.
initial_validity.notes: The residence-permit service page itself gives a 30-working-day processing estimate but does not publish a universal initial validity period for the generic immigrant category.

extension_rules.value: Renewal is discretionary. Under section 29 of the Immigration Act, a board may renew an employee's permit after five years or an investor's permit after ten years; the prescribed renewal application is lodged with an authorized officer, assessed and sent to the board. The current work-permit service instructs employee and investor applicants to submit renewal six months before expiry, repeat the applicable work-permit requirements, and provide a contract-renewal letter plus copies of both work and residence permits.
extension_rules.notes: The Act requires the prescribed fee after approval and permits an appeal to the Minister if renewal is refused. The statute does not guarantee renewal or publish a separate renewal period for a generic non-working immigrant residence permit.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: A separately approved immigrant or investor residence permit can authorize residence.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The official materials do not confirm that working solely for a foreign client without a substantive Botswana business or other accepted work-permit basis qualifies.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: A non-citizen lawfully resident for at least five years may apply, subject to discretionary character, contribution, standing and sufficient-means criteria. The service page also states that an investor may apply in less than five years, but still requires extensive local investment evidence.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Permanent residence is not automatic. The investor exception does not make ordinary foreign-contract remote work eligible.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalization may be requested after an aggregate ten years of qualifying documented residence, including continuous residence during the twelve months immediately before applying.
path_to_citizenship.notes: The application process requires previous residence permits and indicates renunciation of foreign citizenship after approval.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected for this profile. The framework can serve a genuine Botswana-based investor or operating business, but it does not create an ordinary foreign-contract freelancer category and requires local business substance, licensing and separate work authorization.

rejected_routes.route_name: Study visa and student residence permission

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The study-visa service publishes no numerical monthly threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Proof of sponsorship is required, but no fixed BWP amount is stated.

income_requirement_display.value: No numerical threshold published; proof of sponsorship required
income_requirement_display.notes: This route requires genuine study and is not a qualification-only or remote-work route.

income_proof_months.notes: The study-visa service does not specify a number of income-proof months.

key_requirements.requirement: Acceptance by a Botswana educational institution and the appropriate study or research authorization.
Passport, photographs, covering letter, itinerary or Botswana address, acceptance letter and proof of sponsorship.

initial_validity.value: Study visa up to three months
initial_validity.notes: The underlying course may require separate study or research and residence permissions.

extension_rules.value: The study-visa service describes extension with justification but publishes no maximum extension.
extension_rules.notes: Extension remains tied to genuine study and does not authorize an ordinary remote-work route.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Possible only through separate student permit and residence procedures connected to actual enrolment.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The short study visa does not itself constitute foreign-remote-worker residence.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No direct permanent residence.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: A later applicant must independently satisfy Botswana's permanent-residence rules.

path_to_citizenship.value: Qualifying documented student residence may be relevant to general naturalization, but there is no direct study-to-citizenship entitlement.
path_to_citizenship.notes: The general ten-year documented-residence and other naturalization conditions apply.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because the applicant would need genuine local study; an existing software-engineering degree or foreign contract does not independently qualify the applicant.

summary.value: A foreigner accepted by a Botswana educational institution can independently seek a study visa and required study or research permission, but the visa does not directly grant permanent residence. An existing foreign degree alone creates no independent skilled-residence route in the official materials reviewed.
summary.notes: The treatment of individual study periods for later naturalization should be confirmed before relying on them.

tax_residency_rule.value: Under the Income Tax Act 2026 analysis reviewed, an individual is resident if they have a permanent home in Botswana, are present for at least 183 days in a relevant 12-month period beginning or ending in the tax year, or are a Botswana government employee posted abroad. The tax year runs from 1 July to 30 June.
tax_residency_rule.notes: The new rules took effect on 1 July 2026. Split-year rules may make residence begin on the first day of presence once the applicable test is met.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate, not the expected effective rate. From 1 July 2026 it applies above BWP 400,000 of annual taxable income.

social_contributions_percent.notes: PwC reports no Botswana social-security taxes or contributions. Voluntary pension, insurance and private medical costs are separate.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: No universal monthly social-security or fixed freelancer payment applies. Immigration, licensing and private-insurance costs depend on the legal structure and permit category.

special_tax_regimes.value: The 2026 analysis distinguishes ordinary residents from qualifying temporary residents. A temporary resident who is neither a citizen nor permanent resident, is present solely for employment and has an assignment not exceeding three years may remain taxable only on Botswana-source income. No digital-nomad tax holiday was identified.
special_tax_regimes.notes: Temporary-resident eligibility and income-source characterization require professional review.

taxes.caveats: Botswana has no digital-nomad immigration category. Work physically performed in Botswana may be Botswana-source even when the contract, employer, payment and bank account are foreign. Treaty relief, the short-term employee exemption, residence classification and employee-versus-contractor status can materially change the result.

taxation_system.value: Progressive individual income tax with a 27.5% top marginal rate under the Income Tax Act 2026; taxable income scope depends on residence and qualifying temporary-resident status.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Permanent home, at least 183 days in a relevant 12-month period, or qualifying Botswana government service abroad; tax year 1 July–30 June.
taxation_system.income_scope: The reviewed 2026 analysis describes worldwide income for ordinary residents and Botswana-source income for qualifying temporary residents. Work physically exercised in Botswana can be Botswana-source regardless of foreign payment arrangements.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No digital-nomad regime. Limited temporary-resident treatment and a short-term non-resident employee exemption may apply.
taxation_system.social_security: No social-security tax or contribution is reported for Botswana.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The dashboard number is the 27.5% top marginal rate, not an effective rate. Resident taxable income up to BWP 48,000 is tax free; the reviewed schedules reach 27.5% above BWP 400,000.

tax_brackets.notes: No resident PIT in this band. USD approximation uses approximately USD 0.0757 per BWP from the Bank of Botswana rate previously captured.

tax_brackets.applies_to: Resident individuals; rate applies to excess over BWP 48,000
tax_brackets.notes: USD figure approximates the upper threshold.

taxation_system.notes: The detailed current schedule comes from Botswana tax-advisory analysis because the readable BURS material checked did not expose a post-July 2026 bracket table.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: No dedicated digital-nomad tax category exists. Someone physically working from Botswana must analyze income source, tax residence and any short-term employee exemption under ordinary rules.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: No digital-nomad regime; ordinary employee, independent-business or non-resident rules
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: Progressive PIT up to 27.5%; top marginal screening rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: A permanent home or at least 183 days in a relevant 12-month period can establish residence; qualifying split-year treatment may apply.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: A foreign employer, foreign client or offshore payment does not by itself prevent Botswana taxation when work is physically performed in Botswana. Qualifying temporary residents may exclude foreign-source income, but Botswana-source work remains relevant.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: No digital-nomad holiday identified. Temporary-resident treatment may limit income scope for a qualifying non-citizen, non-permanent-resident employee whose assignment does not exceed three years.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: No Botswana social-security contributions are reported. Taxable employment generally involves PAYE; a locally registered business may have separate income-tax, VAT and licensing obligations.

fixed_payments.status: No universal monthly remote-worker payment applies
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: Social-security contribution rate reported as 0%; PAYE is income tax, not a fixed contribution.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: No nomad fee exists. Published examples include BWP 1,500 for a work permit and renewal and BWP 3,000 for permanent residence; category-specific residence and business fees must be verified before filing.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: No universal fixed freelancer tax was identified. VAT and annual licence or registration payments may apply depending on turnover and activity.
fixed_payments.notes: Business registration and fee payment do not legalize immigration status or ordinary foreign remote work.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: A short-stay non-resident employee may obtain an exemption only if every statutory condition is met, including applicable foreign taxation, payment by a non-resident employer and no cost borne by a Botswana permanent establishment.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: At 183 days or with a permanent home, ordinary residence rules can apply. Botswana-source work may be taxed progressively up to 27.5% even if paid abroad.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: A sole trader or local business must consider individual income tax, business licensing or registration, possible VAT, and separate immigration and work authorization. Registration alone is not a residence or work permit.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: This tax analysis is hypothetical because no lawful ordinary digital-nomad route was found. A Botswana adviser should confirm income source and temporary-resident eligibility.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: A residence permit can be applied for without a stated waiting period, but no qualifying ordinary foreign-remote-work basis or guaranteed issuance was established.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: Five years of continuous lawful residence is the general minimum eligibility period, not a guarantee. Investors may be considered earlier under the service page but require substantive investment evidence.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: This is an inferred minimum if PR were obtained after five years and the applicant later met the ten-year aggregate naturalization rule. Citizenship is not automatically granted five years after PR.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: General naturalization requires an aggregate ten years of documented qualifying residence and continuous residence during the twelve months immediately before applying.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: The government naturalization service gives approximately 18 months.

key_conditions.value: Maintain qualifying residence permits; meet the ten-year aggregate and final continuous twelve-month residence rules; provide police reports, income and purpose-of-stay evidence; attend an interview; and, under the current process, renounce foreign citizenship after approval.
key_conditions.notes: No ordinary remote-worker permit exists from which this timeline can presently begin.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: The published spouse rule requires at least five years of Botswana residence. A declaration of intention may be filed after at least two and a half years of residence; the minister may waive the period in special circumstances.

existing_marriage_effect.value: An existing genuine marriage to a Botswana citizen permits use of spouse residence and naturalization procedures but does not itself confer citizenship. The applicant still needs lawful Botswana residence and must complete the relevant declaration and naturalization processes.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: Applicants should confirm how residence accrued before marriage is counted in their individual case.

requirements_and_risks.value: Applicants provide the Botswana spouse's identity and citizenship evidence, marriage certificate, valid residence permits, support and consent letters, police forms, income evidence and educational documents. Applications are assessed and gazetted; five years does not guarantee approval. False evidence or a sham marriage can lead to refusal and legal consequences.
requirements_and_risks.notes: The current general naturalization process also indicates renunciation of foreign citizenship after approval.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Birth in Botswana alone does not confer citizenship. A Botswana-born child is a citizen when either parent was a Botswana citizen at birth; birth registration is separate from citizenship.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A child born in Botswana to two foreign parents can be registered and receive a birth certificate but does not automatically become a citizen merely by birth.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: Special foundling or anti-statelessness provisions may require separate case-specific analysis.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: If either parent was a Botswana citizen at the child's birth, a Botswana-born child is a citizen by birth. Citizenship by descent also generally follows a Botswana citizen parent for a child born abroad.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: Parentage and civil-registration documents must establish the claim.

parent_benefit_summary.value: Birth of a citizen child does not itself create automatic residence, permanent residence or citizenship for a foreign parent. The parent must qualify through a separate family, immigrant, residence or naturalization procedure.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: Support by a citizen spouse or family member does not remove the separate immigration decision.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: A foreign father receives no automatic status merely because his child is a Botswana citizen. If the mother is a Botswana citizen, the child may be a citizen while the father must independently obtain residence and later meet any PR or naturalization requirements.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: No official automatic parent-of-citizen settlement shortcut was identified.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank displayed on the live Passport Index page when checked; rankings can change.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Passport Index's strict visa-free category.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Passport Index's visa-required category.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: Combined from 29 visa-on-arrival and 7 eTA destinations displayed separately.

passport.notes: The inspected Passport Index page reported mobility score 82, rank 62, 46 visa-free, 29 visa-on-arrival, 7 eTA and 116 visa-required destinations.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: High for administration and professional remote work: English is the official language and is used in government and formal business. Setswana is the national and widely spoken local language.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: Basic Setswana would improve everyday integration.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Low. Neither Russian nor Ukrainian has official status, and the reviewed government language information provides no basis to expect broad day-to-day availability.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: A Russian or Ukrainian speaker should expect to use English for immigration, business and routine services.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate conversion of BWP 6,093 average monthly cash earnings for all wage earners aged 15 and above in Statistics Botswana's Q1 2024 survey, using approximately USD 0.0757 per BWP.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: The Q1 2024 and Q4 2022 official wage tables publish arithmetic averages, not a national median. The newer 2024/25 preliminary labour brief publishes headline employment and unemployment indicators but no earnings distribution.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Botswana uses sector- or occupation-specific hourly minimum wages. A monthly figure was not calculated because coverage and working hours vary.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate conversion of BWP 6,035 average monthly cash earnings reported for citizen wage earners in Q1 2024.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No citizen median earnings statistic is published in the reviewed official wage tables or the newer preliminary labour-market brief.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Statistics Botswana's reviewed releases publish average earnings by occupation, citizenship, sex and industry but no observed national maximum, upper percentile or top-of-range citizen salary.

min_salary_local_currency.value: BWP 9.06 per hour for security guards and cleaners under Statutory Instrument No. 7 of 2024
min_salary_local_currency.notes: This is a documented occupation-specific statutory minimum, not a universal monthly wage.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: Average monthly cash earnings of citizen wage earners aged 15 and above, Q1 2024.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: Statistics Botswana's Q1 2024 and Q4 2022 earnings tables report means by occupation, citizenship, sex and industry, not medians. The March 2026 preliminary 2024/25 labour brief contains employment and unemployment indicators only and states that fuller analysis is forthcoming; consequently, no current official citizen median earnings amount can be supplied.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: The reviewed official releases provide averages for groups but no individual maximum, national salary ceiling, upper percentile or maximum citizen earnings statistic. High occupational or industry means are not maximum salaries, so none has been repurposed as a national maximum.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Average monthly cash earnings of citizen wage earners aged 15 and above; minimum field is a separate occupation-specific statutory hourly wage
average_citizen_salary.period: Q1 2024 earnings survey; newer 2024/25 preliminary labour brief checked but it contains no earnings distribution
average_citizen_salary.notes: The BWP 6,035 figure is an official mean, not an immigration income requirement. Focused review of the current Statistics Botswana labour catalogue, the March 2026 preliminary brief and older formal-sector reports found no published citizen median or national maximum.

cost_of_living_note.value: Statistics Botswana's July 2026 CPI reported 9.4% annual inflation nationally, including 9.0% in cities and towns, 9.4% in urban villages and 10.1% in rural villages. Food and non-alcoholic beverage prices were 6.6% higher than in July 2025, while the overall CPI was 48.8% above its December 2018 base. These figures show substantial current price pressure but are price-change indices, not a monthly living-cost estimate for a single remote worker.
cost_of_living_note.notes: The focused audit found current official CPI data but no current official single-person or remote-worker monthly budget. The 2015/16 household survey publishes historical household income, expenditure and poverty-basket methodology, and the 2024 SWIFT release estimates poverty using that older expenditure baseline rather than publishing a current comparable monthly cost basket. Accordingly, the note reports current inflation and clearly avoids presenting an outdated household amount as a 2026 living-cost budget.
