settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: No digital-nomad or remote-worker status exists; visitor entry cannot be treated as a settlement route.
settlement_track.summary: Eritrea is not valid for this profile because published work residence requires an Eritrean sponsoring entity and government work authorization. Although the nationality law describes general naturalization after 20 years of domicile, no ordinary foreign-contract remote-work status or confirmed route into qualifying domicile was identified.
settlement_track.notes: The renewable one-year employer-linked residence permit should not be interpreted as independent remote-worker eligibility or a confirmed permanent-residence track.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: Foreign-client income does not replace the required Eritrean sponsor, employing company, Labour Office authorization, or government work approval. The inspected rules provide no independent freelancer legalization procedure.

data.notes: The negative route conclusion is supported by multiple Eritrean diplomatic missions and immigration/work-permit legislation. Confidence is medium because Eritrea lacks a comprehensive current immigration or tax portal, much of the governing legislation is old, and current permanent-residence, tax-residence, wage, fee, and processing guidance is not publicly consolidated.

data.selection_summary: Eswatini has no dedicated digital-nomad or ordinary foreign-contract remote-worker status. The independent Class I permit requires assured income but expressly prohibits paid employment; Classes D/F/H require a locally beneficial, capitalized and licensed business or prescribed professional practice; Class A requires a specific employer. Visitor/eVisa status does not authorize work. No qualifying route for this profile or confirmed conversion from such a status to permanent residence was found.

visa_application.title: Eswatini eVisa Portal — Login
visa_application.notes: This is the official direct eVisa portal, but it serves visitor categories and is not an application channel for an ordinary foreign-contract remote-work residence permit. Entry-permit applications use Form 3 submitted to the Chief Immigration Officer; no online residence-permit application was found.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No reliable current USD threshold is supplied. The nominal amounts in the 1987 regulations may be administratively outdated and must be confirmed with Immigration.

minimum_income_local_currency.value: SZL 5,000 assured annual income without dependants; SZL 7,000 with dependants
minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Equivalent to SZL 416.67 or SZL 583.33 monthly. These nominal figures come from the 1987 regulations and may no longer reflect administrative practice.

income_requirement_display.value: SZL 5,000/year without dependants; SZL 7,000/year with dependants — confirm current threshold with Immigration
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: SZL 416.67/month without dependants or SZL 583.33/month with dependants
income_requirement_display.notes: Foreign-source assured income is contemplated, but the Act requires the holder to undertake not to accept paid employment of any kind. Active foreign employment or client work therefore does not fit.

income_proof_months.notes: The regulations require assured annual income but do not prescribe a bank-statement history period.

key_requirements.requirement: Applicant must be at least 21 and have the prescribed assured income at their free disposal.
The holder must undertake not to accept paid employment of any kind, and their presence must benefit Eswatini.
Application is made to the Chief Immigration Officer using Form 3.

initial_validity.value: Discretionary; an issue period may not exceed five years.
initial_validity.notes: No standard initial term is promised.

extension_rules.value: Renewal is discretionary and an individual renewal may not exceed five years; the assured-income condition must continue to be met.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: An approved permit authorizes temporary residence subject to its conditions.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: It does not authorize the applicant's paid remote work.

path_to_permanent_residence.notes: IOM reports that Eswatini permits are temporary and that there is no permanent-residence pathway. No newer official conversion rule was found.

path_to_citizenship.value: General citizenship registration may be available after qualifying lawful ordinary residence, but no source confirms Class I as a dependable settlement route for a paid remote worker.
path_to_citizenship.notes: The route is incompatible with the proposed work before citizenship eligibility becomes relevant.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because paid employment is expressly prohibited. It may suit a non-working person supported by pension, investment or other assured income, but not a software engineer continuing an active foreign contract.

rejected_routes.route_name: Classes D/F/H business or independent-profession entry permits

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No fixed income threshold was found; the law instead requires sufficient capital and resources.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No numeric capital threshold is stated in the reviewed Act.

income_requirement_display.value: No published fixed income threshold; sufficient capital/resources and benefit to Eswatini are required
income_requirement_display.notes: These are local business or prescribed-profession categories, not ordinary foreign-client remote-work permits.

income_proof_months.notes: Business documentation includes financial evidence, but no fixed bank-history period was published.

key_requirements.requirement: Classes D and F require sufficient capital/resources, necessary land interests, licensing or registration, and a business beneficial to Eswatini.
Class H is limited to prescribed professions and qualifications; ordinary software engineering based only on a university degree is not expressly listed.
The published business-person checklist requires Form 3, incorporation documents, lease, police clearance, medical certificate and passport.
Foreign business licensing requires residence status and local-substance documents, including incorporation and premises evidence.

initial_validity.value: Discretionary; an issue period may not exceed five years.
initial_validity.notes: No guaranteed standard term is published.

extension_rules.value: Renewal is discretionary and each renewal may not exceed five years.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: An approved entry permit gives temporary residence tied to the approved local business or professional activity.

path_to_permanent_residence.notes: No permanent-residence conversion was confirmed.

path_to_citizenship.value: General residence-based citizenship registration is legally possible, but these categories are not established by the current sources ordinary remote-worker pathways.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because these categories require a genuine locally licensed business or prescribed professional practice, sufficient capital/resources and local benefit. They do not fit work performed solely for a foreign employer or client without local business substance.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No statutory permit salary threshold was found.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No numeric permit salary threshold was found.

income_requirement_display.value: No published salary threshold; a specific job and employer are mandatory
income_requirement_display.notes: This is an employer-specific permit.

income_proof_months.notes: The published checklist does not prescribe an income-history period.

key_requirements.requirement: Specific employment offered by a specific employer, with the employment beneficial to Eswatini.
Employer covering letter, proof the position was advertised, qualifications, police clearance, medical certificate and employer incorporation records.

initial_validity.value: Discretionary; an issue period may not exceed five years.

extension_rules.value: Renewal is discretionary and remains tied to the specific employment.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Temporary residence is possible while the approved employment continues and permit conditions are met.

path_to_permanent_residence.notes: No permanent-residence pathway was confirmed.

path_to_citizenship.value: General citizenship registration is separate and residence-based.
path_to_citizenship.notes: This employer-sponsored route is outside the target selection.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because it requires a specific employer, job offer and employer-linked application, including proof of advertising.

rejected_routes.route_name: Visitor visa, eVisa or visitor's pass

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: Proof of sufficient means is required, but no numeric threshold is published.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No numeric subsistence threshold is published.

income_requirement_display.value: Sufficient means required; no fixed amount published
income_requirement_display.notes: Visitor entry is not residence authorization for remote employment.

income_proof_months.notes: No bank-statement history period is stated.

key_requirements.requirement: Passport, purpose and duration evidence, photographs, sufficient funds or host undertaking, and onward-travel evidence.
The official page describes visitor categories, not immigration authorization.
Unauthorized employment, occupation, trade, business or professional activity by a non-citizen is an offence.

initial_validity.value: A visa is generally issued for no more than one month; a visitor's pass may be issued for up to six months.
initial_validity.notes: Visa validity and authorized stay are not interchangeable.

extension_rules.value: A visitor's pass may be extended, but aggregate validity cannot exceed one year from entry.
extension_rules.notes: Extension does not convert visitor status into a remote-work residence permit.

path_to_temporary_residence.notes: A separate permit is required for work, study or immigration.

path_to_permanent_residence.notes: No visitor-to-permanent-residence pathway was found.

path_to_citizenship.notes: Visitor presence was not established as qualifying ordinary lawful residence for citizenship.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because visitor status is temporary, does not authorize ordinary remote work and provides no confirmed settlement path.

summary.value: A foreigner accepted by an Eswatini educational or training establishment may independently apply for a student pass. It lasts only for the specified study period, expires when studies cease, does not directly provide permanent residence and is not a degree-based skilled-migration route.
summary.notes: Acceptance by a local institution is required; possession of an existing foreign university degree alone creates no residence entitlement.

tax_residency_rule.value: The reviewed professional summary does not provide a general day-count definition. A person in employment or business in Eswatini is effectively treated as resident; permitted expatriate employees and self-employed persons are deemed resident.
tax_residency_rule.notes: This is activity-based rather than a simple published 183-day test.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate, not an expected effective rate.

social_contributions_percent.notes: The 5% figure is the employee half of ENPF statutory contributions, not a universal social-security rate. For 2026, ENPF caps contributable wages at SZL 4,300 and the combined monthly contribution at SZL 430, split SZL 215 employee/SZL 215 employer. ENPF states that eligibility is for regularly employed Swazi citizens working for registered employers and that non-citizens are prohibited from membership, subject to its listed exceptions and international conventions. This does not establish a mandatory contribution for a foreign-contract remote worker or self-employed foreigner; that scenario also has no confirmed lawful immigration route.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: There is no mandatory USD-denominated monthly payment for a nonexistent remote-worker route. Employed persons have SZL 1.50 monthly poll tax; eligible ENPF-covered employees may also have capped deductions.

special_tax_regimes.value: No digital-nomad, remote-worker or special inbound personal-tax regime was found. Eswatini generally taxes income sourced or deemed sourced in Eswatini.
special_tax_regimes.notes: PwC reports no general foreign-tax-credit regime.

taxes.caveats: Services performed physically in Eswatini may be treated as Eswatini-source even when the payer is abroad. Liability depends on lawful immigration status, actual work location, contract structure, registration and treaty position. Immigration authorization and tax liability are separate questions.

taxation_system.value: Progressive source-based personal income tax with marginal rates from 20% to 33%.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Employment or business in Eswatini effectively creates residence under the reviewed professional summary; no general day-count definition is stated.
taxation_system.income_scope: Income derived or deemed derived from an Eswatini source, irrespective of residence. Services performed while carrying on activity in Eswatini may be local-source even when paid abroad.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No special digital-nomad or remote-worker regime found; no general foreign-tax-credit regime is reported.
taxation_system.social_security: PwC reports no general social-security contribution and an annual SZL 18 poll tax for employed persons. Separately, ENPF applies to eligible covered employment; the 2026 contribution is capped at SZL 215 each per month for employee and employer. ENPF states that non-citizens are prohibited from membership, subject to listed exceptions.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The 33% dashboard figure is the top marginal screening rate, not an expected effective rate. The annual rebate means PwC reports no tax below annual taxable salary of SZL 41,000.

tax_brackets.notes: An annual rebate of SZL 8,200 applies for most taxpayers.
Top marginal screening bracket.

taxation_system.notes: Tax guidance is secondary professional material except for ENPF information. Filing treatment should be confirmed with Eswatini Revenue Service before commencing activity.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: No digital-nomad tax category exists. A hypothetical person lawfully performing services from Eswatini would be screened under ordinary source-based personal income-tax rules, up to the 33% top marginal rate.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: No dedicated route; ordinary individual or business taxation would apply if the activity were otherwise lawful.
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: 20%–33% progressive PIT; 33% is the top marginal screening rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: Employment or business activity in Eswatini can create or deem residence; no general 183-day rule was identified.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Income for services physically performed or activity carried on in Eswatini may be Eswatini-source even if paid by a foreign client or employer.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None found.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: No remote-worker payroll regime exists. ENPF covers eligible local employment and does not establish a foreign self-employed contribution. Employer payroll obligations would depend on a lawful local employment structure.

fixed_payments.status: No remote-worker-specific fixed monthly payment was identified.
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: Eligible ENPF-covered employment has a 5% employee and 5% employer contribution on capped wages; ENPF states that non-citizens are prohibited from membership, subject to listed exceptions. Applicability to any unusual foreign-worker structure requires ENPF confirmation.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: Permit and visa fees exist, but there is no remote-worker permit fee because no such route exists.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: Employed persons have an annual SZL 18 poll tax. No fixed freelancer tax was identified.
fixed_payments.notes: Business licensing, incorporation, VAT or municipal costs may arise only if a genuine local business is established; no universal remote-worker monthly amount was published.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: No reliable day-count safe harbour was found. Short visitor presence does not authorize work, so tax analysis cannot make the immigration activity lawful.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: Ordinary progressive PIT and source rules would need review, but no immigration status authorizes the target foreign-contract activity.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: A genuine locally licensed business may incur ordinary income tax, licensing and registration obligations. It is not an ordinary digital-nomad route and approval is discretionary.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: This tax treatment is hypothetical for the target profile because no lawful ordinary foreign-contract remote-work immigration route was confirmed.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: No qualifying target route exists. Other entry permits are issued directly but are temporary and purpose-specific.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: IOM reports that permits are temporary and that no path to permanent residence exists; no newer official conversion rule was found.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: The Constitution uses lawful ordinary residence, not a defined number of years after permanent residence.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: General minimum: at least five aggregate years of lawful ordinary residence during the preceding seven years, including the continuous 12 months immediately before application. This is not a timeline from an eligible remote-worker route and approval remains discretionary.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: The official service page says the Citizenship Board determines the processing period for each application; it publishes no typical number of months.

key_conditions.value: Lawful ordinary residence; continuous final 12 months and five aggregate years in the preceding seven; good character; adequate siSwati or English; intention to reside; adequate support; contribution to development; oath or affirmation. A separate ten-year residence option requires specified community support. Renunciation may be required by the Board.
key_conditions.notes: No general absence allowance beyond the constitutional residence formula was found.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: A foreign woman marrying an Eswatini citizen may acquire citizenship by lodging the prescribed declaration; the Constitution states no minimum marriage duration. This gender-specific rule does not provide the same route to a foreign husband.

existing_marriage_effect.value: The constitutional provision applies to marriages before or after commencement of the Constitution. A qualifying foreign wife may lodge the declaration before or during marriage, with effect as specified by the constitutional rule.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: The official checklist requires the husband's citizenship evidence and the marriage certificate.

requirements_and_risks.value: The official C2 process is for women married to an Eswatini citizen by birth and requires the declaration/application, fingerprints, husband's covering letter and citizenship evidence, marriage certificate, photographs, identity numbers and fees. No equivalent accelerated rule was found for a foreign husband. The marriage and documents must be genuine; no fixed processing period is published.
requirements_and_risks.notes: Administrative eligibility should be confirmed with Home Affairs.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Birth in Eswatini alone is insufficient. The Constitution generally requires an Eswatini-citizen father, includes a qualified rule through a citizen mother for a child born outside marriage who is not adopted or claimed by the father, and contains a foundling exception.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A child born in Eswatini to two known foreign migrant parents does not ordinarily acquire citizenship merely by birth. A deserted child aged no more than seven found in Eswatini is presumed a citizen unless contrary facts are proved.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: No broad jus-soli or general permanent-resident-parent rule was identified.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: If the citizen parent is the father, the child is a citizen by birth. Citizenship through a citizen mother is more fact-dependent under the reviewed constitutional wording, including rules for birth outside marriage where the father has not adopted or claimed the child.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: This is not an unconditional one-citizen-parent rule.

parent_benefit_summary.value: A citizen child does not automatically confer citizenship or permanent residence on a foreign parent. Any family residence benefit requires a separate permit or citizenship process.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: No automatic parent-of-citizen residence category was found.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: No automatic residence, permanent residence or citizenship benefit was confirmed for a migrant father merely because his child is an Eswatini citizen.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: The father would need an independent lawful status unless Home Affairs confirms a discretionary family category.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank displayed by the live 2026 index when reviewed.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Visa-free destinations are separated from visa-on-arrival and eTA destinations.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: 31 visa-on-arrival plus 7 eTA destinations.

passport.notes: The index reports a mobility score of 79. Index methodologies differ, so these figures should not be combined with Henley totals.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: English is an official language and is usable for legislation, government services, business paperwork and professional communication. This supports day-to-day practicality, although it does not establish the quality of nationwide remote-work infrastructure.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: The language conclusion is official; no current nationwide broadband-quality measure was established in this pass.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Low for official administration: neither Russian nor Ukrainian is an official language. English would normally be required.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: This is an inference from the official-language framework, not a measured prevalence statistic.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: No defensible current USD national mean was assigned. ILOSTAT has an Eswatini average-monthly-earnings series through 2023, but the exact Eswatini observation and its same-series USD value were not exposed in the accessible table captured in this pass. The official 2023 key-findings booklet and June 2026 public release on the 2025 LFS do not print a national mean earnings figure.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: The 2023 employee median is published as SZL 3,000 per month. No matched nominal USD observation was captured, and converting a 2023 statistic at the 2026-08-15 spot rate would be misleading.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No common USD amount applies because Eswatini uses sector- and occupation-specific statutory minimum wages rather than one national monthly minimum.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: A current national mean could not be stated in USD from the reviewed sources. The ILOSTAT-derived dataset confirms Eswatini observations through 2023, but its accessible card did not expose the exact Eswatini row. The official 2023 and 2025 LFS materials reviewed report labour-market indicators without a national mean earnings amount. Older 2016 figures and sector-specific 2021 skills-audit medians were not substituted.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: ILOSTAT's harmonized 2023 LFS series reports the employee median in local currency as SZL 3,000 per month. No matched nominal USD observation was captured, and a current spot-rate conversion would not represent 2023 exchange conditions.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No meaningful national maximum salary is defined or published. Sector medians and statutory minima are not national maxima.

min_salary_local_currency.value: SZL 1,453.21 per month for several domestic-worker categories in the 2024 wage order; other sectors and occupations have different minima
min_salary_local_currency.notes: This is a statutory sectoral minimum, not an observed minimum, national minimum or average salary.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: The reviewed sources establish that Eswatini collects average earnings and that ILOSTAT carries an average-monthly-earnings series through 2023, but the exact all-employee 2023 mean was not visible in the accessible current table. The official 2023 key-findings booklet and public June 2026 summary of the 2025 LFS do not publish that national mean, so no amount is assigned.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: ILOSTAT's harmonized microdata-processing series identifies this as the 2023 median monthly earnings of all employees, both sexes, from Eswatini's Labour Force Survey. It is an employee-earnings statistic, not a citizen-only wage and not an immigration income threshold.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: No national maximum monthly salary is defined or published in the reviewed LFS or ILOSTAT earnings tables. The wage orders set sectoral minima, while the National Skills Audit publishes sector-level entry and experienced medians, not maxima. Individual earnings are open-ended and an observed sample maximum would be unstable, so no maximum is reported.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: 2023 LFS median monthly earnings of employees; official 2024 sectoral statutory minimum; national mean and maximum not assigned
average_citizen_salary.period: 2023 employee median; 2024 sectoral minimum; 2025 LFS public release checked
average_citizen_salary.notes: The national employee median is SZL 3,000 per month for 2023. It is not restricted to citizens and is not an immigration income threshold. Eswatini has sector- and occupation-specific statutory minima rather than one national minimum. No exact current national mean or meaningful national maximum was assigned because the current materials checked do not print those amounts and older or sector-specific figures are not comparable substitutes.

cost_of_living_note.notes: No sufficiently reliable current national cost-of-living measure was established from the reviewed official labour sources.

settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: Visitor/eVisa status is temporary and does not authorize remote employment. Class I permits foreign assured income but expressly prohibits paid employment.
settlement_track.summary: No current status fits ordinary paid work for a foreign employer or client. Independent permits either prohibit employment or require a locally beneficial, capitalized and licensed business or prescribed professional practice, and no permanent-residence conversion is confirmed.
settlement_track.notes: General citizenship registration after qualifying lawful residence exists, but it does not cure the absence of a lawful entry route for the target activity.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: The foreign contract conflicts with Class I's prohibition on paid employment; business/profession permits require local substance and benefit; employment permits require a specific employer.

data.notes: The ineligibility conclusion remains supported by current official immigration pages, the governing Act and regulations. This focused pass inspected more than 15 directly relevant URLs, including more than five URLs absent from the previous source set. It resolves the 2023 employee median at SZL 3,000 and precisely explains why the national mean, USD equivalents and national maximum remain null rather than guessed.

data.selection_summary: Ethiopia is not a match for ordinary foreign-contract remote work. The current Immigration and Citizenship Service catalogue and application portal show business, employment, student, marriage, shareholder and investor statuses, but no digital-nomad, foreign-remote-worker or independently usable low-capital freelance residence category. A foreigner can establish a sole proprietorship only through the foreign-investment framework, which generally requires an investment visa, investment permit and USD 200,000 minimum capital; tax or business registration alone does not create residence rights.

visa_application.title: Immigration and Citizenship Service application portal
visa_application.notes: This is the official general visa and work-permit portal. It does not display a dedicated digital-nomad or foreign-remote-worker category. A login is required after starting an application.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The official route page publishes no minimum income threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The official route page publishes no ETB income threshold.

income_requirement_display.value: No published income threshold; Ethiopian invitation required
income_requirement_display.notes: Eligibility depends on an invitation from an Ethiopian business partner or organization and qualifying business-visit activity, not recurring foreign remote-work income.

income_proof_months.notes: The official route page does not specify an income-proof period.

key_requirements.requirement: Passport valid for at least six months, application form and photographs.
Invitation letter from a business partner or organization in Ethiopia.
Evidence of meetings, conference participation, contract negotiations or another qualifying business visit.

initial_validity.value: Limited business visit; the current route page does not state a single fixed validity period
initial_validity.notes: ICS describes it as limited-period entry for meetings, conferences or negotiations.

extension_rules.notes: The page does not publish a route-specific extension or residence-conversion rule.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: No automatic path; a separate qualifying local employment, investment, study, marriage or other residence basis is required.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: An ordinary foreign-client contract is not listed as a temporary-residence basis.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No business-visa-to-permanent-residence path was confirmed.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The separate permanent-residence service asks for qualifying employer-company documentation.

path_to_citizenship.value: The business visa itself does not provide a citizenship path.
path_to_citizenship.notes: General naturalization requires Ethiopian domicile and qualifying residence; a short business visit does not establish that route.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because it is limited business-entry status, not authorization to reside in Ethiopia while performing ordinary foreign-client remote work.

rejected_routes.route_name: Temporary ID / temporary residence for employees, shareholders, students or journalists

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The official page publishes no minimum income amount.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The official page publishes no ETB income threshold.

income_requirement_display.value: No published income threshold; qualifying Ethiopian sponsor or special status required
income_requirement_display.notes: Eligibility depends on local employment, qualifying Ethiopian investment/shareholding, enrollment or journalism authorization rather than foreign remote income.

income_proof_months.notes: The official page does not state an income-proof period.

key_requirements.requirement: Employer-company letter and the company's valid trade certificate for an employee.
Investment Commission documentation for a shareholder or investor.
Ministry of Education documentation for a student or the relevant authorization for a journalist.
Passport, valid visa and entry stamp.

initial_validity.value: Limited temporary residence; the current page does not publish the exact card term

extension_rules.value: A separate residence-permit renewal service exists, subject to continued qualification and current supporting documents.
extension_rules.notes: The official pages do not publish a universal renewal term or complete absence rules.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Direct temporary status is available only after establishing one of the listed local or special bases.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: A foreign software-services contract alone is not one of the listed bases.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: A separate permanent-residence application exists, but the published service requirements include employer-company documentation.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: No automatic time-based conversion rule was found.

path_to_citizenship.value: Potentially only through general naturalization after Ethiopian domicile and at least four years of qualifying residence, subject to all statutory conditions.
path_to_citizenship.notes: The law and service pages do not expressly confirm that every temporary-ID category counts.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because the published qualifying bases require a local employer or another special local status. The applicant's ordinary foreign contract is insufficient.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: There is no monthly-income test. Eligibility instead requires qualifying investment capital.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The investment requirement is denominated in USD rather than monthly ETB income.

income_requirement_display.value: Generally USD 200,000 minimum investment capital
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: USD 200,000 per wholly foreign-owned investment project; reduced statutory amounts apply only to specified sectors or joint ventures
income_requirement_display.notes: This is capital committed to a qualifying Ethiopian investment, not remote-work income. The statute lists USD 100,000 for specified architectural, engineering, related technical consultancy, testing/analysis or publishing activities and USD 150,000 for a general joint venture with a domestic investor.

income_proof_months.notes: No monthly income-history period applies; investment-capital and bank evidence are required instead.

key_requirements.requirement: Valid passport and investment visa.
Investment permit and the applicable statutory minimum capital, generally USD 200,000 for a wholly foreign-owned project.
Business background or bank statement and registration of imported investment capital.
Commercial registration, TIN and business licence before operating the local business.

initial_validity.value: Investment-based residence is available after obtaining the qualifying investment permit; a universal residence-card term was not established from the inspected investment pages
initial_validity.notes: The EIC guide states that ICS issues residence permits to foreign investors upon submission of an investment permit.

extension_rules.value: Investment and business licences require continued compliance and renewal; the EIC materials state that investment licences are renewed annually.
extension_rules.notes: The residence-card renewal term and absence rules require confirmation with ICS.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: A qualifying foreign investor can obtain investor/shareholder residence after receiving an investment permit.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: This is an investment route, not a low-capital freelancer-registration route.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No automatic time-based investor-to-permanent-residence conversion was confirmed in the inspected current pages.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Filing-level confirmation is required because the public permanent-residence page emphasizes employer-company documentation.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalization may potentially apply after Ethiopian domicile and at least four years of qualifying residence plus all other statutory conditions.
path_to_citizenship.notes: No investment-specific automatic citizenship entitlement exists in the sources inspected.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because the route requires a genuine capitalized Ethiopian investment and investment visa. It is not compatible with the stated ordinary foreign-contract remote-work profile, and merely obtaining a TIN or commercial registration does not create immigration status.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The official service page publishes no income threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The official service page publishes no ETB income threshold.

income_requirement_display.value: No published income threshold; employer-company documentation required
income_requirement_display.notes: The public service requirements focus on a qualifying local employer company and its trade certificate.

income_proof_months.notes: The official page does not state an income-proof period.

key_requirements.requirement: Letter to ICS from an employer company holding a valid trade certificate.
Employer company's trade certificate.
Passport copy, valid visa and entry stamp.

initial_validity.value: Five years
initial_validity.notes: The official page describes a five-year Permanent Residence ID.

extension_rules.value: Renewable after expiration
extension_rules.notes: Detailed renewal and absence conditions are not published on the page.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Not applicable; the service is described as permanent residence.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Direct five-year renewable Permanent Residence ID, but only with the published qualifying documentation.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The page does not establish an independently accessible route for an ordinary foreign-client remote worker.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalization may be possible after at least four years of Ethiopian domicile and residence plus language, income, character, criminal-record, prior-nationality and oath conditions.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Residence does not create an automatic citizenship entitlement.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because the public application requirements include a qualifying employer-company letter and Ethiopian trade certificate.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: Sufficient means are required, but the official page publishes no numeric threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The official page publishes no ETB threshold.

income_requirement_display.value: Sufficient financial means; amount not published
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: Proof of sufficient means for the study period
income_requirement_display.notes: The official page gives no formula or minimum balance.

income_proof_months.notes: The official page does not state a proof period.

key_requirements.requirement: Acceptance by an accredited Ethiopian educational institution.
Proof of tuition payment or scholarship and sufficient financial means.
Passport, application form, photographs and fee.

initial_validity.value: Duration of studies
initial_validity.notes: The page does not state a fixed card term.

extension_rules.notes: A general renewal service exists, but student-specific renewal and post-study conversion rules are not published.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Residence for study is possible after admission to an accredited Ethiopian institution.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No student-to-permanent-residence conversion was confirmed.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The public permanent-residence requirements instead request employer-company documentation.

path_to_citizenship.value: No education-specific citizenship route was confirmed; only the general naturalization framework could potentially apply.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Whether study residence satisfies the statutory domicile requirement needs filing-level verification.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because genuine enrollment is mandatory and it is not a degree-holder or foreign-remote-worker route.

summary.value: A student visa is available without a local employer, but it requires admission to an accredited Ethiopian institution, tuition or scholarship evidence and sufficient means. No independent residence route based merely on already holding a software-engineering degree, or confirmed student-to-permanent-residence conversion, appears in the current official catalogue.
summary.notes: This is an enrollment-based alternative, not a route for continuing ordinary foreign-client remote work.

tax_residency_rule.value: An individual is Ethiopian tax-resident if domiciled in Ethiopia, habitually resident there, or present for more than 183 days in any 12-month period, continuously or intermittently.
tax_residency_rule.notes: Partial arrival and departure days generally count; days present solely in transit do not.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate, not the expected effective rate. The amended monthly employment brackets start at 0% and rise to 35% above ETB 14,000.

social_contributions_percent.notes: For the target foreign applicant, PwC reports that foreign citizens without Ethiopian origin cannot contribute to the private-organization pension fund. The otherwise published employee and employer rates are 7% and 11%, respectively.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: No standard mandatory monthly payment applies to a digital nomad or ordinary foreign freelancer because no such immigration or low-capital self-employment category exists. Investor, licence and registration charges are transactional and project-specific rather than a fixed monthly nomad payment.

special_tax_regimes.value: No special digital-nomad, ordinary foreign-remote-worker, non-dom or remittance-basis regime was identified. Residents are taxed on worldwide income; non-residents are taxed on Ethiopian-source income.
special_tax_regimes.notes: Rules addressing digital services do not constitute a personal digital-nomad concession.

taxes.caveats: Tax treatment depends on whether the relationship is employment or independent business, where services are physically performed, tax residence, permanent-establishment issues, foreign tax credits and any applicable treaty. Immigration permission and tax liability are separate: tax, TIN or commercial registration does not legalize remote work or establish residence.

taxation_system.value: Progressive personal income taxation. Residents are taxed on worldwide income and non-residents on Ethiopian-source income. Employment exercised in Ethiopia can be Ethiopian-source regardless of where payment originates.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Domicile, habitual abode, or more than 183 days in any 12-month period.
taxation_system.income_scope: Worldwide income for residents; Ethiopian-source income for non-residents.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No digital-nomad or ordinary foreign-remote-worker concession was identified.
taxation_system.social_security: Foreign citizens without Ethiopian origin are reported as ineligible for the private-organization pension fund. For covered participants, the published employee contribution is 7% and the employer contribution is 11%.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The displayed 35% is the top marginal screening rate. Current monthly employment brackets are 0% through ETB 2,000, followed by 15%, 20%, 25%, 30% and 35%. Individual business-income treatment requires separate classification and filing advice.

tax_brackets.notes: A date-matched official exchange rate was not captured, so potentially misleading USD thresholds are omitted.
Top marginal bracket, not an effective-rate estimate.

taxation_system.notes: The official Ministry of Justice amendment index and regulation were checked alongside the current professional summaries. Contract classification, deductions, withholding, business-income schedules and the effective date of particular amended provisions should be confirmed before filing.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: There is no dedicated digital-nomad tax regime because Ethiopia has no confirmed digital-nomad or ordinary foreign-remote-worker residence status. Work physically performed in Ethiopia may nevertheless create Ethiopian-source or residence-based tax exposure.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: No digital-nomad category; potentially employment or individual business income under ordinary rules
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: Up to 35% progressive PIT; top marginal screening rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: Domicile, habitual abode, or more than 183 days in any 12-month period.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Residents are taxed on worldwide income. Non-residents are taxed on Ethiopian-source income; employment exercised in Ethiopia may be Ethiopian-source regardless of where payment originates.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None identified.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: A foreign citizen without Ethiopian origin is reported as unable to participate in the private-organization pension fund. Local employment or another contractual structure would require separate payroll and withholding analysis.

fixed_payments.status: No route-specific fixed monthly payment applies
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: No pension contribution for a foreign citizen without Ethiopian origin under the cited summary; otherwise covered employee and employer rates are 7% and 11%.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: Visa, residence, investment, commercial-registration and licensing fees exist, but there is no nomad fee or standard monthly freelancer-residence charge.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: Commercial registration, TIN and business licensing are required for a locally established business. VAT or other business-tax obligations depend on activity, turnover and taxpayer classification; the inspected sources do not publish a universal monthly freelancer amount.
fixed_payments.notes: There is no lawful ordinary nomad route against which a standardized tax-and-fee package can be calculated.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: Remaining below 183 days does not guarantee zero Ethiopian tax because services physically performed in Ethiopia may be Ethiopian-source. Visitor or business immigration status also does not become work authorization.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: Potential worldwide-income taxation at progressive rates up to 35%, subject to income classification, deductions, foreign-tax credits and treaties; a qualifying immigration status must separately be established.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: A foreign national may use a sole proprietorship as the legal form for a genuine Ethiopian investment, but this is not an ordinary freelancer-registration shortcut. The foreign-investment framework generally requires a valid investment visa, investment permit and USD 200,000 capital for a wholly foreign-owned project, with lower statutory amounts limited to specified sectors or joint ventures. Operating locally also entails commercial registration, an individual-business TIN and a business licence. These registrations can trigger ordinary business-income, VAT and filing obligations, but none independently grants residence or authorizes remote work under visitor status.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: This is a screening summary, not a filing position. The focused review established that local sole-proprietor registration is possible only within the capitalized foreign-investment framework, not as an immigration route for an ordinary foreign-client freelancer.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: No qualifying ordinary foreign-remote-worker route exists, so a route-specific time to temporary residence cannot be calculated. Investor residence is a materially different capital-based route.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: The inspected current pages publish no universal time-based temporary-to-permanent conversion rule.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: Nationality law uses Ethiopian domicile and at least four years of preceding residence rather than a separately stated number of years after permanent residence.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: The general statutory minimum is four years of domicile and residence before application, but this profile lacks an eligible initial residence route; a credible route-specific total therefore cannot be stated.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: The inspected current official materials do not publish a typical naturalization processing time. Generic ICS service-time statements should not be assumed to cover nationality decisions.

key_conditions.value: General naturalization requires majority and legal capacity, Ethiopian domicile and at least four years of residence, ability to communicate in a language of an Ethiopian nation or nationality, sufficient lawful income, good character, no disqualifying criminal conviction, release or possible release from prior nationality or statelessness, and an oath of allegiance.
key_conditions.notes: The law does not establish that tourist or business stays satisfy domicile and qualifying residence.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: Nationality by marriage requires at least two years since marriage and at least one year living in Ethiopia immediately before application. The numeric value records the longer marriage period.

existing_marriage_effect.value: An existing genuine marriage to an Ethiopian citizen can support a renewable temporary residence permit and, after the statutory periods, an application for nationality. Marriage to another migrant has no equivalent effect.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: The residence application requires the Ethiopian spouse's letter and identity evidence.

requirements_and_risks.value: The marriage must be legally valid; foreign civil-status documents may require authentication and translation. Temporary residence also requires entry records, the Ethiopian spouse's identity evidence and published financial documentation. Nationality still requires legal capacity, prior-nationality release or possible release and the oath. Authorities may seek further proof of a genuine marriage; fraudulent marriage can lead to refusal and legal consequences.
requirements_and_risks.notes: The public pages do not describe every interview, cohabitation or fraud-check procedure.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Birth in Ethiopia alone does not confer nationality. A child acquires nationality when either parent is Ethiopian. An abandoned infant found in Ethiopia is presumed to have an Ethiopian parent unless foreign nationality is proved.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: No automatic Ethiopian nationality follows merely from birth in Ethiopia when neither parent is Ethiopian. The abandoned-infant presumption is a narrow exception, not general jus soli.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: The law contains no general permanent-resident-parent birthright rule.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: The child is Ethiopian by descent if either parent is Ethiopian, regardless of whether the Ethiopian parent is the mother or father.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: Registration and proof of parentage remain practical requirements.

parent_benefit_summary.value: A citizen child does not automatically naturalize a foreign father. No inspected current official source establishes an automatic parent residence, permanent-residence or citizenship entitlement solely from having an Ethiopian child.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: Any family-unity application must be confirmed directly with ICS.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: No automatic citizenship or confirmed accelerated naturalization benefit. The father must maintain an independent lawful status and meet the applicable residence or nationality rules.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: Marriage to the Ethiopian mother may provide a separate basis if its requirements are met.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank displayed on 2026-08-15; this is not the Henley rank.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Destinations classified strictly as visa-free by Passport Index.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Destinations classified as requiring a visa in advance.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: Combined from 34 visa-on-arrival and 4 eTA destinations. The source reports a mobility score of 51.

passport.notes: Passport-index figures are live and may change when destination policies are updated.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: English is used in higher education and some international and business settings, especially in Addis Ababa, but Amharic remains the principal federal administrative language. The five listed languages reflect the federal working-language framework; the Constitution gives all Ethiopian languages equal state recognition.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: English-only government dealings and daily life are less reliable outside international organizations, large businesses and central Addis Ababa.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Low. Neither Russian nor Ukrainian is a federal working language, and no evidence was found that either is routinely usable for immigration, taxation or ordinary administration.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: This is an inference from the documented language framework, not a measured proficiency survey.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: The latest national labour-force wage result located is denominated in ETB and refers to February 2021. Converting that historical wage using a 2026 exchange rate would not produce a meaningful contemporaneous USD salary.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: The current ESS report page and the report's wage tables publish arithmetic mean monthly payments, including ETB 4,127 nationally, but do not publish a national median or the microdata-derived 50th percentile. A USD median therefore cannot be calculated without estimating an unpublished ETB median.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: The cited current ILO material states that Ethiopia has no national minimum wage, so no universal USD minimum can be reported.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No defensible current USD amount can be derived from the historical February 2021 ETB survey result without mixing incompatible dates.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: ESS's current download page and both the full 2021 Labour Force and Migration Survey report and its key-findings report were checked. They report mean gross monthly payment for paid employees, including the ETB 4,127 national mean, but neither publishes a national median wage or 50th-percentile figure. The ILO survey-catalog metadata identifies a monthly-earnings variable but does not publish a calculated national median. Consequently the USD median remains null rather than being inferred from the mean or from grouped observations.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: The inspected national survey publications do not publish a meaningful national maximum monthly wage; an observed sample maximum would not be a general salary ceiling.

min_salary_local_currency.notes: Ethiopia has no national statutory minimum wage in the cited current ILO material. Sectoral or public-service rates are not a universal minimum.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: Mean gross monthly payment for paid employees in the February 2021 Labour Force and Migration Survey, including bonus, overtime, allowances and other main-job benefits. Survey coverage excluded Tigray.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: The official publications report the national arithmetic mean but do not publish a national median or 50th percentile.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: The official publications do not define or publish a national maximum wage.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Mean gross monthly payment of paid employees from the national 2021 Labour Force and Migration Survey; not a median, minimum wage or all-worker income measure
average_citizen_salary.period: February 2021 survey reference period; monthly payment
average_citizen_salary.notes: This is historical average paid-employee remuneration, not a current 2026 salary estimate. Half of employed persons in the survey were self-employed and about 37% were unpaid family workers, so the paid-employee mean should not be interpreted as average income for every citizen or employed person. A separate Ministry of Labour and Skills analysis reported an approximately ETB 2,878 private-sector average on a different basis, so the nationally scoped ESS figure is retained.

cost_of_living_note.value: Official Ethiopian Statistics Service CPI releases measure changes in living costs. No reliable single national monthly household-cost amount was extracted, so none is presented.
cost_of_living_note.notes: Actual costs vary substantially by city, housing, household size and consumption pattern.
