settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: A business visa, visitor entry, TIN, commercial registration or tax payment is not a foreign-remote-worker residence route and should not be treated as settlement time.
settlement_track.summary: No current regular foreign-remote-worker route was found. Ethiopia offers qualifying investor residence, but that route generally requires USD 200,000 capital and a genuine Ethiopian investment; ordinary foreign-contract remote work does not supply the necessary residence basis.
settlement_track.notes: General naturalization law cannot supply the missing initial immigration basis. The applicant would need a materially different status such as local employment, qualifying investment, study or marriage before a credible settlement timeline could begin.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: The official catalogue contains no status for residing in Ethiopia solely while working for a foreign employer or client. Sole proprietorship exists only through the foreign-investment framework and carries substantial capital, permit and local-business requirements.

data.notes: The focused audit reviewed more than 15 directly relevant URLs and added current official tax, investment, commercial-registration and labour-survey sources. It resolves the self-employment question: a foreigner can form a sole proprietorship only as a qualifying foreign investor, not as an ordinary low-capital freelancer, and registration does not itself grant residence. The national labour survey publishes a mean but no median wage. Confidence remains medium because Ethiopia does not publish a single exhaustive English immigration statute or an express general statement about foreign remote work, and several processing, fee and transition details remain unpublished.

data.selection_summary: Fiji has no current digital-nomad, ordinary freelance, or independent foreign-contract remote-worker residence route. The closest independent option, the Residence Permit on Assured Income, is limited to applicants aged 45+ with sufficient offshore assets and normally prohibits any profession or employment without written approval. Work permits require employment, sponsorship, secondment, or a Fiji-linked project; visitor status cannot be converted in-country into a work permit. Fiji is therefore not valid for the target software-engineer profile, despite having general permanent-residence and naturalisation rules for people who obtain some other qualifying lawful status.

visa_application.title: Fiji IMMI HUB
visa_application.notes: Official Immigration application pages link to IMMI HUB. The hub responded but exposed only a generic server page to the research crawler, so applicants should begin from the relevant Fiji Immigration route page. No digital-nomad or ordinary remote-worker application category was listed.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No fixed monthly income threshold is published. The test is sufficient assets outside Fiji to avoid becoming a charge on public funds.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The official page requires an offshore bank statement expressed in Fijian currency and a retired-scheme statement but publishes no minimum FJD balance or income.

income_requirement_display.value: No fixed threshold published; sufficient offshore assets and age 45+
income_requirement_display.currency_basis: Offshore bank evidence shown in FJD
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: Assets outside Fiji sufficient to avoid becoming a charge on public funds
income_requirement_display.notes: This is an asset/self-sufficiency or retirement-style residence category, not an active foreign-contract remote-work category.

income_proof_months.notes: The latest offshore bank statement is required, but the official page does not specify a statement-history period.

key_requirements.requirement: The principal applicant must be at least 45 years old.
The applicant must control sufficient assets outside Fiji to remain self-supporting and must provide offshore banking and retired-scheme evidence.
Passport and arrival-stamp copies, photographs, a request letter, police clearance, medical report, terms and conditions, and application fees are required.
The permit holder may not engage in any profession or employment, paid or unpaid, without written approval from the Permanent Secretary.
The principal applicant's spouse and dependent children may be included.

initial_validity.value: Up to 3 years
initial_validity.notes: Regulation 50 authorises any period not exceeding three years from grant.

extension_rules.value: Extensions are considered on their merits; the published extension application fee is FJD 650.05.
extension_rules.notes: Continued financial evidence, local police clearance, medical evidence, and other updated documents are required.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Qualifying applicants receive a residence permit directly.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: It is genuine residence but does not authorise ordinary active remote employment.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: After 5 years of physical and lawful residence, permanent residence may be granted if Fiji is the applicant's home and the applicant's presence benefits Fiji or its citizens.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: This is a discretionary general permanent-residence rule, not an automatic conversion guarantee for assured-income permit holders.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalisation may be requested after at least 5 years of lawful presence within the preceding 10 years, subject to the Citizenship Act and supporting-document requirements.
path_to_citizenship.notes: The official citizenship guidance excludes visitor and student time. It does not expressly promise that every assured-income period will be accepted, so Immigration should confirm the counted days before relying on this path.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected for this profile because it is age-gated and its governing conditions prohibit professions and employment without special written approval. A foreign software contract does not independently qualify the applicant.

rejected_routes.route_name: Skilled contracted worker, overseas-employer secondment, or project work permit

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No general minimum salary applicable to an independent remote worker is published because this is a sponsored work route.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No relevant independent-route threshold exists.

income_requirement_display.value: Employment, organisational sponsorship, secondment, or a Fiji-linked project is required
income_requirement_display.notes: A foreign parent-company contract can support a secondment only in the prescribed sponsored/project context; an ordinary foreign-client remote contract is insufficient.

income_proof_months.notes: No personal income-history period relevant to the target scenario was found.

key_requirements.requirement: The relevant employer, organisation, or project sponsor must support the permit and submit the prescribed employment or secondment documents.
A visitor in Fiji cannot lodge a work-permit application in-country and must depart before the application is lodged.
Changing employment in Fiji requires Immigration approval.
The Immigration Act authorises residence-and-work permits for up to 3 years initially.

initial_validity.value: Up to 3 years initially, depending on the work-permit category
initial_validity.notes: Short-term categories may be issued for shorter periods.

extension_rules.value: May be extended if the prescribed conditions remain satisfied.
extension_rules.notes: The published work-permit extension application fee is FJD 650.05.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: The permit authorises temporary residence and work for the approved employment or project.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: It is not independently portable foreign-client remote-work permission.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: A discretionary general permanent-residence application may become possible after 5 years of physical lawful residence, but it is not automatic.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The applicant must also establish Fiji as home and show that their presence benefits Fiji or its citizens.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalisation requires at least 5 lawful years within the preceding 10 years.
path_to_citizenship.notes: This separate settlement possibility does not make an employer-sponsored route valid for the requested selection.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because employment, secondment, organisational sponsorship, or a host-country project is required.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: This route is based on a Fiji investment and operating business rather than monthly foreign income.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The current official page requires proof of available investment funds but does not publish one universal minimum amount.

income_requirement_display.value: Proof of funds and a genuine Fiji company/investment are required; no universal minimum published
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: Company registration, Fiji TIN, offshore investment evidence, and share issuance
income_requirement_display.notes: This is a founder/investor route involving local business substance and is outside the ordinary foreign-contract remote-worker profile.

income_proof_months.notes: Recent bank and investment evidence is required, but no general statement-history period was confirmed.

key_requirements.requirement: The applicant must invest in and operate a business in Fiji.
Company registration, a Fiji tax identification number, proof of funds, and confirmation of share issuance are required.
Police, medical, passport, company, bank, and relevant-authority endorsement documents may be required.

initial_validity.value: Investor permit; the current application page does not state one universal grant period
initial_validity.notes: A separate official legacy page describes a three-year investor permit, but current filing duration should be confirmed in the approval.

extension_rules.value: Extension requires continued investment evidence, tax compliance, local banking evidence, and other updated documents; published application fee FJD 650.05.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: An approved investor permit authorises temporary residence connected to the Fiji investment.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Only the discretionary general permanent-residence rule after 5 years of physical lawful residence was confirmed.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: No automatic investor-permit conversion was established.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalisation may be available after 5 lawful years in the preceding 10 years.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Separate from the investor permit and outside the requested profile.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because the applicant must establish and fund a Fiji business; this is not ordinary remote work for a foreign client.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No remote-worker income threshold exists for visitor status.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Visitors may need evidence of support and onward travel, but there is no published remote-worker threshold.

income_requirement_display.value: Not applicable—visitor status is not residence or remote-work authorisation
income_requirement_display.notes: Visitor permission cannot be treated as a digital-nomad or settlement status.

income_proof_months.notes: No route-specific income-history requirement applies.

key_requirements.requirement: Visitor status generally prohibits business, profession, or employment unless the Permanent Secretary grants approval under the limited statutory exceptions.
A visitor cannot apply for a work permit while remaining in Fiji.

initial_validity.value: Temporary visitor permission only; duration depends on the grant and nationality
initial_validity.notes: It is not qualifying residence for this selection.

extension_rules.value: A visitor extension may be requested for the permitted visitor purpose; the published extension fee is FJD 93.00.
extension_rules.notes: Extension does not create work or residence rights.

path_to_temporary_residence.notes: Visitor status is not a residence permit, and an in-country work-permit conversion is barred.

path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Official citizenship guidance expressly excludes visitor time when calculating the relevant citizenship residence periods.

path_to_citizenship.notes: Visitor time does not supply the requested settlement track.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because visitor permission is temporary, work-restricted, non-residential, and excluded from relevant citizenship residence calculations.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No fixed monthly threshold is published.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Financial statements and sponsorship evidence are required, but no universal minimum is stated.

income_requirement_display.value: No fixed threshold published; financial support and institutional acceptance required
income_requirement_display.notes: This is study-based residence, not qualification-based migration for an existing degree holder.

income_proof_months.notes: The page requests a current financial statement but does not state a history period.

key_requirements.requirement: Acceptance from a Fiji educational institution is mandatory.
Proof of qualifications and financial status is required.
Self-sponsored applicants need sponsor/support documentation, a confirmed return ticket or terms and conditions, and financial evidence.
Police and medical reports may be required.

initial_validity.value: For the approved course or academic period
initial_validity.notes: The page does not publish one universal duration.

extension_rules.value: Extension is considered on merit and should be lodged one month before expiry; the published application fee is FJD 321.00.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: The permit authorises residence for study.

path_to_permanent_residence.notes: No education-to-permanent-residence conversion was confirmed.

path_to_citizenship.notes: Official guidance says student-permit time must not be counted for the cited citizenship residence calculations.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because it requires local study and provides no confirmed education-to-settlement conversion; it is not an ordinary remote-worker route.

summary.value: A self-sponsored foreign student can apply without a local employer after obtaining acceptance from a Fiji institution and arranging the required financial and local support evidence. This grants study residence only. No independent degree-recognition, points-tested skilled migration, graduate permanent-residence route, or rule allowing student time to count toward the cited citizenship periods was confirmed.
summary.notes: Available only by undertaking local education; the applicant's existing software-engineering degree does not itself create residence eligibility.

tax_residency_rule.value: An individual is resident if they reside in Fiji, are domiciled there without a permanent abode abroad, are present for an aggregate 183 days in any 12-month period, or are a Fiji government employee posted abroad. A newly resident individual is generally treated as resident from the first day present in the relevant year.
tax_residency_rule.notes: Treaty residence and individual facts can override the practical result.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: This is the current top marginal screening rate, not an expected effective rate. Resident brackets begin at 0% and rise through 18%, 20%, and 33%–39%.

social_contributions_percent.notes: Employee FNPF contribution rate. From 1 August 2026 through 31 July 2027 the mandatory employer rate is also 8%. Applicability to a foreign person with no Fiji employment must be determined from the actual registration and employment structure.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: No digital-nomad or universal self-employed monthly fixed payment exists because there is no such immigration category. Self-employed income tax is based on chargeable income rather than a published universal monthly lump sum.

special_tax_regimes.value: No digital-nomad, remote-worker, non-dom, remittance-basis, or general inbound-worker tax holiday was found. Temporary residents who are resident solely or mainly for employment under a contract not exceeding 3 years are taxed at resident rates on Fiji-derived or Fiji-earned income; this is not a remote-work visa regime.
special_tax_regimes.notes: The temporary-resident rule is fact-specific and should not be assumed to exempt work physically performed in Fiji.

taxes.caveats: Immigration permission and tax liability are separate. Employment exercised physically in Fiji is Fiji-source wherever paid, and resident individuals are generally taxed on worldwide income with foreign-tax-credit relief where available. Contract classification, permanent establishment, FNPF coverage, VAT/business registration, and treaty residence require Fiji professional advice.

taxation_system.value: Progressive personal income tax; residents are generally taxed on worldwide income and non-residents on Fiji-source income. Current PAYE brackets incorporate the former Social Responsibility Tax at high incomes.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Residence, domicile, or aggregate presence of 183 days in any 12-month period can establish tax residence.
taxation_system.income_scope: Residents: worldwide income, generally with foreign-tax-credit relief. Non-residents: Fiji-source income. Employment performed in Fiji is Fiji-source wherever paid; resident business income is generally Fiji-source unless attributable to a foreign permanent establishment.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No special digital-nomad regime. A narrow temporary-resident employment rule exists for qualifying contracts of no more than 3 years.
taxation_system.social_security: Employee FNPF rate is 8%; the mandatory employer rate is temporarily 8% from 1 August 2026 to 31 July 2027.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The 39% figure is the top marginal rate above FJD 1,000,000, not an effective rate. Resident income through FJD 30,000 is nil-rated; ordinary marginal rates are 18% and 20% before higher-income rates begin above FJD 270,000.

tax_brackets.notes: Nil resident income tax.
First integrated high-income PAYE bracket.
Top marginal screening rate.

taxation_system.notes: The general tax-rate page still displays older separated PIT/SRT tables, but the FRCS PAYE notice updated in February 2026 states that SRT was integrated and publishes the effective 2024-onward 0%–39% structure.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: Not applicable as a route-specific regime because Fiji has no confirmed digital-nomad or ordinary foreign-remote-worker status. Anyone lawfully working from Fiji under another status must analyse ordinary Fiji source, residence, filing, and contribution rules.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: No digital-nomad tax category
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: Progressive 0%–39%; 39% is the top marginal screening rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: Residence can arise through ordinary residence, domicile, or 183 aggregate days in any 12-month period.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Residents are generally taxed on worldwide income; foreign-tax credits may be allowed. Work exercised in Fiji is Fiji-source wherever the payer is located.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None found.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: FNPF employee contribution is 8%; the mandatory employer rate is 8% from 1 August 2026 through 31 July 2027. Coverage depends on whether the arrangement constitutes Fiji employment or registration.

fixed_payments.status: No route-specific fixed monthly payment confirmed
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: Percentage-based FNPF contributions may apply; no universal fixed minimum was found.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: No nomad fee. Assured-income residence applications and extensions cost FJD 650.05, plus possible issue and bond fees, but that route normally prohibits employment.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: Business registration, VAT, and other obligations depend on the legal structure; no universal freelancer lump-sum tax was found.
fixed_payments.notes: No lawful ordinary remote-worker route exists to which a fixed-payment package could attach.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: Remaining below 183 days does not guarantee no Fiji tax: work physically exercised in Fiji can be Fiji-source, and immigration permission is independently required.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: A resident is generally exposed to Fiji tax on worldwide income at progressive rates up to 39%, subject to deductions, credits, treaties, and classification. No remote-worker exemption exists.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: Local business or self-employment can create tax, registration, VAT, and FNPF issues, but registration alone does not legalise immigration status. The investor route requires genuine Fiji investment/business substance.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: Tax analysis is hypothetical because no selected remote-worker immigration route exists.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: No qualifying temporary-residence route exists for the target ordinary foreign-contract remote worker.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: The general law permits a discretionary permanent-residence grant after 5 years of physical lawful residence, but there is no selected target-compatible temporary status from which to count.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: Fiji naturalisation is framed as 5 lawful years within the preceding 10 years, not as a fixed additional period after permanent residence.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: No total can be stated for the target route because no such route exists. Under another qualifying status, the general naturalisation residence test is at least 5 lawful years within the preceding 10 years.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: The official application page gives no standard citizenship processing time and says timing varies with completeness, checks, responses, and external information.

key_conditions.value: General naturalisation requires adulthood, at least 5 lawful years within the preceding 10 years, police and medical evidence, three supporting referees, fees, good-character evidence, and the citizenship application process. Visitor and student periods are expressly excluded in current Immigration guidance for the cited eligibility calculations. Fiji allows dual citizenship.
key_conditions.notes: No prescribed language-test level or maximum absence rule was found beyond the lawful-presence calculation; the form asks about languages and intention to continue living in Fiji.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: The statute requires lawful presence in Fiji for a total of 3 of the 5 years immediately before applying; it does not state a separate minimum duration of marriage.

existing_marriage_effect.value: A person who is or has been married to a Fiji citizen may apply for citizenship by registration after satisfying the 3-of-5-year lawful-presence rule and the statutory marriage conditions. A current spouse may obtain one-year renewable spouse exemption status to enter, reside, and study, but must obtain a work permit to work.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: Marriage by itself does not immediately confer citizenship or unrestricted work rights.

requirements_and_risks.value: The applicant must prove lawful presence and the marriage relationship. The Minister may demand evidence that the marriage was or was intended to result in a genuine and continuing marital relationship and may refuse the application if not satisfied. False or sham-marriage evidence can also trigger immigration and criminal consequences.
requirements_and_risks.notes: The spouse exemption is initially up to one year and remains dependent on the legal marriage; work still requires a separate permit.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Every child born in Fiji on or after 10 April 2009 is a citizen at birth, subject only to the narrow exception where a parent has diplomatic immunity and neither parent is a citizen. Under the prompt's classification rule, this is broad/unconditional jus soli.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A child born in Fiji to two migrant parents becomes a Fijian citizen automatically unless the narrow diplomatic-immunity exception applies.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: The parents' temporary or permanent immigration status is otherwise irrelevant to the child's birth citizenship.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: A child born in Fiji is a citizen by birth. A child born abroad may acquire citizenship by registration if either parent was a Fijian citizen at the time of birth.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: The migrant father's citizenship does not prevent the child acquiring citizenship through the Fijian parent.

parent_benefit_summary.value: The child's Fijian citizenship is valuable to the child, but no current official route was found that automatically grants a foreign parent residence, permanent residence, or citizenship solely because their Fiji-born child is a citizen.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: The published family categories clearly cover spouses and children of citizens, while the searched pages did not publish an automatic parent-of-citizen category. A fact-specific special-purpose family application may warrant direct Immigration advice.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: No automatic benefit was confirmed. The father must independently qualify for a permit, spouse route, permanent residence, or naturalisation; the citizen child's interests may be relevant to a discretionary family application but do not themselves naturalise the father.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: Do not rely on childbirth as an immigration strategy without written confirmation from Fiji Immigration.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank displayed by Passport Index on the checked date.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Strict visa-free category, not combined with visa on arrival or eTA.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Passport Index's visa-required count.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: 43 visa-on-arrival plus 5 eTA destinations; eVisa destinations are not included in this combined figure.

passport.notes: Passport Index reports mobility score 97, comprising 49 visa-free, 43 visa-on-arrival, and 5 eTA destinations. Index methodologies differ, so these figures should not be mixed with Henley rankings.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: High for daily administration and business. English is one of Fiji's three official languages and is widely used in government, business, and education.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: Connectivity and service quality vary by island and location, but language itself is not a significant barrier for an English-speaking remote worker.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Low. No official or reliable source found evidence that Russian or Ukrainian is commonly usable for government administration or ordinary local business; English should be expected.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: This is a cautious practical inference from the documented official-language and English-use context, not a measured prevalence statistic.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: Approximation: official 2022 estimated mean annual gross income of FJD 19,920 divided by 12 equals FJD 1,660 monthly, converted using the Reserve Bank's published reference of about USD 0.4374 per FJD. The wage observation is for 2022 but the official report was released in March 2026.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: The current official survey materials inspected publish means by sector, occupation, sex, and employment type but no reliable national monthly median wage was located.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Illustrative monthly equivalent of the statutory FJD 5.00 hourly minimum from 1 April 2025, assuming 40 hours weekly and 52 weeks divided by 12. Actual monthly pay depends on hours worked.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate USD conversion of FJD 1,660 monthly mean gross income.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No national median salary was established after checking the 2023–24 Employment and Unemployment Survey and the annual paid-employment release.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No meaningful national maximum salary exists in the official sources; sector and occupational means are not maxima.

min_salary_local_currency.value: FJD 5.00/hour; approximately FJD 866.67/month at an assumed 40-hour week
min_salary_local_currency.notes: Statutory national minimum wage, not an observed minimum salary.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: Derived from the official FJD 19,920 annual estimated gross-income mean for registered establishments in 2022.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: Not published in the directly relevant official materials inspected.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: No defensible national maximum published.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Gross mean income for wage and salary earners in registered establishments; minimum is statutory hourly wage
average_citizen_salary.period: Mean observation year 2022, official release March 2026; minimum wage effective from April 2025 and still current in the materials checked
average_citizen_salary.notes: The average is official but lagged. The newer 2024 household labour survey publishes detailed monthly means such as FJD 1,873 for professionals and FJD 1,790 for technicians/associate professionals, but no clean overall employee mean or median suitable for replacing the national figure was identified.

cost_of_living_note.value: No reliable official single-person monthly cost-of-living budget was found. Fiji Bureau of Statistics publishes CPI and household-survey material, but CPI measures price change rather than the cash budget needed by a new resident, so no cost figure is inferred.
cost_of_living_note.notes: Housing and imported-goods costs vary substantially between Suva, Nadi, resort areas, and outer islands.

settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: Fiji has no confirmed digital-nomad or ordinary remote-worker status. Visitor permission is not residence and cannot be used for in-country work-permit conversion; the assured-income residence permit normally prohibits employment.
settlement_track.summary: No current status fits ordinary foreign-contract remote work and feeds a confirmed citizenship path. Settlement is possible only after qualifying under a materially different status, such as sponsored work, genuine investment, family residence, or the age-45+ assured-income category subject to its employment prohibition.
settlement_track.notes: General law provides discretionary permanent residence after 5 years of physical lawful residence and naturalisation after 5 lawful years within 10, but those rules do not create an entry route for this applicant.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: The official permit catalogue contains no digital-nomad or independent foreign-remote-worker category. The independent assured-income permit prohibits a profession or employment without written approval, while work permission is sponsored or project-linked.

data.notes: This audit improves the previous Fiji record by confirming the assured-income employment prohibition and three-year maximum in legislation, the discretionary five-year permanent-residence rule, the current integrated 0%–39% tax brackets, the 183-day tax-residence rule, current FNPF rates, official wage data, broad jus soli, and detailed spouse rules. Remaining nulls are explained where no official fixed threshold, median wage, citizenship processing time, or parent-of-citizen entitlement could genuinely be established.

data.selection_summary: Finland has no dedicated digital-nomad or freelancer residence permit. It can nevertheless fit an ordinary foreign-client software contractor through the independently filed entrepreneur residence permit if the applicant establishes a genuine qualifying Finnish business, works in that business in Finland, and demonstrates profitable operations that primarily support the applicant. Merely retaining foreign payroll employment, owning a passive company, or billing as a light entrepreneur through an invoicing service does not qualify.

visa_application.title: Enter Finland e-service
visa_application.notes: Enter Finland is the official online filing portal. A first entrepreneur permit is normally submitted while abroad; identity may still need to be proved at a Finnish mission.

best_routes.route_name: Residence permit for an entrepreneur

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No fixed monthly threshold is published. The Economic Development Centre assesses whether the business is profitable and whether business income secures the applicant's support.

minimum_income_local_currency.value: No fixed EUR threshold; the business must be profitable and the applicant must primarily earn a living from it.
minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Customer contracts, accounts, funding, a business plan, and a two-year forecast may substantiate viability.

income_requirement_display.value: No fixed threshold — profitable business income must secure support
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: Profitable operations and means of support primarily from the business
income_requirement_display.notes: This is an individual viability assessment rather than a digital-nomad salary test.

income_proof_months.notes: Three months of personal bank statements are requested when the applicant relies on personal funds for startup operations or support. The application also requests a financial forecast for the next two years.

key_requirements.requirement: Operate through an accepted form such as a Finnish private trader, qualifying partnership/cooperative member, or an owner-manager with the required ownership and control.

Have or establish a genuine business and Business ID/Trade Register entry; a first-time private trader applying abroad may apply before receiving the Business ID if the registration information and documents are included.
Work in the business in Finland; passive company ownership is insufficient.

Show profitable operations and means of support primarily from business income. Relevant evidence includes a business plan, two-year forecast, qualifications, funding, accounts, and customer agreements where available.
Do not rely solely on freelancer/light-entrepreneur billing through an invoicing service; Finland has no separate residence permit for that model.
Provide a valid passport, recent photograph, passport copy, and evidence of legal stay in the country of application; translations and legalisation may be required.

initial_validity.value: Usually up to 1 year for a first fixed-term permit; the exact period depends on the grounds and individual circumstances.
initial_validity.notes: The entrepreneur route page does not publish a more specific guaranteed first-permit term.

extension_rules.value: Apply in Finland before expiry. An extended permit may be granted for up to 4 years if the qualifying business and other permit requirements continue.
extension_rules.notes: Current electronic fees are EUR 230 for an extension and EUR 750 for a first entrepreneur permit; paper fees are EUR 430 and EUR 900 respectively.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: The approved entrepreneur application directly grants a fixed-term residence permit based on entrepreneurship.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The first application is normally filed abroad; this is not a tourist-to-residence legalization route.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Entrepreneurship is expressly accepted as a continuous A-permit ground for permanent residence. From 8 January 2026, the earliest general paths after residence begin include 4 years with more than EUR 40,000 of taxable annual income, or specified degree/work-history or C1-language paths; otherwise the standard path is 6 years with at least 2 years of Finnish work history and B1 Finnish or Swedish.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The applicant must still qualify for a continuous entrepreneur permit when applying for permanent residence.

path_to_citizenship.value: Residence under a lawful permit counts toward naturalisation. The normal residence requirement is 8 years, reduced to 5 years when the citizenship language requirement is met, alongside identity, integrity, payment, and financial-resource requirements.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Permanent residence is not a prerequisite for citizenship. Finland permits multiple citizenship.

best_routes.notes: This route fits the foreign-client version of the profile only when the applicant becomes a genuine Finnish entrepreneur, invoices through the qualifying business, works from Finland, and passes the profitability review. A foreign employment contract left unchanged does not itself provide an immigration ground. Foreign customers are not prohibited, but approval remains an evidence-based business-viability decision.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The official requirement is expressed in EUR; no USD conversion is needed for filing.

minimum_income_local_currency.value: EUR 1,210 / 1,090 / 1,030 net per month in 2026, depending on residence location, with funds for at least one year
minimum_income_local_currency.notes: A two-year first permit requires funds covering two years.

income_requirement_display.value: EUR 1,210 / 1,090 / 1,030 net monthly plus Business Finland eligibility
income_requirement_display.notes: Rejected because it is a screened high-growth startup/founder route, not ordinary consulting.

income_proof_months.notes: Funds must cover at least one year.

key_requirements.requirement: Recently founded or planned growth-oriented startup.
Positive Business Finland Eligibility Statement, no more than four months old at filing.

initial_validity.value: Up to 2 years
initial_validity.notes: Sufficient resources must cover the granted period.

extension_rules.value: An extension can be granted for the period of proven continuous income, up to 4 years.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Direct fixed-term residence if startup requirements are met.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Entrepreneur/startup grounds can support permanent residence under the general 2026 paths.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The route is rejected only because the applicant profile does not assume a qualifying growth startup.

path_to_citizenship.value: Possible through ordinary lawful residence and naturalisation requirements.

rejected_routes.notes: Not usable without founder status and Business Finland screening.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The official threshold is EUR 3,937 gross monthly in 2026.

minimum_income_local_currency.value: EUR 3,937 gross per month in 2026
minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Fringe benefits do not count.

income_requirement_display.value: EUR 3,937 gross/month in 2026
income_requirement_display.notes: Rejected because confirmed employment in Finland and employer supplementation are mandatory.

income_proof_months.notes: The threshold is established through the Finnish employment terms rather than a specified bank-statement period.

key_requirements.requirement: Confirmed specialist job in Finland before applying.
Employer must supplement the application with the terms of employment.
Higher education degree or equivalent specialist expertise.

initial_validity.value: Maximum 2 years, or the employment duration if shorter

extension_rules.value: Extension available while qualifying employment continues; current electronic extension fee is EUR 230.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Direct fixed-term residence for qualifying Finnish employment.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Can support permanent residence under the general 2026 paths.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: It fails the no-local-employer criterion.

path_to_citizenship.value: Possible through ordinary lawful residence and naturalisation.

rejected_routes.notes: A strong IT route only after securing a Finnish job; it is not independently usable for foreign-contract remote work.

rejected_routes.route_name: Residence permit to look for work or start a business after Finnish studies or research

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The official maintenance requirement is EUR 800 per month.

minimum_income_local_currency.value: At least EUR 800 per month
minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Funds must be available for living costs.

income_requirement_display.value: EUR 800/month plus a completed Finnish degree or qualifying Finnish research
income_requirement_display.notes: The applicant's existing foreign degree does not satisfy the Finnish-study prerequisite.

income_proof_months.notes: The accessible official page confirms the monthly amount but not a single universal proof period in the captured text.

key_requirements.requirement: Previously held a Finnish residence permit for studies or qualifying research.
Completed the qualifying degree or research in Finland.

initial_validity.value: Up to 2 years
initial_validity.notes: The permit can be sought within five years after graduation under current Migri guidance.

extension_rules.value: A new work, entrepreneur, or other qualifying status is generally required when the jobseeking permit ends.
extension_rules.notes: Its A/B classification follows the previous permit in the circumstances described by Migri.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Direct residence only for graduates/researchers meeting the Finnish-study or Finnish-research prerequisite.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: A separate permanent-residence path exists for qualifying higher-education degrees completed in Finland, subject to A-permit grounds and language/other requirements.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: This does not make a pre-existing foreign degree independently sufficient.

path_to_citizenship.value: Possible through ordinary lawful residence if all naturalisation requirements are later met.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected for the stated applicant because the relevant degree was not established as having been completed in Finland.

summary.value: Finland offers an independent jobseeking/start-a-business permit to people who completed qualifying studies or research in Finland, and a favorable permanent-residence path for specified Finnish higher-education degrees. A foreign university degree alone does not open this route; it can only assist with an entrepreneur application or later PR path after qualifying Finnish residence and work history.
summary.notes: Available without a local employer only after the required Finnish education/research history.

tax_residency_rule.value: A continuous stay exceeding 6 months generally makes an individual a Finnish resident taxpayer, normally taxable on worldwide income. A stay of no more than 6 months normally produces nonresident treatment, generally limited to Finnish-source income, subject to treaties, permanent-establishment, leased-employee, and other special rules.
tax_residency_rule.notes: Temporary trips outside Finland normally remain part of the continuous six-month period.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: This is the top 2026 state earned-income marginal bracket, not the expected effective rate. Municipal income tax, possible church tax, health contributions, YEL, deductions, and the division of business income into earned/capital components can materially change the total.

social_contributions_percent.notes: The 2026 YEL pension contribution rate is 24.40% of confirmed self-employment work income. New entrepreneurs may receive a 22% contribution discount for the first four years, making the effective YEL rate about 19% during that period.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate standard minimum YEL contribution: EUR 9,423.09 minimum annual confirmed work income × 24.40% ÷ 12 = about EUR 191.60/month, converted using the ECB converter result of EUR 1 = USD 1.1392 accessible during research. YEL is mandatory only when its age, duration, and work-income conditions are met; actual confirmed work income may be higher.

special_tax_regimes.value: No digital-nomad or ordinary self-employed inbound tax holiday was found. Finland's 25% foreign key-employee tax-at-source regime from 2026 requires qualifying wage employment, including salary of at least EUR 5,800 per month and other conditions, so it does not apply to the selected sole-trader/entrepreneur scenario.
special_tax_regimes.notes: A limited-company owner may have a different salary/dividend analysis, but the key-employee regime still requires its specific employment conditions.

taxes.caveats: Finnish entrepreneur taxation depends on legal form, allocation between earned and capital income, municipality, deductions, church membership, YEL work income, health-insurance status, VAT place-of-supply rules, and applicable tax treaties. Obtain Finland-specific advice before converting a foreign employment or client arrangement.

taxation_system.value: Progressive residence-based taxation. For 2026, state earned-income marginal rates run from 12.64% to 37.50%; municipal tax and social/health components are additional. Residents generally report worldwide income.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Continuous presence over 6 months generally creates resident taxpayer status.
taxation_system.income_scope: Worldwide income for residents; generally Finnish-source income for nonresidents, subject to treaties and special rules.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No nomad regime. A 25% qualifying foreign key-employee regime exists but requires qualifying wage employment and does not fit the selected self-employed route.
taxation_system.social_security: YEL is generally mandatory where self-employment lasts at least four months and confirmed annual work income reaches EUR 9,423.09 in 2026. Standard contribution is 24.40%, with a possible 22% new-entrepreneur discount for four years.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The bracket rates below are state tax rates. The overall marginal burden can be higher because average municipal tax is about 7.57% in 2026, health-care contribution on wage/work income is 1.10%, and a self-employed daily-allowance contribution of 1.11% applies at annual income of at least EUR 17,255 (0.23% below that threshold). Deductions mean these percentages should not simply be added to estimate effective tax.

tax_brackets.notes: Tax at lower limit EUR 0.
Tax at lower limit EUR 2,780.80.
Tax at lower limit EUR 4,794.80.
Tax at lower limit EUR 7,063.55.

tax_brackets.threshold_local: Over EUR 52,100 taxable earned income annually
tax_brackets.notes: Tax at lower limit EUR 11,053.55.

taxation_system.notes: The 37.50% dashboard value is the top state marginal rate, not an all-in or effective rate.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: Finland has no digital-nomad tax category. A qualifying entrepreneur uses ordinary Finnish self-employed/business and resident-tax rules.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: ordinary_self_employed_entrepreneur
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: Progressive state earned-income tax up to 37.50%, plus municipal and applicable social/health charges; not an effective-rate estimate.
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: Over 6 months of continuous presence generally creates Finnish resident taxation.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Residents generally report worldwide income. Foreign-client business income is not exempt merely because the customer is abroad; treaty and VAT place-of-supply analysis may apply.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None confirmed for ordinary remote contractors. The 25% key-employee regime is employment-based and does not fit this route.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: YEL is generally 24.40% of confirmed self-employment work income once mandatory conditions are met; new entrepreneurs may qualify for a 22% discount for four years. Employees with foreign employers have separate A1 and Finnish insurance rules.

fixed_payments.status: route_dependent_but_quantified
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: At the 2026 minimum YEL work-income level, standard YEL is about EUR 191.60/month; approximately EUR 149.45/month during an eligible 22% new-entrepreneur discount. Actual YEL is based on confirmed work income, not business profit.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: Entrepreneur permit: electronic EUR 750 first permit and EUR 230 extension; paper EUR 900 first permit and EUR 430 extension.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: VAT registration is generally required once turnover exceeds EUR 20,000 in either the current or preceding calendar year. Accounting, Trade Register, and insurance costs vary and no universal monthly amount was established.
fixed_payments.notes: The EUR 20,000 VAT threshold does not itself determine whether cross-border services are Finnish-taxable; place-of-supply and reverse-charge rules require transaction-specific analysis.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: For an employee staying no more than 6 months with a foreign employer, foreign wages are usually not taxed in Finland absent special circumstances, although social-insurance obligations can remain. This does not create a valid immigration route. A Finland-based entrepreneur should not assume the same treatment for business conducted in Finland.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: After more than 6 months, assume Finnish worldwide-income reporting and progressive taxation, subject to treaty relief. A foreign employer may also acquire reporting or permanent-establishment issues.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: Expect business tax prepayments based on estimated profit, annual business returns, YEL where mandatory, bookkeeping, and VAT registration/returns when applicable.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: Immigration eligibility and tax classification are separate; obtaining an entrepreneur permit does not fix the final tax result.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: The entrepreneur permit itself is the initial fixed-term residence status; time is required for application processing, but no prior Finnish residence period is prescribed.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: Four years is the earliest generally relevant path, for example with taxable annual income over EUR 40,000 or another specified four-year path. The standard residence path is 6 years with B1 language and at least 2 years of Finnish work history.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: Permanent residence is not required before applying for citizenship. Eligibility is measured by lawful residence and the naturalisation requirements; depending on the PR path, citizenship eligibility may arise before, with, or after PR.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: Five years applies when the applicant already meets the citizenship language requirement. Otherwise the ordinary residence requirement is 8 years.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: Migri's current table states 35 months in most adult application cases and 8 months in a minority of cases. A backlog remains, so this estimate can change.

key_conditions.value: Maintain lawful qualifying residence and the genuine entrepreneur business; for PR, satisfy one of the 2026 residence/income/degree/work-history/language paths and retain A-permit grounds. For citizenship, establish identity, satisfactory Finnish/Swedish or qualifying sign-language skills, the required lawful residence period, integrity, paid taxes and other obligations, and sufficient financial resources. Finland permits multiple citizenship.
key_conditions.notes: Absences and changes of permit grounds can affect residence calculations and should be checked before filing.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: A current spouse of a Finnish citizen needs 5 years of residence and at least 3 years of living together. This is a reduction from the ordinary 8-year period, although applicants who satisfy the language requirement also have a 5-year route without marriage.

existing_marriage_effect.value: An existing marriage matters only if the current spouse is Finnish and the couple meets the genuine cohabitation requirement. A prior marriage to a Finn or marriage to another foreign national does not shorten the citizenship residence period.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: Marriage may separately support a family-ties residence permit, but it does not grant citizenship automatically.

requirements_and_risks.value: The applicant must still meet the other citizenship conditions, including lawful residence, identity, language, integrity, payment obligations, and sufficient resources. Migri examines actual family life and documentation; false or sham relationship evidence can cause refusal and other legal consequences.
requirements_and_risks.notes: The five-year spouse period requires a current Finnish spouse and at least three years of living together.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Finland primarily grants citizenship by descent. Birth in Finland confers citizenship on children of two foreign nationals only in narrow anti-statelessness/protection circumstances.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: Normally no automatic Finnish citizenship. Exceptional place-of-birth citizenship can apply where the child cannot acquire either parent's citizenship and the specific refugee/protection-related statutory conditions are met.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: Birth in Finland alone is insufficient.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: A Finnish mother transmits citizenship automatically. Where only the father is Finnish, the result depends on marriage, place of birth, and confirmation of paternity; a child born in Finland outside marriage becomes Finnish when paternity is officially confirmed.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: Parentage-specific rules should be checked against the family's facts.

parent_benefit_summary.value: A Finnish minor child can sponsor a residence-permit application by the child's genuine legal guardian, providing an unrestricted right to work once granted. The parent does not acquire Finnish citizenship automatically and must separately meet naturalisation requirements.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: Guardianship and genuine family ties must be documented.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: If the other parent is Finnish and the child obtains Finnish citizenship, a migrant father who is the child's guardian may apply for residence on family-ties grounds. If both parents are foreign and the child is not Finnish, birth alone gives the father no citizenship or PR shortcut.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: A citizen child supports residence, not automatic parental citizenship.

rank.notes: Passport Index Power Rank as accessed on 2026-08-15. The current official Henley table separately placed Finland joint 4th with access to 186 destinations.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Passport Index's strict visa-free category; its broader mobility score is 173.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Passport Index category requiring a visa in advance.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: Combined from 42 visa-on-arrival and 11 eTA destinations. eVisas and other categories are not included in this combined figure.

passport.notes: Passport-index methodologies differ. Passport Index supplies the requested category split; Henley supplies a broader prior-visa-free access score and currently reports Finland joint 4th with 186 destinations.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: High for everyday remote work and especially technology-sector contexts. EF's 2025 index classified Finland's English proficiency as very high and ranked it 12th of 123 countries/regions. Finnish or Swedish remains important for integration, government matters, and citizenship.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: English usability does not replace the Finnish/Swedish citizenship language requirement.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Useful within substantial communities but not a substitute for Finnish, Swedish, or English in most official and professional settings. At the end of 2025, Statistics Finland reported about 102,618 Russian and 46,696 Ukrainian native-language speakers.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: Availability of Russian- or Ukrainian-language services varies by locality and provider.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate conversion of EUR 4,269 using EUR 1 = USD 1.1392. The underlying figure is preliminary average monthly earnings of full-time wage and salary earners for 2026 Q1.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate conversion of the finalized EUR 3,615 monthly median for 2024.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Finland has no single statutory national minimum wage, and the official distribution source did not publish an actual national minimum. The lowest-paid decile earned under EUR 2,477/month in preliminary 2024 data, but that is not a minimum salary.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate USD value of EUR 4,269/month.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate USD value of EUR 3,615/month.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No meaningful national maximum is published. The best-paid decile threshold was at least EUR 6,115/month in preliminary 2024 data, but that is not a maximum.

min_salary_local_currency.notes: No statutory nationwide minimum or observed absolute minimum was established. Sectoral collective agreements commonly set pay floors.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: Preliminary average monthly earnings of full-time wage and salary earners, 2026 Q1.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: Median total earnings of full-time wage and salary earners, finalized 2024 data updated in June 2026.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: No actual national maximum was published.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Gross monthly earnings of full-time wage and salary earners. Average is 2026 Q1 preliminary average monthly earnings; median is finalized 2024 total earnings. These are not entrepreneur income thresholds.
average_citizen_salary.period: 2026 Q1 average; 2024 median/distribution
average_citizen_salary.notes: Preliminary 2024 distribution data placed the lowest-paid decile below EUR 2,477 and the highest-paid decile at or above EUR 6,115 monthly. Those decile cutoffs are included only as distribution context, not as minimum or maximum wages.

cost_of_living_note.value: Finland's wages, taxes, and cost of living are described by the authority-supported InfoFinland service as slightly above the EU average. Statistics Finland reported 2.1% year-on-year consumer-price inflation in June 2026; actual housing costs vary substantially by municipality.
cost_of_living_note.notes: The CPI is a price-change measure, not a monthly household budget.
