settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: Visitor visas and the visitor registration card are not remote-work authorizations. A separate lawful professional, family, study or other qualifying residence basis would be required before Morocco's general settlement rules could become relevant.
settlement_track.summary: Morocco has general four-year residence-card and five-year naturalization rules, but no confirmed initial residence category for ordinary foreign-contract remote work. The applicant would need to qualify independently under a materially different authorized status, so the requested route itself cannot lead to citizenship.
settlement_track.notes: Naturalization remains discretionary, and the existence of general settlement rules does not legalize remote work performed under visitor status.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: No dedicated digital-nomad visa or ordinary foreign-client freelancer residence route was found. The visitor card restricts professional activity requiring authorization; Labour Code article 516 and the current TAECHIR materials describe employer-led authorization for a Moroccan foreign-worker employment contract, which an overseas software contract alone does not establish.

data.notes: The negative selection result is retained after a focused unresolved-field audit. Thirty distinct directly relevant canonical URLs were reviewed, including seven sources absent from the previous set. Labour-law and TAECHIR materials clarify why the professional card has no general income threshold and why an overseas software contract is not the employer-filed Moroccan work contract. Current HCP labour publications still do not publish a national median individual wage; the precise null is retained rather than substituting household income, a statutory minimum or a public-sector average.

data.selection_summary: Mozambique has no current digital-nomad or ordinary foreign-contract remote-worker residence category. The official 2026 portal offers short-stay tourist/business visas, an investment visa requiring at least USD 500,000, and an oil-and-gas work visa requiring an employment contract and local company/project documentation. A generic residence visa is only an entry instrument and the reviewed official material does not establish a foreign-client contract or foreign remote income as an independent substantive basis for DIRE residence. Mozambique therefore does not fit this applicant’s citizenship-oriented selection.

visa_application.title: Mozambique eVisa and eTA online application
visa_application.notes: This is the active application system linked by the official SENAMI eVisa portal. The platform launched on 11 February 2026 and does not list a digital-nomad or foreign-remote-worker category.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The portal requires sufficient means but publishes no remote-worker income threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No fixed subsistence amount is published on the reviewed portal pages.

income_requirement_display.value: No published fixed amount; sufficient means required
income_requirement_display.notes: This is a short-stay entry category, not a remote-work residence route.

income_proof_months.notes: The portal does not prescribe a number of months of income history.

key_requirements.requirement: Passport valid for at least six months, subsistence guarantees, applicable fee and category-specific documents.
Tourism is limited to tourism/holiday purposes; business entry covers meetings, research, conferences and business activity rather than ongoing foreign remote employment.

initial_validity.value: Up to 90 days for the portal’s tourist or business categories
initial_validity.notes: The exact authorized stay is stated on the issued visa.

extension_rules.value: No remote-work conversion or settlement extension is confirmed; a changed travel date requires a new eVisa.
extension_rules.notes: Business visas do not qualify their holders for permanent residence under the cited migration profile.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: No path from this visitor/business status was confirmed.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: A separate qualifying basis would be required.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Business visas do not entitle holders to seek permanent residence.

path_to_citizenship.value: None from this short-stay category.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Naturalisation instead requires at least ten years of habitual and regular residence.

rejected_routes.notes: Independently obtainable short-stay entry does not authorize this applicant to establish a qualifying remote-work residence or settlement track.

rejected_routes.route_name: Work visa and employment-based temporary residence

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No immigration income threshold is published; compensation is governed by the employment contract and labor rules.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The route page does not state a route-specific minimum salary.

income_requirement_display.value: No route-specific income threshold published
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: Contractual salary; applicable labor minimums may apply
income_requirement_display.notes: This is not a foreign-contract remote-worker route.

income_proof_months.notes: Eligibility is based on the employment contract, not a prescribed historical-income period.

key_requirements.requirement: Employment certificate and contract proving the employer-employee relationship.
Invitation addressed to SENAMI, criminal record, commercial license and, for the portal category reviewed, proof connecting the concessionaire and subcontractor.
Foreign employment is subject to Mozambican authorization and labor-market restrictions.

initial_validity.value: Portal options of 90, 180 or 365 days, tied to the authorized employment/project
initial_validity.notes: The currently detailed online work category is oil and gas.

extension_rules.value: Temporary residence permits are generally valid for one year and renewable while the qualifying reason continues.
extension_rules.notes: Employment and authorization must remain valid.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: A qualifying work visa/employment authorization can support temporary residence.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: This is employer-based, not independent.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Permanent residence may become available after more than ten consecutive years of qualifying temporary residence if the original basis continues.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Short-stay business, border and humanitarian statuses are excluded.

path_to_citizenship.value: Naturalisation may be requested after at least ten years of habitual and regular residence, subject to constitutional conditions.
path_to_citizenship.notes: The existence of a long settlement path does not make the starting route suitable for an independent remote worker.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because a Mozambican employment/project relationship and authorization are required. A contract solely with a foreign employer or client outside Mozambique does not satisfy the published route requirements.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The requirement is investment capital rather than monthly income.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The official portal states the threshold in US dollars.

income_requirement_display.value: Minimum qualifying project investment: USD 500,000
income_requirement_display.notes: This is a substantial-capital investment route and is excluded for the ordinary remote-worker profile.

income_proof_months.notes: Historical monthly income is not the test.

key_requirements.requirement: Investment project worth at least USD 500,000 and approved by government entities.
Commercial license, tax and INSS clearances, criminal record, medical certificate and supporting project documentation.

initial_validity.value: Multiple-entry visa for 90, 180, 365 or 730 days
initial_validity.notes: The issued duration depends on the approved itinerary/project.

extension_rules.value: The portal directs applicants needing an extension to contact a Mozambican embassy.
extension_rules.notes: No automatic extension was identified.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Investment activity is a recognized qualifying basis, but requires the substantial approved investment.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Potentially through the general ten-year qualifying-residence rule, subject to continuing the original basis.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Filing-level confirmation would be required for a specific investment structure.

path_to_citizenship.value: General naturalisation after at least ten years of habitual and regular residence may apply.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Not suitable for the supplied non-investor profile.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because it requires an approved project worth at least USD 500,000, not merely foreign remote income or a software-services contract.

rejected_routes.route_name: Generic residence visa followed by DIRE

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: Subsistence guarantees are required, but the checklist publishes no fixed threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The checklist does not state a fixed MZN amount.

income_requirement_display.value: Means of subsistence required; no fixed amount published
income_requirement_display.notes: Financial means alone were not shown to create an independent substantive residence ground.

income_proof_months.notes: The checklist does not specify a historical-income period.

key_requirements.requirement: Subsistence guarantee, request letter, individual or organizational sponsor letter, criminal record and medical certificate.
After arrival, the holder must apply to SENAMI for residence authorization and a DIRE card.

initial_validity.value: Single entry and 30-day stay, extendable to 60 days
initial_validity.notes: This is an entry visa, not itself the final residence authorization.

extension_rules.value: Initial stay may be extended to 60 days; DIRE requires a separate SENAMI residence application.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: The visa permits a subsequent DIRE application only when the applicant has an accepted qualifying residence ground.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The reviewed checklist did not confirm ordinary foreign remote work as such a ground.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Only qualifying temporary residents can reach the general permanent-residence rule after more than ten consecutive years.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The entry visa alone does not start a confirmed settlement track.

path_to_citizenship.value: No citizenship path is established by the visa alone.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Ten years of habitual and regular residence is required for ordinary naturalisation.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because this consular residence visa is only a 30-day entry instrument for a later SENAMI/DIRE filing and does not itself supply the substantive residence ground. The checklist requires subsistence evidence and a sponsor/request letter, but neither it, Law 23/2022’s official embassy summary, nor the current visa portal recognizes foreign remote income, a foreign-client contract, a Mozambican bank account, tax registration or sole-proprietor registration alone as a self-sponsored DIRE basis. A filing would therefore require a separately accepted ground, such as authorized local employment, family status or qualifying investment.

summary.value: Mozambique lists a student visa, but no independent points-tested, degree-based or software-engineer residence program was found. A university degree can support an employer’s foreign-worker authorization; it is not an independent residence ground for this profile.
summary.notes: Study itself is not treated as an ordinary foreign-contract remote-work route, and the reviewed sources did not confirm student status as a direct permanent-residence route.

tax_residency_rule.value: From 1 January 2026, residence is based on having a main residence in Mozambique, carrying on the principal professional activity there, or having the center of economic interests there. The former 180-day test was repealed.
tax_residency_rule.notes: This new, fact-sensitive test can make physical-day counting alone misleading.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate, not the expected effective rate. Progressive resident rates run from 10% to 32%; many non-resident Mozambique-source earnings are subject to a 20% final withholding rate.

social_contributions_percent.notes: Locally registered self-employed workers bear the full 7%. For employees, the standard 7% is split 3% employee and 4% employer.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: No fixed USD amount exists. A self-employed contribution is 7% of chosen conventional remuneration, subject to applicable minimum-base rules; the exact minimum depends on the activity sector and accepted base.

special_tax_regimes.value: No digital-nomad or inbound remote-worker tax regime was found. From 1 January 2026, previous simplified and exempt personal-income-tax regimes were abolished, with affected taxpayers migrating to statutory accounting.
special_tax_regimes.notes: Implementing regulations for portions of the 2026 reform were still expected within 180 days of enactment.

taxes.caveats: Tax treatment depends on whether the person is resident under the new 2026 center-of-interests/activity test, where the work is performed and sourced, whether the contract is employment or independent services, payer residence, local registration and any applicable tax treaty. Mozambique has no nomad visa whose tax treatment can be analyzed separately.

taxation_system.value: Progressive personal income tax on residents’ worldwide income, with rates from 10% to 32%; non-residents are taxed on Mozambique-source income and commonly face 20% final withholding on earned income.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Main residence, principal professional activity or center of economic interests in Mozambique from 1 January 2026; no general 180-day safe threshold.
taxation_system.income_scope: Residents: worldwide income. Non-residents: Mozambique-source income.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No digital-nomad regime; simplified and exempt IRPS regimes were abolished from 2026.
taxation_system.social_security: Generally 7%: employees bear 3% and employers 4%; qualifying self-employed workers bear the full 7% on conventional remuneration.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The dashboard value of 32% is the top marginal screening rate. It is not an effective rate; statutory deductions and the progressive calculation affect actual liability.

tax_brackets.threshold_local: Annual taxable income up to MZN 42,000
tax_brackets.notes: Annual bracket; no USD conversion used because a same-date official exchange-rate value was not extracted.
Marginal bracket.
Marginal bracket; separate non-resident withholding rules may also use 20%.
Marginal bracket.
Top marginal bracket and dashboard screening rate.

taxation_system.notes: The tax-residence rule was materially updated for 2026; the previous record’s 180-day formulation is no longer current.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: Not applicable as a route-specific regime because Mozambique has no confirmed digital-nomad or foreign-remote-worker visa. A person who nevertheless becomes resident on another lawful basis would generally enter the ordinary worldwide-income IRPS system.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: No digital-nomad route; ordinary resident or non-resident IRPS rules would apply on another lawful status.
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: 10%–32% progressive resident IRPS; 32% top marginal screening rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: From 2026, main residence, principal professional activity or center of economic interests—not a general 180-day test.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Tax residents are taxed on worldwide income; non-residents on Mozambique-source income.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None found.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: Local employees generally contribute 3% with 4% from the employer; locally registered self-employed workers generally bear 7%. Applicability to a foreign-contract arrangement requires classification and registration advice.

fixed_payments.status: No nomad-specific fixed payment. Locally registered self-employment can trigger a variable 7% INSS contribution.
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: Self-employed: 7% of conventional remuneration, with the contribution base subject to applicable minimum rules.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: The eVisa portal requires payment but no remote-worker fee exists because there is no such category; exact current visa fees were not exposed on the reviewed public pages.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: VAT/business registration obligations may arise if a person lawfully conducts taxable local economic activity; no nomad-specific municipal or freelancer flat tax was confirmed.
fixed_payments.notes: Amounts depend on sector, contribution base and legal classification. Sole-proprietor registration does not itself establish immigration eligibility.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: There is no longer a general day-count threshold whose non-exceedance guarantees non-residence. Main residence, professional activity or economic interests can establish residence regardless of days.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: On another lawful residence basis, worldwide foreign remote-work income would generally enter progressive IRPS up to 32%, subject to sourcing, deductions and treaty relief.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: If lawfully registered as self-employed, ordinary IRPS, accounting/filing rules and generally 7% INSS contributions can apply. Registration is not a substitute for immigration authorization.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: High confidence in ordinary tax rules; lower route-specific confidence because no lawful nomad route exists and contract classification is fact-dependent.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: No qualifying independent remote-work starting status exists. Employer, qualifying investment and specified family/religious/medical/volunteer grounds can support temporary residence.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: Permanent residence becomes available after qualifying temporary residence has been extended for more than ten consecutive years, provided the original reason continues. Business, border and humanitarian visas are excluded.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: Permanent residence is not stated as a separate prerequisite for naturalisation. Both general permanent residence and naturalisation use approximately ten years of qualifying residence, so eligibility may coincide; grant remains discretionary.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: At least ten years of habitual and regular residence before applying for ordinary naturalisation; this is unavailable from the rejected short-stay categories alone.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: The constitution and reviewed immigration/nationality materials publish no official processing-time standard.

key_conditions.value: For ordinary naturalisation: at least ten years of habitual and regular residence, age 18 or older, knowledge of Portuguese or a Mozambican language, capacity to support oneself, civic probity and statutory guarantees. The grant is discretionary rather than automatic.
key_conditions.notes: The reviewed constitutional text did not establish a general renunciation requirement, but current nationality-law filing requirements should be checked before relying on dual-nationality treatment.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: At least five years of marriage to a Mozambican citizen for nationality by declaration, except the constitution notes a statelessness exception.

existing_marriage_effect.value: An existing genuine marriage can count toward the five-year marriage duration. Once the duration and statutory guarantees are satisfied, the foreign spouse must declare the wish to acquire Mozambican nationality; acquisition is not automatic merely upon marriage.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: The constitution states that later annulment or dissolution does not prejudice nationality already acquired.

requirements_and_risks.value: The applicant must document the marriage, make the required declaration and satisfy guarantees fixed by law. Authorities may verify civil-status records and the marriage’s authenticity; sham or fraudulent documentation can lead to refusal and legal consequences. No separate accelerated permanent-residence period was confirmed.
requirements_and_risks.notes: Filing-level requirements should be verified with the civil registry or consulate.

birthright_citizenship.notes: The constitution broadly grants nationality to persons born in Mozambique after independence. The principal narrow exception concerns a child of two foreign parents when either parent is in Mozambique in service of that parent’s foreign state; that child can acquire nationality by a timely declaration.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: Yes, a child born in Mozambique to two migrant parents is generally Mozambican at birth. The narrow foreign-government-service exception applies when either foreign parent is serving that parent’s state in Mozambique.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: This corrects the contradictory previous record, which incorrectly said two foreign parents did not generally produce citizenship.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: Yes. A child born in Mozambique is generally Mozambican by territorial birth, and a child of a Mozambican parent born abroad can also acquire nationality by the constitution’s declaration rules.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: Foreign-birth registration/declaration formalities should be completed promptly.

parent_benefit_summary.value: A citizen child does not automatically make either foreign parent a Mozambican citizen. A family-based residence possibility may exist, but the reviewed official sources did not establish an automatic residence, permanent-residence or shortened naturalisation entitlement solely from parenthood.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: Filing-level verification with SENAMI is required for residence as the parent of a minor citizen.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: The migrant father does not acquire citizenship automatically through the child. Any family residence application would be separate, and ordinary naturalisation still requires its own conditions unless another statutory exception applies.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: No official source reviewed confirmed an automatic father-specific PR or citizenship shortcut.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank displayed when accessed; real-time rankings can change.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Strictly visa-free destinations in Passport Index’s separated breakdown.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Destinations classified as requiring a visa in advance.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: 31 visa-on-arrival plus 4 eTA destinations. Passport Index separately reports a mobility score of 67.

passport.notes: A separate 2026 Henley-based secondary summary reported rank 74 and access to 59 destinations without a prior visa, but Passport Index was selected because it publishes the requested visa-free, visa-on-arrival/eTA and visa-required breakdown consistently.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: English-only living is possible in some international-business, NGO and tourism settings, especially Maputo, but is not broadly practical for government processes or local integration. Mozambique ranked 84th with a score of 465 in EF EPI 2025, below the global average, while Portuguese is the sole official language.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: EF EPI is based on self-selected test takers and should be treated as an indicator, not a census.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Russian and Ukrainian have no official or documented broad administrative role. They should not be expected to work for immigration, taxation or ordinary local services; Portuguese assistance would normally be needed.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: No reliable national usage statistics for Russian or Ukrainian were found in the focused language search.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: No current national mean monthly worker salary is published in the checked official annual sources. The Ministry’s 2024 labour bulletin limits its remuneration table to sectoral minimum wages, and an ILO methodology note says no Mozambique wage observation was available in the wage databases it checked; the ILO therefore used a modelled labour-income-per-employed-person proxy, which is not reported here as observed salary.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: No current official national median monthly employee salary is published in the Ministry’s annual labour bulletin or INE’s statistical yearbook. IOF 2022 is household-based and cannot supply an individual-worker median.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Official amounts are available in MZN, but no same-date official USD conversion was extracted, so no approximate USD value is inserted.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: The checked publications do not provide a current national individual-worker mean that can be converted to USD. Sectoral minimum wages, household receipts and the ILO’s modelled labour-income proxy are not substituted for observed average salary.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Neither checked official annual publication reports a national median individual-worker monthly salary; IOF 2022 measures households rather than individual employee earnings.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: A meaningful maximum salary was not published. The highest sectoral minimum wage is not treated as a maximum observed salary.

min_salary_local_currency.value: MZN 4,991.09 per month, the lowest listed sectoral statutory minimum effective 1 July 2025
min_salary_local_currency.notes: This is the Kapenta-fishing statutory minimum, not an observed economy-wide minimum salary. Sectoral minima range up to MZN 19,043.61 for banks and insurers.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: The Ministry’s 2024 remuneration table contains sectoral statutory minimum wages, not mean earnings. INE’s IOF 2022 reports household-level receipts and expenses, which cannot be substituted for an individual employee average. The ILO methodology note says it found no Mozambique wage observation in the databases it checked and therefore used a modelled labour-income-per-employed-person proxy; that proxy is not inserted as an observed national average salary.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: The current Ministry annual bulletin and INE yearbook do not publish a national median employee salary, and IOF 2022 is household-based. No defensible national median MZN amount can be derived from those publications.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: Neither the official 2024 labour bulletin nor the 2025 minimum-wage schedule defines an upper bound for actual worker earnings. The highest sectoral statutory minimum is a wage floor, not a national maximum salary.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Sector-specific statutory gross monthly minimum wages only; national individual-worker mean and median earnings are unpublished in the checked current official annual labour/statistical publications, while IOF 2022 figures are household-level receipts and expenses.
average_citizen_salary.period: Minimum-wage schedule effective 2025-07-01; 2024 annual labour/statistical publications and IOF 2022 checked for broader earnings measures
average_citizen_salary.notes: The focused pass found no publishable national mean or median worker salary. The Ministry’s statistics catalogue contains quarterly 2025 labour-market bulletins, but its latest annual bulletin’s remuneration chapter reports only sectoral minimum wages. Household income/expenditure and modelled labour-income proxies are not relabelled as employee salary.

cost_of_living_note.value: Official INE data showed Mozambique CPI inflation of 7.51% year-on-year and 4.57% on a 12-month-average basis in June 2026. This indicates recent price movement but is not a complete household cost-of-living budget.
cost_of_living_note.notes: No official comparable monthly basket for a remote worker was identified.

settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: Tourist/business eVisas are short-stay categories and cannot be treated as remote-work residence or citizenship routes.
settlement_track.summary: Mozambique has a general ten-year route from qualifying residence toward permanent residence and naturalisation, but no fitting independent status from which this ordinary foreign-contract remote worker can start. Available work and investment routes require local employment/project authorization or substantial capital, while visitor/business status does not qualify for settlement.
settlement_track.notes: The general settlement rules should not be confused with eligibility for a starting residence category. Because no matching starting route exists, no applicant-specific citizenship year is stated.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: The current SENAMI portal lists tourist, business, investment and sector-specific work categories but no remote-worker category. Law 23/2022’s official embassy summary describes tourist and work visas, while the residence-visa checklist requires a later SENAMI/DIRE application based on a qualifying ground. The reviewed sources do not recognize a foreign software-services contract, foreign salary, local tax registration, bank account or sole-proprietor registration by itself as that ground; CMS’s Mozambique review likewise says cross-border mobile work has no specific Mozambican legislation. Accordingly, ordinary foreign-contract remote work is not a confirmed independent residence basis.

data.notes: Focused unresolved-field audit retained the high-confidence conclusion that Mozambique has no ordinary foreign-contract remote-worker residence route. It clarified that the generic residence visa is only an entry instrument requiring a separate accepted DIRE ground; added current official and specialist confirmation that no remote-worker category or specific cross-border mobile-work regime was identified; and replaced vague salary markers with explained nulls. The latest annual labour bulletin publishes sectoral minimum wages only, INE IOF 2022 is household-based, and the ILO’s available Mozambique figure is a modelled labour-income proxy rather than an observed average wage. Thirty distinct directly relevant canonical URLs are included, including six URLs absent from the previous source set.

data.selection_summary: Myanmar has no current digital-nomad, foreign-remote-worker, or ordinary independently sponsored residence route. Tourist status is visitor-only, while the business eVisa and eStay extension require a registered Myanmar company, company director, invitation or employment documents, and local organizational support. The selective expert permanent-residence category requires professional credentials, an appointment letter of at least one year, and three years of Myanmar stay; it is not a route for ordinary work under a foreign contract.

visa_application.title: Official Myanmar eVisa portal
visa_application.notes: This official portal accepts tourist and business eVisa applications only. It is provided as the official immigration starting point, not as a qualifying remote-worker application channel.

rejected_routes.route_name: Business eVisa and company-supported eStay extension

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No minimum monthly income is published because eligibility depends on a registered Myanmar inviting company and business or employment purpose, not foreign remote income.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No income threshold is published.

income_requirement_display.value: No published income threshold; registered Myanmar company and local business/employment basis required
income_requirement_display.notes: A foreign contract does not replace the invitation, company-registration, appointment, and extension-support requirements.

income_proof_months.notes: No remote-income history requirement is published.

key_requirements.requirement: Invitation from a registered and operating Myanmar company or registered chamber; the inviting company must provide registration, a recent DICA extract, and annual-return evidence.
The applicant must be officially appointed to work for the inviting company and act consistently with the invitation letter.

An eStay extension must be submitted by a registered Myanmar company and one of its listed directors; SME cases require licensing, inspection, and confirmation that the applicant is employed by the company.
Foreign-worker registration requires an employment contract, company registration, salary-tax receipt, and MIC or SEZ recommendation.
Commerce-linked extension recommendations require an updated employment contract, income-tax evidence, and board-backed company guarantee.

initial_validity.value: 70-day stay for a business eVisa
initial_validity.notes: The approval letter is valid for 90 days for entry; this is distinct from the permitted 70-day stay.

extension_rules.value: A business-visa holder may seek an eStay extension, but the registered Myanmar company must submit and support it. The official pages do not publish a guaranteed extension duration; the responsible scrutiny body determines it.
extension_rules.notes: The latest entry must be a business visa, the passport must generally retain at least six months' validity, and overstay or company-registration problems can make the online application ineligible.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: No independent temporary-residence permit results from this route; it is a company-supported business stay.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The official material calls it a stay extension and re-entry visa, not an independent residence status.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No automatic conversion. A foreign expert would have to qualify separately for the selective PR program, including professional evidence, a qualifying appointment letter, and three years of Myanmar visa-and-stay history.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The business eVisa itself does not create a confirmed entitlement to PR.

path_to_citizenship.value: No citizenship path is confirmed from business eVisa or eStay status. Myanmar's citizenship law does not provide an ordinary residence-years naturalization route for an unrelated post-1982 foreign applicant.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Naturalized citizenship is restricted to the statutory categories in sections 42, 43, and the grandfathered spouse provision in section 45.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because the route requires a locally registered inviting or employing company and is not compatible with ordinary independent foreign-contract remote work.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No minimum monthly income was published on the official service page.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No income threshold was published.

income_requirement_display.value: No published income threshold; expert credentials, Myanmar appointment, and prior stay required
income_requirement_display.notes: Absence of a stated income threshold does not make this an ordinary self-sponsored route.

income_proof_months.notes: No general income-history period was published.

key_requirements.requirement: Professional qualification or education certificate and evidence of career experience.
Appointment letter with a term of at least one year.
Evidence of three years of continuous Myanmar visa-and-stay history for the specialist category.
Passport, identity documents, health recommendation, photographs, residency facts, CV, signature, fingerprints, in-person filing or evaluation, and committee scrutiny.
USD 500 is payable to the Myanmar embassy after the application is accepted for processing under the published service steps.

initial_validity.value: Direct permanent-residence certificate and card if finally approved; the current government describes foreign PR as being granted for a defined period
initial_validity.notes: The exact card validity period was not established in the reviewed current official material.

extension_rules.notes: Current official sources confirmed active processing but did not clearly publish renewal duration or procedure.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: No direct temporary residence. The applicant must first accumulate qualifying Myanmar stay on another lawful basis.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: For experts, the service page requires three years of prior visa and stay evidence.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Direct PR is possible only after discretionary expert-category approval.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: This is selective committee-reviewed PR, not degree-based entitlement or an ordinary skilled-independent program.

path_to_citizenship.value: No ordinary PR-to-citizenship transition is established for this applicant. The 1982 law restricts naturalized-citizenship applications to specified ancestry, pre-1948 residence, and grandfathered-spouse categories.
path_to_citizenship.notes: PR should not be assumed to create naturalization eligibility.

rejected_routes.notes: Although an application can now be initiated in Myanmar or through a Myanmar embassy, the expert route still requires a local appointment and selective expert treatment. It therefore fails both the ordinary-remote-work and no-local-employer criteria.

summary.value: Myanmar's expert PR category recognizes professional or educational qualifications, but a degree alone is insufficient. It also requires career evidence, an appointment letter of at least one year, three years of Myanmar stay, and discretionary committee approval, so it is unavailable to the profile without a local appointment.
summary.notes: Direct PR is possible only for an approved applicant in the selective expert category; this is not a general qualification-based migration program.

tax_residency_rule.value: An individual foreigner is a resident foreigner when residing in Myanmar for at least 183 days during the income year.
tax_residency_rule.notes: Foreigners employed by qualifying Myanmar Investment Law companies may in some circumstances be taxed at resident rates regardless of stay duration.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate, not the expected effective rate. The official IRD index lists a 2026 Union Taxation Law effective 1 April 2026; the accessible English 2025 law and January 2026 tax summary show the same 0%-25% individual scale, but the Burmese 2026 text should be checked before filing.

social_contributions_percent.notes: Employee rate for the currently implemented health and social-care scheme; employer rate is 3% according to the current tax summary, with employee and employer monthly caps of MMK 6,000 and MMK 9,000. Additional statutory funds described in the rules depend on commencement notifications and employment structure.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: The employee social-security cap is MMK 6,000 monthly when the scheme applies, but a USD conversion is withheld because Myanmar has materially divergent official and market exchange rates.

special_tax_regimes.value: No special digital-nomad, remote-worker, non-dom, or inbound-worker regime was identified. Investment incentives relate to qualifying local investments and do not create an ordinary foreign-remote-worker regime.
special_tax_regimes.notes: Professional, salary, and business characterization can change the treatment.

taxes.caveats: The applicant has no qualifying immigration route, so this is a general tax screening rather than a route-specific filing conclusion. Work physically performed in Myanmar may raise Myanmar-source, business-registration, permanent-establishment, foreign-exchange, and immigration issues even before the 183-day residence threshold. Contract structure, the income heading, available relief, source rules, and any tax treaty must be reviewed professionally.

taxation_system.value: Progressive personal income tax with a top marginal rate of 25%. Resident foreigners are generally taxed on worldwide income, while non-resident foreigners are taxed on Myanmar-source income.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: At least 183 days in Myanmar during the income year for an individual foreigner.
taxation_system.income_scope: Resident foreigners: worldwide income. Non-resident foreigners: Myanmar-source income.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No digital-nomad or ordinary foreign-remote-worker tax regime identified.
taxation_system.social_security: Where the employment social-security scheme applies, the employee contribution is 2% and employer contribution 3%, capped at MMK 6,000 and MMK 9,000 per month respectively.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The accessible English Union Taxation Law applies 0%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% marginal brackets after applicable relief. Salary income up to MMK 4.8 million annually is not taxed, but when salary exceeds that amount the law states tax is charged on total income. Non-resident foreigners do not receive the ordinary personal reliefs.

tax_brackets.notes: USD conversion omitted because reliable conversion is impeded by divergent Myanmar exchange rates.
Top marginal rate used for dashboard screening.

taxation_system.notes: The official IRD index confirms a 2026 law exists and the government confirms it took effect on 1 April 2026. Because an accessible English rendering of its full individual bracket table was not recovered, brackets are reported from the official English 2025 law and cross-checked against the January 2026 PwC summary; filing-level confirmation of the Burmese 2026 law remains necessary.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: Not applicable as a special category: Myanmar has no dedicated digital-nomad or foreign-remote-worker status. If a foreigner nevertheless becomes taxable while working in Myanmar, general PIT rules can reach 25%.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: No digital-nomad category; general foreign-individual rules only
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: Up to 25% progressive PIT; top marginal screening rate, not expected effective tax
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: At least 183 days during the income year generally creates foreign-individual tax residence.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Resident foreigners are generally taxed on worldwide income; non-resident foreigners are generally taxed on Myanmar-source income.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None identified.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: No nomad-specific contributions. In covered local employment, employee social security is generally 2% and employer social security 3%, capped at MMK 6,000 and MMK 9,000 monthly.

fixed_payments.status: No nomad-specific fixed payment; employment contributions and visa fees depend on the separate local-company structure
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: Employee contribution capped at MMK 6,000 per month and employer contribution capped at MMK 9,000 per month where the scheme applies.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: Business eVisa and extension fees may apply; the reviewed official pages did not establish a single fixed monthly amount. Selective PR has a USD 500 initial application payment after acceptance.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: The 2025 Union Taxation Law states a MMK 20,000 commercial tax per sale and activation of a SIM card and 15% commercial tax on internet-service receipts; these are transaction or consumption taxes, not monthly nomad levies.
fixed_payments.notes: Mandatory health insurance, a freelancer flat tax, or a municipal nomad fee was not identified because no such route exists.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: Being below 183 days generally avoids resident-foreigner status, but does not automatically exempt Myanmar-source income or work physically performed in Myanmar. Immigration legality and source characterization require advice.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: A foreigner resident for tax purposes is generally exposed to worldwide-income taxation at progressive rates up to 25%, subject to characterization, relief, and treaty analysis.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: No fitting immigration path based on simple freelancer or sole-proprietor registration was confirmed. Local business or investment registration would create separate company, licensing, commercial-tax, and immigration obligations and cannot be treated as a tourist-to-freelancer conversion.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: This section is hypothetical because no valid digital-nomad route exists.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: No qualifying independent temporary-residence route exists. A 70-day business stay and company-supported extensions are not treated as direct temporary residence for this selection.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: The expert PR category requires three years of Myanmar visa-and-stay history. This is a selective threshold for a rejected local-appointment route, not a general entitlement or a valid remote-work timeline.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: The citizenship law establishes no ordinary number of years from PR to citizenship for an unrelated foreign applicant.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: No qualifying immigration-to-citizenship chain exists for the profile.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: No reliable official processing-time target was found. The Central Body makes the decision and the law does not publish a processing deadline.

key_conditions.value: The selective expert PR category requires qualifications, career evidence, a one-year appointment letter, three years of Myanmar stay, and committee approval. Naturalized citizenship is restricted to specific ancestry, pre-1948 residence, and grandfathered-spouse cases; a national language, good character, allegiance, and renunciation of foreign citizenship apply where naturalization is legally available.
key_conditions.notes: Myanmar does not permit dual citizenship under the reviewed law and current government statement.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: Two years of Myanmar visa-and-stay history is stated for a foreigner connected with local people in the PR service. This is a PR threshold, not a general citizenship shortcut.

existing_marriage_effect.value: A valid marriage contract may support the relative-to-Myanmar PR category after the published two-year stay threshold. For citizenship, marriage alone does not confer citizenship, and the statutory spouse-naturalization provision is limited to a person who already held a Foreigner's Registration Certificate before the 1982 law took effect.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: A new or already existing modern marriage should not be assumed to create citizenship eligibility under the grandfathered provision.

requirements_and_risks.value: PR applicants must document the lawful marriage and prior Myanmar stay and remain subject to administrative scrutiny. Citizenship is not automatic through marriage; the grandfathered naturalization provision also requires age 18, good character, sound mind, monogamy, three years' continuous residence as lawful spouse, allegiance, and renunciation of foreign citizenship. False documents or sham relationships create serious refusal, revocation, and criminal risks.
requirements_and_risks.notes: The boolean is true only because marriage can shorten the published selective PR stay threshold from three years for experts to two years for the locally related category; it does not indicate a generally available marriage-to-citizenship route.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Birth in Myanmar alone is insufficient. Citizenship or eligibility for naturalized citizenship depends on the parents' citizenship categories and ancestry; birth registration is also required.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A child born in Myanmar to two foreign migrant parents does not acquire citizenship merely from birthplace.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: The law has no broad jus soli rule.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: If one parent is a citizen and the other a foreigner, the child may apply for naturalized citizenship under sections 43 and 44 after reaching age 18 and meeting the national-language, good-character, and sound-mind conditions; citizenship is not automatic in this parent combination.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: Other combinations involving citizen, associate-citizen, naturalized-citizen, or qualifying descendants can produce different results under section 7.

parent_benefit_summary.value: Having a citizen or potentially naturalized-citizen child does not automatically grant the foreign parent residence, PR, or citizenship. Any family PR claim must independently fit the published relative category.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: No automatic parent-of-citizen naturalization provision was found.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: A migrant father receives no automatic citizenship from the child's status. If the mother is a Myanmar citizen and the father is foreign, the child may be eligible to apply for naturalized citizenship, but the father must pursue his own immigration or family PR basis.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: The child's eligibility should not be represented as automatic father citizenship or PR.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank displayed on the live Passport Index page on 2026-08-15; this differs from Henley's methodology and can change dynamically.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Visa-free destinations shown separately by Passport Index.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Destinations classified as visa required by Passport Index.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: Combined dashboard value: 35 visa-on-arrival plus 4 eTA destinations.

passport.notes: The same live source showed a mobility score of 54 and world reach of 27%. Passport indexes use different country universes and category definitions, so these figures should not be mixed with a Henley rank or score.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: English can help in international business and online work, but Myanmar language is the sole constitutional official language; government procedures and much local administration should be expected to require Myanmar-language assistance.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: No current nationwide English-proficiency score was relied upon, so this is a cautious practical assessment rather than a measured proficiency ranking.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: No reliable country-specific evidence established broad practical use of Russian or Ukrainian. Applicants should expect to rely on Myanmar language or, in some international-business settings, English.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: The official wage figure is from the 2019 labour-force data summarized in a 2021–2022 bulletin. A USD conversion is withheld because it would be stale and highly sensitive to Myanmar's divergent official and market exchange rates.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: No current official national median wage was located.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: The current statutory amount is daily, not monthly, and USD conversion is unreliable because of multiple materially divergent MMK exchange rates.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No defensible current USD conversion is provided.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: A current national median was not published in the reviewed official statistical material.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No meaningful national maximum wage is published.

min_salary_local_currency.value: MMK 7,800 per eight-hour day, including MMK 3,000 of cumulative daily allowances; equivalent to MMK 202,800 for 26 paid days
min_salary_local_currency.notes: Effective 1 October 2025. This does not apply to small or family-owned businesses with fewer than ten workers, and the 26-day monthly equivalent is arithmetic rather than an official monthly minimum.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: Official national average monthly income based on 2019 labour-force data, reproduced in the 2021–2022 Q2 statistical bulletin. It is retained as the best official figure found but is too stale for present-day budgeting.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: No current official median was established.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: No meaningful national maximum was established.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Statutory daily minimum for the minimum field; national average monthly income for the average field
average_citizen_salary.period: Minimum effective 2025-10-01; average based on 2019 labour-force data
average_citizen_salary.notes: The minimum is current but is a statutory floor. The average is official but old. Myanmar's exchange-rate distortions make current USD comparisons misleading, so USD fields remain explained nulls.

cost_of_living_note.notes: The official statistics portal provides consumer-price material, but no sufficiently current, comparable national remote-worker cost-of-living budget was established. A crowdsourced estimate was not substituted for official evidence.

settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: Myanmar's tourist and business eVisas are visitor or company-supported business statuses, not digital-nomad residence permits. Time on them does not create a confirmed ordinary settlement entitlement.
settlement_track.summary: Ordinary business stay requires a locally registered inviting or employing company. Expert PR is selective and requires a local appointment plus three years of Myanmar stay, while the citizenship law provides no normal PR-to-naturalization route for an unrelated foreign remote worker.
settlement_track.notes: Switching to the rejected expert PR category would still not establish a confirmed citizenship track and would require facts outside the applicant's ordinary foreign-contract profile.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: The official online categories are tourist and business only. Business entry and extension require a registered Myanmar company and local appointment or employment support; a foreign client contract alone is insufficient.

data.notes: Audit of the previous record preserved its ineligibility conclusion but strengthened it with current 2026 official PR activity, the precise business-eVisa and eStay requirements, statutory citizenship categories, current passport data, current minimum-wage allowances, social-security caps, and tax brackets. More than 15 distinct directly relevant URLs were inspected. Remaining nulls are retained where no reliable current figure, duration, processing target, or USD conversion could be established.

data.selection_summary: Namibia has an independently filed permanent-residence application based on sufficient means and/or qualifications, education, training or experience. It does not expressly require employer sponsorship and directly grants permanent residence, but approval is highly discretionary, considers whether the intended occupation is adequately supplied locally, and does not expressly accommodate ordinary foreign-client remote work. It is therefore a qualification-based partial match. The Digital Nomad Visa fits foreign remote work but lasts only six months, is non-renewable, prohibits a change of condition, and does not provide qualifying naturalisation residence.

visa_application.title: Permanent Residence Permit
visa_application.notes: The official permit page provides the permanent-residence checklist. The prescribed application is submitted to the Chief of Immigration; no dedicated online PR submission portal was confirmed. MHAISS publishes a six-month processing target, but approval remains discretionary.

best_routes.route_name: Permanent Residence Permit based on sufficient means or qualifications

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The law requires sufficient means or the ability to earn sufficient means but publishes no numerical minimum.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No fixed NAD income or asset threshold is published.

income_requirement_display.value: No published minimum; prove sufficient means, income and/or relevant qualifications
income_requirement_display.notes: The Immigration Selection Board evaluates the applicant’s means, qualifications, intended occupation, desirability and local labour availability.

income_proof_months.notes: The official checklist requests proof of financial resources, assets and own income but specifies no fixed bank-statement period.

key_requirements.requirement: Apply on the prescribed permanent-residence form to the Chief of Immigration; the Immigration Selection Board decides the application.
Show good character, likely assimilation, desirability, sufficient means or suitable qualifications, education, training or experience.
Satisfy the Board that the intended employment, business, profession or occupation is not already adequately supplied in Namibia.
Provide passport, photographs, medical and radiological reports, police clearances, deed of surety, CV, work references, financial-resource evidence and the training/experience questionnaire.
Pay N$20,000 after approval.

initial_validity.value: Permanent residence; permit must normally be activated by entry within 6 months
initial_validity.notes: Before acquisition of domicile, the permit may lapse after a continuous absence exceeding two years or permanent departure unless a longer absence is authorised.

extension_rules.value: No routine renewal; permanent status is subject to statutory lapse and cancellation rules
extension_rules.notes: A PR re-entry visa is issued separately for up to two years.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: None required; this is a direct permanent-residence application.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Direct permanent residence if the Immigration Selection Board approves the independently submitted application.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: MHAISS publishes a six-month processing target. Approval is not an entitlement; the 2023/24 annual report recorded 313 approvals and 869 refusals among 1,182 processed PR applications.

path_to_citizenship.value: Naturalisation may be requested after 10 years of qualifying ordinary residence by virtue of permanent residence.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Naturalisation remains discretionary and requires good character, lawful residence, citizenship knowledge, continued-residence intent and willingness to renounce other citizenship.

best_routes.notes: This is an independent qualification/sufficient-means route that directly grants PR, but it is not an ordinary digital-nomad route. A foreign software contract may help prove means, yet official sources do not confirm that continuing exclusively foreign-client work satisfies the Board’s occupational and local-labour criteria. Filing-level advice is warranted.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: Additional required monthly amounts are USD 1,000 for an accompanying spouse and USD 500 for each accompanying child.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The official threshold is denominated in USD rather than NAD.

income_requirement_display.value: USD 2,000/month applicant + USD 1,000 spouse + USD 500 per child

income_proof_months.notes: The official page requires a six-month bank statement.

key_requirements.requirement: Be a remote employee, freelancer or self-employed professional working for companies or clients outside Namibia.
Provide passport, health or travel insurance, medical certificate, radiological report, police clearance, employer motivation, employment contract or payslip and qualifications.
Obtain NIPDB motivation and formal MHAISS approval; the N$3,300 visa fee is payable upon approval.

initial_validity.value: 6 months
initial_validity.notes: It is a temporary remote-work stay.

extension_rules.value: Non-renewable; a new application is allowed only 12 months after expiry
extension_rules.notes: The route expressly prohibits a change of condition.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Direct six-month permission to live in Namibia and perform foreign remote work.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: A separate section 26 permanent-residence application is legally available based on means or qualifications and the Immigration Selection Board assessment. A digital-nomad visa does not need to accumulate a PR residence period.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: NIPDB prohibits changes of condition on the nomad visa, while section 26(6) generally permits PR applications by persons already lawfully admitted. Their application together to this visa is not clarified, so exit requirements and approval for foreign-only remote work remain uncertain. Zero years denotes no statutory residence waiting period, not guaranteed approval.

path_to_citizenship.notes: The Citizenship Act excludes periods during which an applicant had a right to reside only under a temporary immigration permit.

rejected_routes.notes: This is a strong temporary fit for the applicant’s foreign contract, but it fails the citizenship-oriented selection because it is non-renewable, cannot be changed to another condition and does not accrue qualifying naturalisation residence.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The official permit page publishes no general salary threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No general minimum salary is stated.

income_requirement_display.value: No general published salary threshold
income_requirement_display.notes: Employer sponsorship and labour-market evidence are the decisive requirements.

income_proof_months.notes: The employment-permit checklist does not prescribe a fixed income-proof period.

key_requirements.requirement: Local work offer, employer representation, company profile, vacancy advertising, local-candidate evidence and Social Security registration.
Medical and radiological reports, police clearance, passport, surety and professional registration where applicable.

initial_validity.value: 1 year
initial_validity.notes: MHAISS publishes a one-to-two-month processing target.

extension_rules.value: Renewable annually while employer-specific requirements continue to be met
extension_rules.notes: Renewal requires employer motivation, tax evidence, local recruitment and skills-transfer evidence.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Direct employer-specific temporary employment permit.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: A separate discretionary PR application may be submitted, but an employment permit does not automatically mature into PR.

path_to_citizenship.value: Only through a separately obtained qualifying status and the naturalisation rules.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because it requires a Namibian employer, work offer and labour-market evidence.

rejected_routes.route_name: Visitor entry followed by sole-proprietor or self-employment registration

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: A numerical income threshold is inapplicable because no tourist-to-self-employment legalisation route was established.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: A numerical income threshold is inapplicable because business registration does not confer residence or work permission.

income_requirement_display.value: No legalisation route established
income_requirement_display.notes: Business registration alone does not confer immigration permission to work or reside.

income_proof_months.notes: No income-proof period applies because this is not a recognised immigration route.

key_requirements.requirement: A visitor permit does not authorise employment, conducting a business, or carrying on a profession or occupation where an employment permit is required.
A person lawfully present may separately apply for PR under section 26, but approval is discretionary and not a tourist-to-self-employment conversion entitlement.

initial_validity.value: Visitor permission only
initial_validity.notes: Visitor status is not a work or settlement status.

extension_rules.value: Visitor extensions do not create self-employment or residence rights

path_to_temporary_residence.notes: Registering a business or bank account does not itself legalise work.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Only through a separate section 26 PR application assessed on its own merits.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: No guaranteed in-country conversion was identified.

path_to_citizenship.notes: Visitor and temporary-permit periods are excluded from naturalisation residence.

rejected_routes.notes: The enter-as-tourist, register, then legalise scenario is not a valid route. The independently filed PR route must be assessed separately.

summary.value: Admission to a recognised Namibian educational institution permits an independent student-permit application without a local employer. The permit is issued yearly and can be renewed with registration and progress evidence, but it is temporary, does not directly grant PR, and temporary-permit time is excluded from naturalisation residence. Separately, relevant qualifications can support the discretionary direct PR route.
summary.notes: Study is not a citizenship shortcut; a separate PR application must independently satisfy section 26.

tax_residency_rule.value: Namibia uses a source-based system rather than a day-count residence test. Income derived or deemed derived from Namibia is taxable; where the income-producing work is performed matters more than where payment is made.
tax_residency_rule.notes: There is no general domestic 183-day safe harbour. Services physically performed from Namibia may be Namibian-source even when the employer or client and bank account are foreign.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate, not the expected effective rate. The first N$100,000 of annual taxable income is taxed at 0% under the latest captured table.

social_contributions_percent.notes: For a covered employee, the employee and employer each contribute 0.9% of basic monthly wage. From 1 March 2025, each share is subject to a N$4.50 monthly minimum and N$99 maximum, corresponding to the prescribed N$500–N$11,000 wage band. Section 20 of the Social Security Act makes employer/employee registration compulsory but allows a self-employed person with no employees to register voluntarily; if registered, section 21 requires that person to pay both shares. The DNV page does not specify SSC treatment, and the Act excludes independent contractors from its employee definition, so mandatory coverage of a foreign-employed or independent-contractor DNV holder cannot be inferred without classification-specific guidance.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: No universal mandatory fixed monthly tax or social-security payment applies to every DNV holder. Covered employment has percentage contributions bounded by fixed NAD minimum and maximum amounts; voluntary self-employed registration entails both shares. Mandatory health/travel insurance has no official fixed premium, while the DNV fee is a one-time N$3,300.

special_tax_regimes.value: No digital-nomad tax exemption, remittance-basis concession or inbound-worker holiday was identified. Namibia’s ordinary source rules apply.
special_tax_regimes.notes: Treaty relief depends on the relevant treaty; Namibia has no general unilateral foreign-tax-credit provision.

taxes.caveats: Remote services performed while physically in Namibia can be treated as Namibian-source despite foreign payment. Confirm employee-versus-independent-contractor classification, foreign-employer payroll or permanent-establishment exposure, treaty relief, VAT or imported-service consequences, and SSC coverage before working. The published rate table should be rechecked for the precise filing year.

taxation_system.value: Progressive personal income tax on Namibian-source or deemed-source income, with rates from 0% to 37%.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Source, rather than residence or a 183-day test, is the primary charging basis.
taxation_system.income_scope: Namibian-source and deemed Namibian-source income; certain foreign income can be deemed Namibian-source.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No special digital-nomad or general inbound remote-worker exemption confirmed.
taxation_system.social_security: For covered employees, employee and employer each contribute 0.9% of basic monthly wage, subject from March 2025 to N$4.50 minimum and N$99 maximum per party. A self-employed person without employees may register voluntarily and, if registered, pays both shares.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The dashboard’s 37% figure is the top marginal rate, applying only to taxable annual income above N$1,550,000. It is not an effective rate.

tax_brackets.notes: Approximate USD conversion uses the Bank of Namibia’s May 2026 average of about N$16.48/USD.

tax_brackets.applies_to: Excess over N$150,000; base tax N$9,000
Excess over N$350,000; base tax N$59,000
Excess over N$550,000; base tax N$115,000
Excess over N$850,000; base tax N$205,000
Excess over N$1,550,000; base tax N$429,000
tax_brackets.notes: Top marginal bracket.

taxation_system.notes: NamRA supplies the official brackets; PwC’s Namibia pages, reviewed 16 July 2026, clarify source and treaty treatment. The PwC table is labelled for 1 March 2025 through February 2026, while the official NamRA bracket publication remains the latest captured rate table. Current SSC amounts are supported by the Act plus the February 2025 statutory update; the underlying contribution regulations should still be checked when classifying a non-local employment arrangement.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: The DNV has no confirmed tax holiday. Foreign-paid compensation may be taxable when the services producing it are performed in Namibia under Namibia’s source-based rules. If taxable, progressive rates up to 37% apply.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: digital_nomad
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: 0%–37% progressive tax on Namibian-source income; 37% is the top marginal screening rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: No general day-count threshold controls liability; source of the income-producing activity is central.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Foreign payment is not automatically exempt. Income genuinely arising outside Namibia is generally outside scope, but remote services performed from Namibia may have a Namibian source.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None confirmed.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: No DNV-specific official guidance confirms mandatory SSC registration for a foreign employer, foreign employee or independent contractor using the six-month visa. Covered employees and employers each pay 0.9%, bounded at N$4.50–N$99 monthly per party from March 2025. A self-employed person without employees may register voluntarily and then pays both shares.

fixed_payments.status: partially_confirmed
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: No mandatory DNV-specific fixed contribution is published. If SSC employment coverage applies, each 0.9% share is bounded at N$4.50–N$99 monthly; a voluntarily registered sole self-employed person pays both shares.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: N$3,300 once, payable upon DNV approval. PR costs N$20,000 if the separate PR application is approved.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: No fixed freelancer tax was identified. Business carried on in Namibia is taxable, and VAT or imported-service rules may apply depending on registration and transaction structure; no route-specific fixed VAT payment is published.
fixed_payments.notes: Mandatory health or travel insurance has no published minimum premium.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: A short stay is not automatically tax-free because Namibia does not use residence as its primary charging test. Analyse where the services are performed and any applicable treaty.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: Ordinary residence alone does not create a worldwide-income system, but Namibian-source and deemed-source income remains taxable. Remote work physically performed in Namibia can create filing and payroll issues.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: Business activities carried on in Namibia are taxable. A sole self-employed person without employees may voluntarily register for SSC and pay both shares; employing staff triggers employer obligations. VAT treatment requires transaction-specific review.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: Tax and SSC treatment is not stated on the DNV page, so the conclusion applies ordinary current source and social-security rules. Obtain Namibian tax and payroll advice before performing services from Namibia.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: The selected partial-match route applies directly for permanent residence; no temporary-residence stage is required.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: This is a direct PR application. MHAISS publishes a six-month processing target, but approval is discretionary and not guaranteed.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: MHAISS describes naturalisation as requiring ten years of ordinary residence by virtue of PR.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: Approximately ten years from the start of qualifying PR residence, plus application processing. DNV, visitor and other temporary-permit time does not count.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: The official service charter targets three months for marriage, registration and naturalisation applications after receipt of the required renunciation letter; actual discretionary processing can vary.

key_conditions.value: Maintain qualifying ordinary residence under PR; show lawful residence, good character, health and security compliance, adequate citizenship knowledge, intention to continue residing, tax and residence confirmation, police clearances, character references and willingness to renounce foreign citizenship. Temporary-permit and visitor time is excluded.
key_conditions.notes: Naturalisation is in the Minister’s absolute discretion, and refusal need not be accompanied by reasons.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: Citizenship by marriage requires at least ten years of ordinary residence in Namibia as the spouse following a good-faith marriage. This is not shorter than the current general ten-year naturalisation period.

existing_marriage_effect.value: An existing good-faith marriage matters because qualifying ordinary residence as the citizen’s spouse after the marriage can accumulate toward the ten-year marriage route; marriage alone does not confer citizenship or eliminate residence requirements.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: The official checklist requests marriage and birth records, residence confirmation, tax confirmation and police clearances.

requirements_and_risks.value: The marriage must be genuine and maintained in good faith, with ten years of ordinary residence as spouse and a formal application. Authorities require documentary residence and relationship evidence. Sham marriage, false statements or fabricated cohabitation can cause refusal and immigration or criminal consequences.
requirements_and_risks.notes: No automatic citizenship arises on marriage.

birthright_citizenship.notes: A child born in Namibia after independence is a citizen if a parent is Namibian or ordinarily resident, subject to exclusions for diplomatic or foreign-government service and illegal immigration; anti-statelessness protection overrides those exclusions.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A Namibia-born child can acquire citizenship where at least one migrant parent is ordinarily resident at birth and the constitutional exclusions do not apply. Temporary presence alone is not necessarily ordinary residence; a six-month DNV should not be assumed sufficient.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: The Supreme Court has held that ordinary residence is a factual concept and is not identical to permanent residence.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: If either parent is a Namibian citizen, a child born in Namibia is a citizen by birth. A child born abroad can acquire citizenship by descent subject to registration requirements.

parent_benefit_summary.value: Having a Namibian citizen child does not automatically grant the migrant father residence, PR or citizenship. The relationship may be relevant to a separately assessed family or constitutional application, but no automatic parent-of-citizen route was confirmed.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: Section 26 expressly covers certain family members of a permanent resident, but it does not create automatic citizenship for a citizen child’s foreign parent.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: No automatic citizenship or residence benefit. The father must retain or obtain an independent lawful status and may need individual legal advice concerning family-life rights.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: Childbirth should not be treated as an immigration conversion mechanism.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank on the Passport Index Namibia dashboard, checked 15 August 2026.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Passport Index’s visa-free category, excluding visa on arrival and eTA.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Passport Index category.
