settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: The statutory Digital Residence is capped at 12 months, has no currently confirmed application channel, and has no confirmed conversion to permanent residence. Temporary immigration time normally does not count toward citizenship without ministerial consent.
settlement_track.summary: The 2021 statute contemplates foreign employees, freelancers, independent contractors, and consultants, but its operative eligibility wording is inconsistent and no current application channel could be verified. The status is temporary, and neither permanent-residence conversion nor counting toward citizenship is confirmed, so it is not a citizenship-path route.
settlement_track.notes: General permanent residence after seven years plus substantial assets and investment citizenship are separate routes that do not cure the ordinary remote-worker mismatch.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: The statute expressly contemplates freelancers, independent contractors, and consultants, but its operative clause is drafted around full-time foreign employment. With no current official application channel or implementing guidance and no settlement conversion, the route cannot presently be treated as an available ordinary foreign-contract citizenship-path fit.

data.notes: Thirty-one distinct relevant URLs were inspected across the previous and focused passes, including six URLs absent from the previous source set covering immigration administration, social-security law and coverage, labour-force income collection, and official salary scales. Primary law establishes Digital Residence and expressly contemplates freelancers, but no replacement programme portal, fee schedule, route-specific tax guidance, or settlement conversion was found. Exact general social-security rates and the public-service salary ceiling are now stated; the national median remains null because the named current sources publish no estimate.

data.selection_summary: Saint Lucia does not currently offer a dedicated digital-nomad, foreign-remote-worker, or residence-oriented freelance visa for an ordinary software engineer working under a foreign contract. The 2021 Live It initiative was an extended visitor programme that permitted remote work during a tourism stay, not a residence permit; no current Live It application channel or conversion into permanent residence was found. General work permits, nationality-restricted Caribbean free-movement rights, and citizenship by investment do not provide a matching route for this profile.

visa_application.title: Issuance of Non-Immigrant Visas to Foreigners
visa_application.notes: This is the official non-immigrant visa information page, not a digital-nomad or residence application. It lists tourist, business and student visa fees and links to a downloadable form. No current dedicated Live It or remote-worker application was found in the official visitor services reviewed.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The 2021 announcement did not publish a minimum income threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No minimum in East Caribbean dollars was published.

income_requirement_display.value: No published minimum income; this was a visitor programme, not a residence route
income_requirement_display.notes: Applicants were visitors arranging an extended tourism stay through a programme specialist.

income_proof_months.notes: The programme announcement prescribed no income-history period.

key_requirements.requirement: Meet ordinary visitor entry requirements, including a passport and return travel arrangements.
The 2021 programme paired participants with a local tourism specialist and hotel or villa accommodation.

initial_validity.value: Up to six weeks as initially promoted
initial_validity.notes: This matched the ordinary maximum visitor admission described by the government.

extension_rules.value: The 2021 programme promoted the possibility of requesting an extension for a longer stay, reportedly up to one year.
extension_rules.notes: No active standalone extension rules or current Live It application channel were found in the official services reviewed in August 2026.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: None confirmed; an extended visitor stay is not a temporary residence permit.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The official announcement describes visitors and remote working during an extended vacation.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No conversion from Live It or visitor status was found.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The Immigration Act recognizes permanent residents but the reviewed materials do not create a Live It conversion route.

path_to_citizenship.value: No route-specific path; naturalisation requires qualifying residence under separate citizenship law.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Section 8 requires qualifying residence for naturalisation, while the Live It announcement describes participants as visitors on an extended vacation. Neither source classifies Live It visitor time as statutory residence, and no route-specific conversion or counting rule was identified.

rejected_routes.notes: Live It fit foreign remote work only as a temporary visitor lifestyle arrangement. It was announced in 2021, has no current dedicated application channel in the official portal reviewed, grants no residence status, and is not a citizenship-path match.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The general work-permit provision prescribes no income threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No general minimum income threshold or wage formula is stated.

income_requirement_display.value: No published general income threshold in the reviewed work-permit provision
income_requirement_display.notes: Labour Act section 318 requires the prescribed form, fee and any required information, but publishes no wage, salary or monthly-income test. Any class-specific filing terms must be confirmed with the Labour Department.

income_proof_months.notes: Section 318 does not prescribe an income-history or bank-statement period; class-specific evidence remains discretionary or prescribed elsewhere.

key_requirements.requirement: Submit a prescribed work-permit application with the prescribed fee and information required by the Minister.
A foreign national may not work for reward or profit without a valid work permit or exemption.
A separate lawful immigration permission is still necessary; a work permit is not itself permanent residence.

initial_validity.notes: The general statutory provision does not state a uniform duration.

extension_rules.notes: No uniform renewal period is stated in the reviewed general provision.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: No automatic temporary residence was confirmed from the work permit itself.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: Employment authorization and immigration status must be treated separately.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No automatic permanent-residence conversion was found.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Permanent residence exists as a legal status, but the reviewed official material did not publish a standard work-permit-to-PR timeline.

path_to_citizenship.value: Potentially only after separately qualifying residence satisfying the citizenship law.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Naturalisation is discretionary and not guaranteed by holding a work permit.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because no dedicated foreign-contract remote-work category was found. Although the Labour Act permits an applicant to submit a work-permit request, the route authorizes work and does not establish an independently documented remote-worker residence-to-settlement pathway. Whether a local employer is required depends on the permit category and needs filing-level confirmation.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: Eligibility is based on a qualifying investment and fees, not monthly income.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No monthly-income test applies.

income_requirement_display.value: Substantial qualifying investment and programme fees required; no monthly-income threshold
income_requirement_display.notes: Current investment options and amounts must be verified directly with the programme before filing.

income_proof_months.notes: The route uses due diligence and source-of-funds evidence rather than a prescribed monthly income-history period.

key_requirements.requirement: Qualifying investment, due diligence, source-of-funds documentation and processing through the Citizenship by Investment Unit and authorized programme channels.

initial_validity.value: Direct citizenship if approved
initial_validity.notes: This is not a residence visa.

extension_rules.value: Not applicable to citizenship

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Not applicable
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The programme is not a temporary-residence route.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: Not applicable
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The programme provides citizenship rather than a preliminary PR status.

path_to_citizenship.value: Direct citizenship after qualifying investment and approval
path_to_citizenship.notes: Excluded from selection because substantial investment is required.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because this profile excludes investor and citizenship-by-investment routes. It is not an ordinary foreign-contract remote-worker option and applications are handled through specialized programme channels.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: The reviewed regional-mobility and establishment information publishes no monthly-income threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No income threshold is published; eligibility is nationality- and category-based.

income_requirement_display.value: No published income threshold; eligibility depends primarily on qualifying Caribbean nationality and status
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: Nationality-restricted; bank reference required for CSME establishment
income_requirement_display.notes: A university degree alone is insufficient for a national of a non-participating country.

income_proof_months.notes: No monthly income-history test applies in the published regional-mobility material. The official CSME right-of-establishment service asks for a bank reference, qualifications and a business description, but states no number of months of earnings or bank statements.

key_requirements.requirement: Citizenship of a participating CARICOM or OECS state and, where applicable, a recognized CSME skills category or certificate.
The university-graduate category is nationality-restricted; it is not a global degree-based immigration programme.
For the CSME right of establishment, the official service lists a passport, character certificate, bank reference, qualifications, business plan or proposal, and recommendation; it publishes no fee.

initial_validity.value: Up to six months under reciprocal OECS/CARICOM entry provisions, with broader rights available to qualifying regional nationals under applicable arrangements
initial_validity.notes: Exact rights depend on nationality and the specific regional instrument.

extension_rules.value: Qualifying OECS nationals may obtain indefinite-stay rights under the regional free-movement regime; CSME skills procedures depend on the applicant's category.
extension_rules.notes: This must be verified based on the applicant's nationality.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Possible only for qualifying nationals of participating Caribbean states.
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: Not a route open to ordinary third-country applicants.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No generally applicable direct PR grant was established for a non-participating-country applicant.
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Indefinite regional stay rights should not be assumed to equal domestic permanent residence.

path_to_citizenship.value: Any eventual citizenship would depend on separately satisfying registration or naturalisation law.
path_to_citizenship.notes: Regional mobility does not itself grant Saint Lucian citizenship.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected for the general applicant profile because these rights are restricted to nationals of participating Caribbean states. A relevant university degree does not make a non-CARICOM national eligible.

summary.value: Saint Lucia participates in CARICOM and OECS mobility arrangements that can benefit qualifying regional nationals, including certain university graduates, without ordinary work-permit sponsorship. This is nationality-restricted and is not an independent degree-based residence route open to an ordinary third-country software engineer. No general qualification-only route granting permanent residence was found.
summary.notes: Availability and temporary-residence treatment cannot be answered without the applicant's nationality; a degree by itself is insufficient.

tax_residency_rule.value: An individual is resident if their permanent place of abode is in Saint Lucia and they are physically present for some part of the income year, if they are physically present for at least 183 days in the income year, or under the statutory continuity rule linking presence across adjacent income years.
tax_residency_rule.notes: The 183-day test is not the only residence test.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate on annual chargeable income, not an expected effective rate.

social_contributions_percent.notes: NIC states that employees contribute 5% with 5% from the employer, while participating self-employed or voluntary contributors use 10% of an agreed stipulated amount. NIC also says self-employed participation is not obligatory, so 10% is not a universal mandatory remote-worker charge.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: No universal fixed monthly payment applies. A participating self-employed NIC contribution is percentage-based on an agreed amount rather than a single fixed charge.

special_tax_regimes.value: No current digital-nomad tax exemption or special inbound remote-worker regime was found.
special_tax_regimes.notes: Live It was presented as a tourism programme and its announcement did not establish a tax holiday.

taxes.caveats: Tax treatment depends on physical presence, permanent-home and continuity tests, whether foreign remote-service income is considered Saint Lucia-source, whether the individual is an employee or independent contractor, and any applicable treaty. The absence of a matching immigration route does not prevent tax residence or local-source obligations from arising.

taxation_system.value: Progressive personal income tax. The published schedule applies 10%, 15%, 20% and 30% marginal rates to annual chargeable-income slices. Residents can be taxed on income from sources inside and outside Saint Lucia under the statutory framework; nonresident status and income sourcing require individual analysis.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Residence can arise through a permanent-place-of-abode test, at least 183 days of physical presence, or the statutory adjacent-year continuity rule.
taxation_system.income_scope: Residents are generally within the tax framework for income from sources in and outside Saint Lucia; nonresidents are principally taxed on Saint Lucia-source income. Remote-service sourcing and treaty treatment require professional confirmation.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No special digital-nomad or Live It tax regime was found. A 2026 IRD publication describes updated personal allowances and deductions, but not a nomad exemption.
taxation_system.social_security: NIC describes a 5% employee contribution matched by 5% from the employer. For participating self-employed or voluntary contributors, the FAQ states 10% of an agreed stipulated amount and also says self-employed participation is not obligatory.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The dashboard's 30% figure is a top marginal screening rate, not the effective rate on gross income. Allowances and deductions, including changes described by IRD for the 2025 income year, affect taxable income.

tax_brackets.applies_to: First EC$10,000 of annual chargeable income
tax_brackets.notes: Approximate USD conversion uses the EC$2.70 per US$1 currency peg.

tax_brackets.applies_to: Chargeable-income slice above EC$10,000 through EC$20,000
tax_brackets.notes: USD figure represents the approximate upper threshold.

tax_brackets.applies_to: Chargeable-income slice above EC$20,000 through EC$30,000
tax_brackets.notes: USD figure represents the approximate upper threshold.
Top marginal rate, not the rate on all income.

taxation_system.notes: Official IRD and NIC sources support the general framework. Exact liability for foreign remote work needs advice on residence, source, employment classification, deductions and treaty position.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: No dedicated digital-nomad tax category exists because no current dedicated nomad residence status was found. A person who stays long enough or otherwise meets a residence test may enter the ordinary progressive tax system.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: Ordinary visitor or taxpayer rules; no dedicated nomad category
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: Up to 30% marginal personal income tax; not a flat or expected effective rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: Potential residence through permanent abode, 183 days, or statutory continuity across adjacent years.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Resident worldwide-income treatment may apply; service-income sourcing and treaty relief must be confirmed for the specific foreign contract.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None found.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: NIC describes 5% employee plus 5% employer contributions. Self-employed or voluntary participation is described as 10% of an agreed amount, while the FAQ also states that it is not obligatory for a self-employed person.

fixed_payments.status: No universal fixed monthly tax or social-security payment confirmed
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: No fixed amount; potentially 10% of an agreed stipulated amount for a participating self-employed contributor.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: The official Washington service page lists US$30 for a tourist visa, US$35 for a business visa, US$25 for a student visa and US$10 for passport return. Fees depend on nationality and application location; these are not nomad-visa fees.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: No universal remote-worker transaction tax applies. If the person actually registers a local business name as an individual, the published one-time Registry charge is EC$125 plus an EC$2.50 stamp. IRD tax-account registration is fee-free; VAT is transaction-based rather than fixed, with a published EC$400,000 annual taxable-supplies threshold and 12.5% standard rate. These local-business charges do not themselves authorize immigration or work.
fixed_payments.notes: The business-name fee and stamp apply only if a local business name is registered. VAT depends on taxable activity and turnover; document-specific stamp duty can apply to listed legal instruments, but no single recurring amount applies to an ordinary foreign remote worker.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: Fewer than 183 days does not automatically guarantee nonresidence because permanent-abode and continuity tests also exist. Saint Lucia-source income may remain taxable even for a nonresident.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: A resident should expect ordinary progressive taxation up to a 30% marginal rate, subject to deductions, income sourcing, treaty relief and employment classification.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: Local self-employment requires IRD registration and may involve business-name registration and VAT if the taxable-supplies threshold is met. NIC describes 10% of an agreed amount for participating self-employed contributors but says participation is not obligatory; immigration authorization remains separate.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: The tax analysis is cautious because Live It did not create a statutory nomad tax category and no matching current immigration status exists.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: No current ordinary foreign-contract remote-worker route granting temporary residence was found.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: The reviewed official material did not establish a standard visitor or work-permit conversion timeline to permanent residence.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: Naturalisation law is based on qualifying residence rather than a clearly stated number of years after obtaining permanent residence.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: For an alien using a separate qualifying residence basis, section 8 ordinarily requires more than 12 months of residence immediately before application plus at least seven aggregate years of residence or government service during the preceding seven years. This is an approximately eight-year statutory residence pattern, is discretionary, and does not mean Live It visitor time qualifies.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: The government service page lists two months after submission in Saint Lucia, but actual naturalisation cases may vary and the page provides limited procedural detail.

key_conditions.value: For naturalisation: full age and capacity, good character, adequate English and knowledge of citizens' duties, the statutory residence history, intent to reside in Saint Lucia or serve its government, renunciation of other citizenship, and an oath of allegiance. The application form also calls for police clearance, tax-compliance proof and references.
key_conditions.notes: Naturalisation is discretionary. No official source confirms that temporary Live It or ordinary visitor time satisfies the residence requirement.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: Section 6 creates spouse registration categories without stating a minimum marriage-duration or prior-residence period. Zero means no statutory waiting period was found, not automatic same-day citizenship.

existing_marriage_effect.value: A current marriage to a Saint Lucian citizen supports an application for registration. The text also refers to persons who have been married to someone who was a citizen during the marriage, but case-specific eligibility should be confirmed with the Citizenship Department.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: Registration is not automatic merely upon marriage.

requirements_and_risks.value: The applicant must use the prescribed registration process. The Minister may consider residence, character, English knowledge, security and public order, and criminal history in relevant registration cases. Marriage and identity documents must be genuine; false statements, concealment or sham arrangements risk refusal, loss of citizenship and legal penalties.
requirements_and_risks.notes: The statute's spouse provisions and refusal grounds are structured differently for some registration categories, so filing advice is recommended.

birthright_citizenship.notes: A person born in Saint Lucia after 22 February 1979 becomes a citizen, subject only to narrow diplomatic-immunity and enemy-occupation exceptions.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A child born in Saint Lucia generally becomes a citizen even when both parents are foreign migrants, unless the narrow diplomatic-immunity or enemy-occupation exception applies.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: A child born in Saint Lucia is a citizen by birth regardless, subject to the narrow exceptions. Citizenship by descent may also apply to a child born abroad to a Saint Lucian parent under separate provisions.

parent_benefit_summary.value: Birth of a Saint Lucian citizen child does not automatically give either foreign parent residence, permanent residence or citizenship. Any parental application requires a separate legal basis and confirmation from immigration authorities.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: No automatic parent-regularization provision was identified in the reviewed sources.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: The foreign father does not automatically receive citizenship or residence because the child is a citizen. He must qualify independently under immigration, residence, registration or naturalisation rules.

passport.index_name: Henley Passport Index 2026 for rank/access; Passport Index 2026 for category breakdown

rank.notes: The live 2026 Henley table reviewed on 2026-08-15 lists Saint Lucia at rank 32 with access to 143 destinations.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Henley's access score combines destinations accessible without obtaining a visa in advance and is not a pure visa-free-only count.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Passport Index's live category breakdown; methodology differs from Henley.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: Passport Index listed 41 visa-on-arrival and 5 eTA destinations on 2026-08-15. This combined value excludes its separate eVisa category.

passport.notes: Passport rankings and access counts change frequently. Henley's current access score and Passport Index's category breakdown use different methodologies and should not be added together.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: High. English is the official language and government, immigration, tax and business information is available in English. Tourism sources also describe widespread internet access in hotels and commercial areas.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: Connectivity quality varies by property and location.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Low. No official or widely established Russian- or Ukrainian-language public-service environment was found; English would normally be needed for daily administration and professional dealings.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: This is a practical inference from English being official and Kwéyòl being the principal widely spoken local language; no quantitative Russian/Ukrainian proficiency data was found.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: No current official national mean monthly wage was published in the CSO sources reviewed. The CSO publications page lists 2025 annual and 2026 Q1 labour-force releases focused on employment indicators; the 2024 labour-market-needs questionnaire asks establishments for wage ranges but is only a survey instrument, and the 2016 living-conditions report publishes a median rather than a mean.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate conversion of the latest official national median earnings figure located, EC$1,510.30 per month in the 2016 SLC-HBS, at the EC$2.70 per US$1 peg. This is historical, not a current 2026 median.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate conversion of the statutory EC$1,131.11 monthly minimum using the EC$2.70 per US$1 currency peg.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: A current national mean salary remains unpublished in the official sources checked. Current CSO labour-force releases report employment and unemployment; the 2024 employer questionnaire collects wage bands but is not a results table; and the 2016 living-conditions report provides median earnings only.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Historical benchmark: EC$1,510.30 monthly median earnings in the official 2016 SLC-HBS, approximately US$559.37 at EC$2.70 per US$1. No newer official national median was located, so this must not be read as a current 2026 salary.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No national maximum salary statistic is published. The 2024 employer questionnaire asks respondents for their establishments' highest salary and uses an open-ended above-EC$11,000 band, but the questionnaire is not published survey results and cannot support a national maximum.

min_salary_local_currency.notes: Statutory national minimum wage, not an observed minimum or immigration threshold.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: No current official national arithmetic-mean monthly earnings value is published in the CSO pages and reports checked. The available 2016 report gives a median, while the 2024 wage questionnaire contains questions and bands but no resulting national mean.

median_salary_local_currency.value: EC$1,510.30 per month (2016 SLC-HBS median earnings)
median_salary_local_currency.notes: This is the latest official national median-earnings statistic located, but it is from the 2016 household budget survey and is not current to 2026.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: A national maximum salary is neither a statutory ceiling nor a published CSO statistic. The 2024 survey questionnaire includes an open-ended top wage band above EC$11,000 and asks each establishment for its highest salary, but no national results or finite maximum were published in the sources reviewed.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Statutory national minimum wage effective 2024; historical 2016 household-survey median; no current official mean or maximum
average_citizen_salary.period: Minimum effective 1 October 2024; median from SLC-HBS 2016; CSO releases and survey materials checked through 2026
average_citizen_salary.notes: The statutory minimum is current but is not average earnings. The only official national median located is EC$1,510.30 from 2016. Current labour-force publications do not publish mean or median pay, and the 2024 labour-market-needs questionnaire is an instrument rather than a results release; current mean and maximum therefore remain null.

cost_of_living_note.value: The CSO publishes CPI and inflation series measuring changes in household consumer prices, but the reviewed source does not provide a single current monthly cost-of-living budget. No absolute household budget is therefore reported.
cost_of_living_note.notes: CPI tracks price change, not the amount a remote worker should budget.

settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: Live It was a visitor-style extended tourism programme, not a residence permit. No current application channel, PR conversion or confirmation that its time counts for naturalisation was found.
settlement_track.summary: No current ordinary foreign-contract remote-worker residence route was found. Live It was temporary visitor permission only, so the applicant would need an entirely separate lawful residence basis and approximately eight years of qualifying residence before discretionary naturalisation could be considered.
settlement_track.notes: Permanent residence is recognized in immigration law, but the reviewed official sources did not establish a standard visitor, remote-worker or self-employed conversion path.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: Remote work was mentioned only within the legacy Live It visitor programme. Current labour law requires a work permit or exemption for a foreign national engaging in an occupation for reward or profit, and no dedicated status permitting ordinary foreign-contract remote work as a residence-to-citizenship route was confirmed.

data.notes: The previous rejection was preserved and strengthened through a focused audit of the flagged citizenship, work-permit, regional-mobility, tax-payment and wage fields. Thirty-six distinct directly relevant URLs are included, nine outside the previous source set. Current official CSO releases still do not publish a national mean or maximum wage; the record uses the official 2016 median only as an explicitly historical benchmark and leaves genuinely unpublished current figures null.

data.selection_summary: The Prime Minister’s Office provides an independently filed self-employed work-permit form and allows applications for temporary residence. Seven consecutive years of temporary residence can support permanent-residence or citizenship-registration applications. However, official materials do not expressly confirm whether foreign-client-only software contracting qualifies without local registration, customers, or business substance. Obtain written PMO confirmation before relying on this route.

visa_application.title: Prime Minister’s Office residence and self-employed work-permit forms
visa_application.notes: The official page provides downloadable forms, not a transactional online application. Residence and work-permit applications may be mailed, couriered, or delivered by a representative. The online entry-visa platform is not the residence/work-permit application.

best_routes.route_name: Self-employed work permit plus temporary residence

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No minimum income threshold is published in the reviewed official work-permit or residence materials.

minimum_income_local_currency.value: No published minimum income
minimum_income_local_currency.notes: Applicants must establish genuine self-employment and satisfy the documentary requirements.

income_requirement_display.value: No published income minimum; proof of genuine self-employment required
income_requirement_display.notes: Ask the PMO whether a foreign software contract, invoices, and foreign bank receipts suffice and whether local business registration is mandatory.

income_proof_months.notes: The official materials prescribe no fixed income or bank-statement look-back period.

key_requirements.requirement: Proof of genuine self-employment and the dedicated self-employed work-permit form.
A residence application is also required when work permission is sought for more than six months.
Passport documentation, police record, medical documents, immigration/residence report, photographs, fees, and official translations of non-English documents.
Company applicants provide registration and compliance evidence; the materials do not clearly state whether an individual foreign-contract professional must register a local business.
Self-employed residents register separately with NIS and select an income category.

initial_validity.value: A work permit alone is one-time and no longer than six months; longer work requires residence permission
initial_validity.notes: The first grant period for a combined self-employed work-permit and residence filing is discretionary.

extension_rules.value: Temporary residence and longer-term work authorization must be renewed; continuous temporary residence matters for the seven-year settlement rule
extension_rules.notes: Official pages do not publish a complete renewal test or guaranteed renewal period.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Apply independently to the Prime Minister’s Office for temporary residence and a self-employed work permit
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: Residence alone does not authorize self-employment.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: A person granted temporary residence for seven or more consecutive years may apply for permanent residence
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Eligibility to apply is not an automatic grant.

path_to_citizenship.value: Citizenship registration may be requested after seven or more consecutive years of temporary residence, or after acquiring permanent residence
path_to_citizenship.notes: The investigative process is approximately six months to one year or longer; approval remains discretionary.

best_routes.notes: This is not a digital-nomad visa. Independent self-employed filing and the seven-year settlement rule are official, but foreign-client-only remote software work remains subject to manual confirmation.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: Visitor status has no remote-worker income threshold.

minimum_income_local_currency.value: Sufficient visitor funds; no fixed amount published
minimum_income_local_currency.notes: This is an entry condition, not a residence income test.

income_requirement_display.value: No remote-worker threshold; visitor extensions cost EC$75 per month or part-month
income_requirement_display.notes: USD conversion uses EC$2.70 per US$1.

income_proof_months.notes: No fixed income-proof history is published.

key_requirements.requirement: Valid entry permission and an extension application for stays beyond the period granted at entry.
Residence and employment require separate Prime Minister’s Office permission.

initial_validity.value: Usually three or six months depending on nationality and category; the period granted at entry controls
initial_validity.notes: OECS nationals have different regional rights.

extension_rules.value: Extensions may be requested for EC$75 per month or part thereof
extension_rules.notes: An extension creates neither work authorization nor qualifying temporary residence.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: No direct path; a separate PMO residence application is required
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: Visitor permission neither converts automatically into temporary residence nor is credited toward it in the reviewed official materials. A visitor must file a separate residence application, and only time after temporary residence is granted is identified for the seven-consecutive-year settlement rule.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No confirmed path from visitor status
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The seven-year rule concerns granted temporary residence, not visitor extensions.

path_to_citizenship.value: No confirmed citizenship path from visitor status
path_to_citizenship.notes: Visitor status is excluded from selection.

rejected_routes.notes: Visitor permission is not remote-work residence authorization and does not count as the selected settlement route.

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No operational investment or income rules are published.

minimum_income_local_currency.value: Financial requirements unpublished
minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The government page only describes the programme as coming soon.

income_requirement_display.value: Not open; financial requirements unpublished
income_requirement_display.notes: An announced but non-operational investment programme cannot be used for current selection.

income_proof_months.notes: No operational programme exists from which an income-proof period could arise.

key_requirements.requirement: No stable application rules or open official application channel were available on the research date.

initial_validity.notes: No initial validity applies because the programme is not operational.

extension_rules.notes: Renewal rules are inapplicable before implementation.

path_to_temporary_residence.notes: The announcement establishes no temporary-residence route.

path_to_permanent_residence.notes: The announcement establishes no permanent-residence route.

path_to_citizenship.value: The government page labels citizenship by investment as coming soon
path_to_citizenship.notes: It remains pending and falls outside the ordinary remote-worker profile.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because it is pending, investment-based, and lacks an active application process.

summary.value: No independent degree-based or points-tested residence route for an ordinary foreign applicant was identified. CSME skills recognition is a regional nationality right for qualifying CARICOM nationals, not a general route for this profile.
summary.notes: A software-engineering degree may support a self-employed filing but does not independently create residence eligibility.

tax_residency_rule.value: Residence arises through a permanent place of abode plus some presence, at least 183 days of presence in the basis period, or the statutory continuity rule across adjacent years.
tax_residency_rule.notes: Treaty residence and tie-breaker rules may alter dual-residence cases.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate, not an expected effective rate.

social_contributions_percent.notes: Published 2026 self-employed rate. Conventional employee/employer contributions total 14%: 6.5% employee and 7.5% employer.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate minimum self-employed NIS payment of EC$70.20 monthly, converted at EC$2.70 per US$1. The occupationally appropriate income category may be higher.

special_tax_regimes.value: No special digital-nomad, remote-worker, remittance-basis, or inbound tax holiday was identified.
special_tax_regimes.notes: Assume ordinary PIT and self-employed compliance unless the IRD confirms otherwise.

taxes.caveats: Tax depends on residence, where services are performed, employment or business classification, deductions, structure, and treaty position. Foreign payment does not automatically make income exempt.

taxation_system.value: Progressive personal income tax on individual income from sources inside or outside Saint Vincent and the Grenadines.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Permanent-place-of-abode/presence tests, 183 days, or the adjacent-year continuity rule.
taxation_system.income_scope: The IRD describes PIT as covering individual income from sources inside or outside the country; non-resident and treaty treatment is fact-specific.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No digital-nomad or ordinary foreign-remote-worker exemption identified.
taxation_system.social_security: The 2026 self-employed schedule applies 13.5% to selected monthly income categories from EC$520 to EC$5,200, producing EC$70.20–EC$702 monthly contributions. Employee/employer contributions total 14%.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: Official bands are 10%, 20%, and 28%. The dashboard’s 28% is the top marginal screening rate. The IRD still links the table labelled 2024; confirm that no later schedule applies when filing.

tax_brackets.notes: USD conversion uses EC$2.70 per US$1.

tax_brackets.threshold_local: Over EC$5,000 through EC$10,000; EC$500 plus 20% of the excess over EC$5,000
tax_brackets.notes: USD figure is the upper threshold.

tax_brackets.threshold_local: Over EC$10,000; EC$1,500 plus 28% of the excess over EC$10,000
tax_brackets.notes: This is the dashboard screening rate.

taxation_system.notes: Remote-service sourcing, deductions, treaty residence, and business structure require filing-specific advice.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: There is no dedicated nomad tax category. If accepted as self-employed, ordinary PIT, business compliance, and self-employed NIS are the prudent assumptions.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: Proposed self-employed resident; no dedicated digital-nomad regime
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: Progressive PIT up to a 28% top marginal rate; not an expected effective rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: Residence can arise through permanent abode plus presence, 183 days, or the continuity rule.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: The IRD describes PIT as covering income from sources inside or outside the country. Foreign payment alone does not establish exemption.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None identified.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: Self-employed residents use a 13.5% schedule. Conventional employment uses a 14% total rate split 6.5%/7.5%.

fixed_payments.status: NIS categories are published; immigration approval charges and business-registration costs depend on filing circumstances.
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: Self-employed NIS ranges from EC$70.20 to EC$702 monthly under the 2026 schedule.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: Official materials list application and approval fees by category and nationality; obtain a current PMO calculation.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: Relevant businesses register for VAT at EC$300,000 annual sales; standard VAT is 16%. No fixed freelancer tax was identified.
fixed_payments.notes: No universal private-insurance amount, municipal freelancer levy, or minimum business fee was established.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: Short presence does not guarantee non-residence because permanent-abode and continuity tests may apply. Locally sourced income may remain taxable.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: Assume foreign-client remuneration enters ordinary PIT up to 28% unless the IRD or treaty analysis establishes otherwise.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: Expect PIT registration and returns, records, self-employed NIS, and possible business/VAT registration depending on structure and turnover.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: This models the potential self-employed route, not a digital-nomad visa; immigration acceptance remains unresolved.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: Temporary residence is applied for directly; normal processing is stated as approximately six to eight weeks.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: Application becomes possible after seven or more consecutive years; approval is not automatic.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: Permanent residents may seek citizenship registration, but seven consecutive years of temporary residence is also an independent registration ground.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: Earliest stated registration eligibility; it does not guarantee approval.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: The PMO states approximately six months to one year or longer, so no single typical value is supportable.

key_conditions.value: Secure self-employed work and temporary-residence permission, preserve consecutive temporary residence for seven years, maintain immigration, tax, and NIS compliance, and pass the citizenship investigation.
key_conditions.notes: No official language test, integration examination, formal absence limit, or mandatory renunciation rule was identified. Consecutive granted residence should not be equated with unrestricted absences.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: Current PMO guidance lists marriage to a Vincentian as a registration ground without a minimum marriage or residence period.

existing_marriage_effect.value: An existing genuine marriage creates a separate citizenship-registration basis, potentially avoiding the seven-year temporary-residence wait.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: The original Constitution uses gender-specific wording, while current PMO guidance describes marriage generally; confirm eligibility for the applicant’s circumstances.

requirements_and_risks.value: Civil-status, identity, medical, and police documents and an investigation are required. Citizenship is not automatic; false or sham-marriage evidence risks refusal and legal consequences.
requirements_and_risks.notes: PMO processing is approximately six months to one year or longer.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Constitution section 91 grants citizenship to persons born in the country, subject to narrow diplomatic-immunity and enemy-occupation exceptions.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A locally born child generally becomes a citizen even when both parents are migrants, except under the narrow constitutional exceptions.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: Parental temporary or permanent status is generally not determinative.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: A locally born child generally has citizenship by birth. A child born abroad may acquire citizenship if a qualifying parent is a citizen.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: PMO guidance also recognizes citizenship by descent.

parent_benefit_summary.value: A citizen child does not automatically make a foreign parent a citizen or permanent resident. No automatic parent-of-citizen residence route was identified.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: Family circumstances may be presented in a discretionary filing but are not a guaranteed entitlement.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: A migrant father receives no automatic residence, permanent residence, or citizenship through the child and must qualify independently.
benefit_to_migrant_father.notes: Marriage to a Vincentian parent may provide a separate basis; fatherhood alone does not.

rank.notes: Passport Power Rank on 2026-08-15. Henley separately showed rank 22 and access to 157 destinations under a different methodology.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Strict visa-free category.

visa_required_destinations.notes: Visa-required category.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: 39 visa-on-arrival plus 7 eTA destinations.

passport.notes: Index methodologies differ; Passport Index supplies the requested categorical breakdown.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: High for communication: English is official and used for laws, forms, business, and public services. Verify internet quality at the intended address.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: Vincentian Creole is common in everyday speech.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Low. No reliable source established widespread Russian- or Ukrainian-language public services; applicants should expect to operate in English.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: This is an inference from official-language information, not a measured proficiency statistic.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: The official 2022 survey publishes a national median and grouped counts but no arithmetic mean.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: EC$14,560.86 annual median divided by 12 and converted at EC$2.70 per US$1.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Illustrative statutory floor for a full-time domestic general helper: EC$1,000 monthly at EC$2.70 per US$1. Wage floors are sector- and occupation-specific, not universal.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: The official survey publishes no national arithmetic mean; open-ended bands prevent reliable reconstruction.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate monthly conversion of official 2022 median gross annual income.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: The upper survey class is open-ended at EC$50,000 or more annually; no finite national maximum is published.

min_salary_local_currency.value: Sector-specific; EC$1,000/month for a full-time domestic general helper (other 2024 orders use occupation-specific hourly or daily floors)
min_salary_local_currency.notes: Current official materials establish separate wage regulations for agriculture, call centres, domestic work, industry, shop assistants, security, professional offices, nursing homes, and hotel/tourism work. EC$1,000 monthly is an expressly published example, not a universal national monthly minimum.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: The 2022 Labour Force Survey reports median gross annual income of EC$14,560.86 and income-band counts, but no national arithmetic mean. A mean cannot reliably be derived because the lowest and highest bands are open-ended and 6,030 employed persons have income not stated.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: Official gross annual median divided by 12.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: The survey’s highest category is EC$50,000 or more annually—an open-ended band, not a maximum. Current official statistical and wage-order pages publish no finite national maximum salary.

average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Official 2022 gross annual employed-person income for the median; current 2024 sector-specific statutory wage floors for the minimum example
average_citizen_salary.period: 2022 earnings survey; 2024 wage orders shown as current by the Labour Department in 2026
average_citizen_salary.notes: The income statistic covers employed persons and is not an immigration threshold or software-engineer salary. Minimum wages are sector-specific; no arithmetic mean or finite maximum is published.

cost_of_living_note.value: No reliable official current remote-worker household budget was identified. July 2026 inflation of 2.9% does not establish a monthly living-cost budget.
cost_of_living_note.notes: Housing and inter-island costs vary; obtain current local quotations.

settlement_track.nomad_only_warning: This is not a digital-nomad visa. It requires acceptance under the self-employed work-permit system plus granted temporary residence.
settlement_track.summary: If foreign-client-only software contracting is accepted as self-employment, the combined route can reach citizenship-registration eligibility after seven consecutive years. The settlement rule is official; initial eligibility for ordinary foreign-contract remote work remains unresolved.
settlement_track.notes: Permanent residence is not expressly required before citizenship registration, but continuous temporary residence and approval after investigation are required.

regular_foreign_contract_remote_work_fit.notes: Official sources allow independent self-employed work-permit and temporary-residence filings but do not confirm qualification without local customers, registration, or economic substance.

data.notes: Focused unresolved-field audit completed. Current official materials establish sector-specific 2024 wage floors, including EC$1,000 monthly for a full-time domestic general helper, but no universal monthly minimum. The Labour Force Survey establishes a median but neither an arithmetic mean nor a finite maximum. The decisive immigration gap remains PMO acceptance of ordinary foreign-client-only remote software work.

data.selection_summary: No current Samoan digital-nomad, foreign-remote-worker, or ordinary foreign-client freelance residence route was found. Visitor permits prohibit work; employment requires a permit tied to a specific Samoan employer and role; and the independently initiated business route requires a Foreign Investment Certificate, business licence, company or sole-trader establishment, and genuine business activity in Samoa. The latter is an entrepreneur/investment route, not a clean residence route for continuing an ordinary foreign software contract, and no automatic transition from it to permanent residence was confirmed.

visa_application.title: Samoa Immigration Forms
visa_application.notes: This official page provides temporary- and permanent-residence forms, but Samoa has no dedicated digital-nomad application. Applicants should verify the appropriate permit with Immigration before filing; temporary-residence approval must be obtained before travel.

rejected_routes.route_name: Temporary Resident Permit for conduct of business or investment

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No monthly foreign-income threshold is published; this is a business-establishment route.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No monthly income threshold was found. Business approvals and operating substance are required instead.

income_requirement_display.value: No published monthly income threshold; FIC, business licence, business registration and genuine Samoan business activity required
income_requirement_display.currency_basis: WST/SAT business fees and compliance requirements
income_requirement_display.local_or_formula_value: FIC application SAT 50 plus SAT 50 issuance; annual FIC renewal SAT 50; temporary-residence main-applicant fee SAT 900 offshore or SAT 1,800 in-country
income_requirement_display.notes: The fees are not income thresholds. Other registration, licensing and sectoral costs can apply.

income_proof_months.notes: No fixed number of income-proof months is published for this route.

key_requirements.requirement: Obtain a Foreign Investment Certificate, register the business or company, and obtain a current Ministry of Revenue business licence.
File temporary-residence form MPMC100; medical and police reports are required for business/investment applicants, with the general police/medical rules applying to longer stays.

A foreigner working in the Samoan business may also require a Foreign Employee Employment Permit; the official 2026 guide states that non-citizens operating a business are subject to employment-permit requirements.

initial_validity.value: Grant-specific temporary residence; official page publishes a 10-working-day processing target but not a standard permit duration
initial_validity.notes: The FIC is renewed annually. Permit validity must be confirmed from the grant and Immigration.

extension_rules.value: Residence renewal terms are not published in sufficient detail; the FIC and business licence must remain current, and material business changes must be reported
extension_rules.notes: The FIC renewal application is normally due at least three months before expiry.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Direct application for business/investment temporary residence after obtaining the required Samoan business approvals

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No automatic years-based conversion from this temporary-business permit to permanent residence was confirmed
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: A permanent-residence form and fee exist, but the official pages reviewed do not publish a general eligibility clock connecting temporary business residence to PR.

path_to_citizenship.value: Citizenship is available after continuously holding permanent residence for five years, but no reliable time from this business permit to permanent residence is published
path_to_citizenship.notes: Temporary-business residence should not be treated as starting the statutory five-year citizenship period.

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected for the specified profile because it requires creation and operation of a regulated Samoan business, not merely an existing foreign-client software contract. ICT is a priority investment sector, but that does not remove foreign-investment, licensing, work-permit, and local-business requirements.

rejected_routes.route_name: Temporary Resident Permit for employment plus FEEP

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: No remote-worker income threshold; a specific Samoan employer and position are required.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: The statutory minimum wage is not an immigration income threshold.

income_requirement_display.value: No nomad-income threshold; specific Samoan employer, role and employer-filed FEEP required
income_requirement_display.notes: The employer submits the FEEP application and the case is assessed against local labour demand and supply.

income_proof_months.notes: No fixed income-history period is published.

key_requirements.requirement: Employer-filed Foreign Employee Employment Permit tied to the named employer and role, plus a residence permit.
Employer sponsorship, qualifications, medical report and police report as applicable.
Labour-market demand and supply assessment by MCIL.

initial_validity.value: FEEP valid for up to three years, subject to conditions; residence-permit validity is grant-specific
initial_validity.notes: The permit is non-transferable between employers or roles.

extension_rules.value: A new or replacement authorization is required if the employment or nominated employer changes
extension_rules.notes: If nominated employment ends, the residence permit is subject to cancellation and the person must leave or obtain a new basis.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: Employment residence is available after sponsorship and FEEP approval

path_to_permanent_residence.value: No automatic transition based solely on years of sponsored temporary employment was confirmed
path_to_permanent_residence.notes: Permanent-residence applications exist, but current public guidance does not provide a general employment-to-PR clock.

path_to_citizenship.value: A separate permanent-residence grant is required, followed by five continuous years holding PR

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because a local employer must apply and the permit is tied to that employer and role.

rejected_routes.route_name: Visitor Permit or Business Visitor Permit

minimum_monthly_income_usd.notes: Only sufficient support funds are required; no fixed threshold is published.

minimum_income_local_currency.notes: No fixed amount is published.

income_requirement_display.value: Sufficient funds; no fixed amount; work is prohibited
income_requirement_display.notes: A business visitor may undertake short meetings, negotiations, conferences, or branch visits while normally employed and paid offshore, but this does not authorize ongoing remote work.

income_proof_months.notes: Not published.

key_requirements.requirement: Passport valid at least six months beyond the intended stay, onward ticket, permission for the next destination, sufficient funds and confirmed local contact address.

initial_validity.value: 90 days on arrival
initial_validity.notes: Qualifying foreign nationals receive the visitor permit at the border.

extension_rules.value: A visitor extension uses form MPMC100 with onward ticket, sufficient-funds evidence and accommodation details
extension_rules.notes: Using a temporary-residence form for an extension does not turn the visitor stay into a work-authorized or settlement route.

path_to_temporary_residence.value: No qualifying residence is granted by the visitor permit
path_to_temporary_residence.notes: Another independently qualifying permit would be required.

path_to_permanent_residence.value: None from visitor status

path_to_citizenship.value: None from visitor status

rejected_routes.notes: Rejected because work is expressly prohibited. The narrow business-visitor permission does not cover ordinary ongoing remote software work.

summary.value: A foreign student admitted to a Samoan educational institution can apply for a study-purpose temporary residence permit without an employer. Enrollment confirmation and proof of funds are required; work is only possible part-time if separately authorized. A degree already held by the applicant does not create an independent skilled-residence route, and no study-to-PR conversion was confirmed.
summary.notes: This is an education route requiring local enrollment, not a qualification-based route for continuing foreign remote work.

tax_residency_rule.value: An individual is resident for a tax year if they have a home in Samoa during the year or are present for an aggregate 183 days in any 12-month period commencing or ending in that tax year; special arrival and departure rules can apportion the resident period.
tax_residency_rule.notes: Tax residence can therefore arise through the home test before day 183.

income_tax_rate_percent.notes: Top marginal screening rate, not the expected effective rate.

social_contributions_percent.notes: Employee SNPF contribution for covered employment. The employer contributes a matching 10% and also pays a 1% accident-compensation levy. This payroll regime is not evidence that a foreign remote worker can lawfully reside or register locally.

fixed_payments_usd_monthly.notes: No universal fixed monthly nomad or sole-trader social-security payment was found. Employee contributions are percentage-based.

special_tax_regimes.value: No digital-nomad or ordinary remote-worker tax exemption was found. The Income Tax Act contains narrow exemptions for certain short visits, approved foreign-government/development services and specified temporary employment, but none is a general nomad regime.
special_tax_regimes.notes: The short-visit personal-services exemption requires no more than 30 days in the tax year, taxation in the home country, and services for a nonresident person; it does not override immigration rules.

taxes.caveats: A foreign payer does not necessarily keep income outside Samoa's tax net: salary for employment exercised in Samoa is Samoa-source wherever paid, and resident-business income is generally sourced to Samoa except for business attributable to a permanent establishment outside Samoa. Classification as employee versus independent business, the location where services are exercised, any treaty position, and whether a Samoan business is created require professional advice.

taxation_system.value: Progressive personal income tax: 0% through SAT 15,000 annual taxable income, 20% on the SAT 15,001–25,000 band, and 27% above SAT 25,000. Resident remote work physically performed in Samoa can be Samoa-source even when paid offshore.
taxation_system.tax_residency_rule: Home in Samoa during the tax year or aggregate presence of 183 days in a relevant 12-month period, with statutory arrival/departure rules.
taxation_system.income_scope: Samoa-source income is taxable; employment exercised in Samoa is Samoa-source wherever paid. Resident business income is generally Samoa-source except to the extent attributable to a permanent establishment outside Samoa.
taxation_system.special_regimes: No general digital-nomad, expatriate, remittance-basis or foreign-remote-income holiday was found.
taxation_system.social_security: Covered employees contribute 10% of gross wages to SNPF, employers match 10%, and employers pay a 1% accident-compensation levy. Applicability to any foreign arrangement depends on lawful local registration and worker classification.
taxation_system.progressive_tax_notes: The displayed 27% is the top marginal rate. It does not apply to the first SAT 25,000 and is not an effective-rate estimate.

tax_brackets.applies_to: Annual individual or sole-trader taxable income
tax_brackets.notes: USD approximation uses the Central Bank of Samoa indicative rate of USD 0.36708 per SAT 1 on 14 August 2026.

tax_brackets.applies_to: The taxable-income slice within this band
tax_brackets.notes: USD figure is the approximate upper threshold, not tax due.
Top marginal band.

taxation_system.notes: VAGST is 15%. Registration is generally compulsory for continuous and regular taxable business activity when annual turnover exceeds SAT 130,000; business licensing and annual income-tax filing also apply to persons carrying on business in Samoa.

digital_nomad_taxation.value: Not applicable as a special route because Samoa has no confirmed digital-nomad permit. If a person nevertheless performs services while physically in Samoa, ordinary source and residence rules must be analyzed; immigration permission remains a separate issue.
digital_nomad_taxation.route_tax_category: No digital-nomad category; ordinary individual, employee, sole-trader or nonresident rules as applicable
digital_nomad_taxation.income_tax_display: 0% / 20% / 27% progressive PIT; 27% is the top marginal screening rate
digital_nomad_taxation.tax_residency_rule: Home in Samoa or 183 aggregate days in a relevant 12-month period, subject to arrival/departure provisions.
digital_nomad_taxation.foreign_income_treatment: Employment exercised in Samoa is Samoa-source wherever paid. Resident business income is generally Samoa-source unless attributable to a permanent establishment outside Samoa; contract-specific sourcing requires advice.
digital_nomad_taxation.special_digital_nomad_or_inbound_regime: None found for ordinary foreign-contract remote workers.
digital_nomad_taxation.social_security_and_payroll: Covered local employment generally carries 10% employee SNPF, 10% employer SNPF and a 1% employer accident levy. No fixed nomad contribution was found.

fixed_payments.status: No fixed nomad payment; percentage-based payroll and business obligations may apply
fixed_payments.social_security_or_payroll: No universal monthly minimum found; covered employee SNPF is 10% plus 10% employer matching and 1% employer accident levy.
fixed_payments.visa_or_state_fees: No nomad fee. Business temporary residence costs SAT 900 for an offshore main applicant or SAT 1,800 in-country; visitor permit fee is SAT 200 where applicable.
fixed_payments.other_fixed_or_transaction_taxes: FIC fees include SAT 50 application, SAT 50 issuance and SAT 50 annual renewal. VAGST is 15%, with a published SAT 130,000 annual turnover registration threshold.
fixed_payments.notes: Business-licence and sector-specific fees were not reducible to a universal monthly amount.

practical_scenarios.under_tax_residency_threshold: Visitor status still prohibits work. Tax law contains a narrow exemption for qualifying foreign personal services performed during visits totaling no more than 30 days, but this is not a general 182-day tax holiday and does not supply immigration permission.
practical_scenarios.tax_resident_remote_worker: Potentially subject to progressive PIT up to 27%; work exercised in Samoa can be Samoa-source even with a foreign employer or client.
practical_scenarios.self_employed_or_local_registration: A person carrying on business in Samoa must register for income tax and generally needs a business licence; foreign investment, immigration, FEEP and VAGST requirements may also apply.

digital_nomad_taxation.notes: Tax analysis does not cure the absence of a lawful ordinary remote-worker immigration route.

years_to_temporary_residence.notes: No qualifying remote-work route exists. Separate employment, business, study and family temporary permits are application-based rather than earned after a published number of years.

years_to_permanent_residence_after_tempo.notes: The official pages provide a PR application and fees but do not publish a general years-based temporary-residence-to-PR rule for the rejected business or employment routes.

years_to_citizenship_after_permanent_res.notes: The applicant must have continuously held a valid permanent-resident permit for the five years immediately preceding the citizenship application.

total_years_to_citizenship.notes: Five years after PR is known, but time to qualify for and obtain PR from any relevant temporary route is not established; there is no qualifying remote-work route.

typical_citizenship_processing_time_mont.notes: No official typical citizenship processing time was published on the pages reviewed. The 10-working-day target shown by Immigration applies to visitor, temporary-residence and PR permits, not clearly to citizenship.

key_conditions.value: For citizenship by permanent residence: continuously hold PR for five years, be of good health and character, understand citizenship responsibilities and privileges, intend to continue residing in Samoa, pay the fee, and provide evidence of employment plus business and social activity over the preceding five years.
key_conditions.notes: No formal language-test score or general renunciation requirement was found in the cited provisions. Citizenship remains a registration decision by the Minister.

years_of_marriage_or_residence_required.notes: Five continuous years married to and residing with the Samoan spouse, in Samoa or elsewhere, immediately before applying.

existing_marriage_effect.value: An existing marriage can count if the couple has continuously been married and residing together during the qualifying five-year period. At application, the statute also requires the applicant to be residing in Samoa with the spouse and intending to continue doing so.
existing_marriage_effect.notes: Marriage does not grant citizenship automatically; registration must be approved.

requirements_and_risks.value: Provide evidence of time living together and the continuing marriage; the applicant must also be in good health and character, understand citizenship responsibilities and privileges, and pay the substantial citizenship-by-marriage fee. False or sham evidence risks refusal and immigration or criminal consequences.
requirements_and_risks.notes: The official fee published on 15 August 2026 was SAT 5,400.

birthright_citizenship.notes: Birth in Samoa alone is insufficient. At least one parent must be a Samoan citizen at the time of birth, subject to narrow statutory provisions.

if_both_parents_migrants.value: A Samoa-born child of two noncitizen migrant parents does not obtain Samoan citizenship merely by being born there. No general PR-parent birthright rule was found.
if_both_parents_migrants.notes: Other anti-statelessness or exceptional ministerial provisions should be checked for unusual individual cases.

if_second_parent_local_citizen.value: If either parent is a Samoan citizen when the child is born in Samoa, the child is a citizen by birth. A child born abroad can acquire citizenship by descent when the Samoan parent satisfies the statutory transmission conditions.
if_second_parent_local_citizen.notes: Where the Samoan parent is themselves a citizen only by descent, that parent generally must have accumulated at least three years of residence in Samoa to transmit citizenship to a child born abroad.

parent_benefit_summary.value: Having a Samoan-citizen child does not automatically give a foreign parent permanent residence or citizenship. A parent may investigate a separate family-support or reunion temporary permit, but no automatic parent-to-PR conversion was confirmed.
parent_benefit_summary.notes: Family residence and citizenship must be applied for on their own legal grounds.

benefit_to_migrant_father.value: A foreign father receives no automatic citizenship from the child's status. If the other parent is Samoan, the child can be Samoan, while the father must independently qualify through marriage, family residence, employment, business, or another permit.

rank.notes: The live Henley ranking inspected on 15 August 2026 listed Samoa at rank 39 with a score of 129. A secondary page still reported rank 35, so the current official live ranking was preferred.

visa_free_destinations.notes: Henley's score counts destinations accessible without a prior visa, including visa-free and visa-on-arrival access; it is not a pure visa-free-only count.

visa_required_destinations.notes: The inspected current ranking did not publish a reliable separate visa-required total for Samoa.

visa_on_arrival_or_eta_destinations.notes: A current Samoa-specific VOA/eTA subtotal was not exposed in the sources reviewed; 129 is the combined Henley access score and should not be duplicated here.

passport.notes: Passport data are current-index screening figures and can change whenever destination entry rules change.

english_remote_work_practicality.value: English is institutionally recognized alongside Samoan and is used in legislation, government and investment materials. It is practical for business and remote-work logistics, although Samoan is central to everyday community and cultural life.
english_remote_work_practicality.notes: Language practicality does not overcome the absence of a remote-work permit.

russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.value: Russian and Ukrainian are not official languages, and no reliable evidence of broad public-service availability in either language was found. English would normally be required for immigration, tax and business dealings.
russian_or_ukrainian_practicality.notes: This is a cautious practical inference from the official bilingual framework; no population-level Russian/Ukrainian proficiency dataset was found.

average_wage_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate gross formal-sector monthly average: SAT 42,388 annual wage divided by 12 and converted at the Central Bank's indicative USD 0.36708 per SAT 1 rate on 14 August 2026.

median_wage_usd_monthly.notes: The latest official employment report publishes mean wages, not a national median.

min_salary_usd_monthly.notes: The minimum is statutory hourly pay; a monthly USD amount would require an unsupported assumption about working hours.

average_salary_usd_monthly.notes: Approximate gross formal-sector mean, converted using the Central Bank's 14 August 2026 indicative rate.

median_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No current official median wage was found.

max_salary_usd_monthly.notes: No meaningful national maximum salary is published; industry mean highs are not individual maximum salaries.

min_salary_local_currency.notes: Statutory private-sector and state-owned-enterprise minimum effective 1 July 2026; workers under the Public Service Act are excluded.

average_salary_local_currency.notes: Derived from the official SAT 42,388 average annual formal wage for the 12 months ending March 2026.

median_salary_local_currency.notes: Not published in the current official report.

max_salary_local_currency.notes: No national maximum was published.

average_citizen_salary.currency: WST (Samoan tala; official sources commonly display SAT or $)
average_citizen_salary.salary_basis: Gross wages of formal employees registered with the Samoa National Provident Fund; excludes proprietors, self-employed people, unpaid family/volunteer workers, farm workers, domestic workers and the informal sector
average_citizen_salary.period: Twelve months ending March 2026; minimum wage effective 1 July 2026
average_citizen_salary.notes: The formal-sector mean is not a median, immigration income threshold, or expected software-engineer salary.

cost_of_living_note.value: The official CPI series showed year-on-year inflation of 2.1% in May 2026, including notable increases in transport and housing/utilities, but it does not provide a defensible monthly expatriate living-cost budget.
cost_of_living_note.notes: A monthly cost estimate is intentionally omitted because no reliable official household budget matching a remote worker was established.
